gist: If I truly believe Ram will do me good, then Ram does it, not Krishna; belief decides who helps.

hindi: मेरी तार जुड़ गई आपके पर्सनलाइज्ड 72 पर मानसिकता आपके 12 पर की स्टिमुलेशन के अकॉर्डिंग चलती है और चलाती है इसे कहते हैं बॉडी और माइंड सिंक
says: He splits a life into a small fixed chart part (the garbled '12 par', probably 12 percent) and a large personalised part (garbled '72 par') where belief and mindset respond to the chart's stimulation; body and mind in sync is the goal.
ambiguity: The numbers 72 and 12 are garbled; they may be percentages, or 'par' may mean something else. Later he calls the 12 part the fixed kundli, which supports a 12 percent reading.
classical_check: Silent; the fixed (prarabdha) versus effort (purushartha) idea exists classically but no percentages are given.

hindi: कोई नंबर गंदा अच्छा नहीं है 8 तारीख को जन्म लोग फलाने होते हैं अबे यार बेवकूफी वाली बातें हैं
says: He rejects numerology claims: no number is good or bad in itself, and the idea that people born on the 8th are of one type is called silly.
classical_check: Birth-date numerology is not part of classical Parashari Jyotish, so this agrees with the classical texts' silence.

gist: Sade sati is blamed for everything; Ram and Ravan faced the same conditions yet turned out differently.

hindi: आपकी में इतने गुण मिलते हैं आपका घर सीता माता और राम का कहते हैं 36 मिले थे 36 कभी मिल ही नहीं सकते 35 से ऊपर मिलते नहीं है
says: He mocks guna-milan scoring for marriage: claims of 36 out of 36 matches (like Ram and Sita) are false, since a full 36 never really occurs and scores above 35 do not occur.
ambiguity: Factually a score of 36 is possible in ashtakoota (same Moon nakshatra, pada and lord combinations); his claim that it cannot occur is questionable or may refer to practical rarity.
classical_check: Differs: ashtakoota maximum is 36 and attainable in principle; the legend of Ram and Sita having 36 is popular, not classical.

hindi: बृहस्पति अपने आगे किसी की चलने नहीं देता क्योंकि वह गुरु ग्रह है यदि गुरु ही डिस्टर्ब या घातक या खराब हो जाए तो किसी की भी नहीं सुनता व्यक्ति
says: Jupiter lets no one override him because he is the guru planet; if Jupiter itself is disturbed, harmful or spoiled, the native becomes stubborn and listens to nobody.
cells_derived_method: Same afflicted-Jupiter stubbornness is coloured by the house Jupiter occupies (what area of life) and the sign (whose style the stubbornness takes); strongest where Jupiter rules or sits in kendras.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: afflicted Jupiter in the 9th in Mercury's sign could show a native who argues against teachers and elders and rejects dharma advice.
Derived: afflicted Jupiter in the 10th in a critical earth sign could give a boss who will not take advice at work.

classical_check: Agrees with Jupiter as guru karaka; Jupiter's affliction making one deaf to counsel is an interpretation, not a quoted classical verse.

hindi: किसी ग्रह के वक्री हो जाने मात्र से उस ग्रह की पॉइंट्स नेगेटिव होने शुरू हो जाते हैं वक्री का क्या मतलब होता है
says: He denies that retrogression alone makes a planet's results negative (the point on which the sentence is garbled), and says he will explain what vakri actually means.
ambiguity: Caption drops the negation: it reads as if retrogression makes points negative, but the context ('mere retrogression') suggests he says it does NOT automatically do so.
classical_check: Classically retrograde planets gain cheshta bala (strength), so agrees that retrograde is not simply bad.

hindi: हमारे को अपना इष्ट पता होना चाहिए अगर इष्ट हमें सही पता है तो यार इष्ट का करना क्या है हमें इष्ट की
says: One must know one's own ishta devata correctly; once known, the question is what to do for that deity (sentence continues into worship and sadhana).
ambiguity: How he determines the ishta is not given in this sentence.
classical_check: Ishta devata from the Atmakaraka in the Navamsa (Karakamsha) is the classical Jaimini method; he does not state it here.

gist: If you do not know how to do puja then make pickle of it; sarcastic aside.

hindi: इष्ट की साधना करेंगे इंटरनेट ने बता रखा है ओम नमो शिवाय कर लो शिवजी जेब में होंगे ऐसे नहीं होते बड़ा लफड़ा है
says: Remedy should be sadhana of one's own ishta; chanting a generic mantra such as Om Namah Shivaya because the internet says so does not put Shiva in your pocket, it is not that easy.
classical_check: Silent; classical remedies are prescribed per planet and chart, consistent with his point against generic mantras.

hindi: क्रोसिन की गोली सब खाते हैं जेनेरिक है लेकिन डॉक्टर यह कहेगा ऐसा हो सकता है तुम्हें सेफाम की जरूरत है ... क्रोसिन आप का टाइम पास टेंपरेरी उपाय है
says: Analogy: a generic remedy is like Crocin for fever, only a temporary time-pass; the real cause needs a specific diagnosis and medicine, so astrological remedies must target the root cause in the chart. Medical details here are only an analogy, not advice.
classical_check: Silent; the analogy is his own.

hindi: जब जब पुरुष होक भी किसी के चरणों में जा रहे हो आपके तीनों प्लेनेट प्रबल हो रहे हैं अगर यह दोषी है तो दोष भी मुक्त हो रहा है
says: Bowing at someone's feet, even as a man, strengthens three planets of yours, and if those planets are afflicted the affliction is cleared; the three planets are not named in the caption.
ambiguity: Which three planets is not stated; the next section ties bones and humility to Saturn, so Saturn may be one. Caption is also partly garbled.
classical_check: Silent; respect to elders as a remedy for afflicted planets appears in remedial traditions, not in the Parashari rules.

gist: People change focus at every remark and get provoked by what others say.

hindi: जो व्यक्ति किसी के कहने पर कुछ नहीं मानते जब तक खुद ना आजमा ले उनको शर की हड्डिया मजबूत रहती सारी सारी की सारी हड्डियां शनि के पास है
says: People who accept nothing on hearsay until they test it themselves keep strong bones, because bones all belong to Saturn; he links self-tested, grounded Saturn-type character with bone strength. Health claim is his tradition claim, not medical advice.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's bone significance is modified by Saturn's house (which body area or life area) and sign dignity (strong in Libra, Capricorn, Aquarius).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in the first house would suggest sturdy frame and strong bones.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in the 8th would suggest weak or injury-prone bones and joints.

ambiguity: The caption says 'शर की हड्डिया', probably 'sir ki haddiyan' or 'sharir ki', i.e. skull or body bones.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is the classical karaka of bones and joints.

hindi: शनि के पास मूलाधार चक्र है शनि के पास सारी माया है
says: Saturn holds the muladhara (root) chakra and the whole of maya, the material illusion.
classical_check: Chakra-planet mapping is tantric, not Parashari; Saturn-muladhara is a common but not universal assignment.

hindi: शनि के पास सारी चिजी है प्रॉपर्टी जायदाद जमीन भोग विलास की चिजी भोग नहीं विलास नहीं चिजी यह सारी की सारी शनि के पास है
says: Saturn controls the material assets: property, inheritance, land, and objects of comfort and luxury; these are all in Saturn's hands.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's capacity to deliver property depends on its house (4th for land and home, 2nd for accumulated wealth) and sign strength.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in own sign in the 4th would suggest land and house ownership, built slowly.
Derived: Saturn in own sign in the 11th would suggest gains through property and long-term assets.

classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn is a karaka for land and long-lasting assets; luxury is classically Venus, so he differs there.

hindi: इसी को आदेश देता है मालिक सूर्य सूर्य के आगे कभी नहीं जाता
says: Saturn takes orders from the Sun, its master, and never goes against or ahead of the Sun; Sun is the owner and Saturn the servant who holds the assets.
ambiguity: 'आगे कभी नहीं जाता' could mean never defies the Sun or never moves ahead of him; the caption cuts at 'य'.
classical_check: Mythologically Saturn is Sun's son and an enemy in Parashari friendship tables, so 'servant' differs from the classical enmity.

gist: Bowing to a stone idol is easy, bowing to a living person is hard; we think others are not worthy.
Every person holds hidden treasure and a possible guru, even someone who looks like a joker.
Lack of confidence comes from years of being told we are worthless; we are children of God, no less than Him.
Starts a remark on Krishna's personality; caption breaks at the 4:04 boundary.
Krishna believed Aham Brahmasmi; many babies were born then, yet only one Krishna rose.

hindi: 12 लग्न चलते हैं एक दिन के 24 घंटे में लगभग लगभग दो घंटे का एक लग्न होता है वेरिएट करता है क्योंकि धरती अंडाकार घूमती है
says: Twelve lagnas rise in a 24 hour day, each about two hours, and the length varies because the earth's motion is elliptical, so there is some error in uniform timing.
ambiguity: Physically the variation comes from latitude and the oblique ascension of signs, not the ellipse alone.
classical_check: Agrees on about 2 hours (about 4 ghatis variable); classical lagna durations vary by latitude.

hindi: कृष्ण ही अकेला क्यों उठे क्योंकि कृष्ण के अंदर मादा था खोपड़ी में कुछ था यह पूर्व जन्म के कई संस्कारों से होता है
says: Many people share Krishna's chart timing yet only he rose; the difference is inner capacity from past-life samskaras, so the same chart gives different results for different souls.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical view of purva-janma karma as the source of chart differences; same-chart twins are a standard discussion point.

hindi: यह 12 प्र जो कुंडली हमारी फिक्स बन गई जो प्रारब्ध है जो मुन्ना है जो हमारा मूलाधार है जो हमारा शनि ग्रह जहां बैठा है जहां शनि मुखिया है ... उसको वेरिएट करने की क्षमता हमारी ह्यूमन कॉन्शियस में है
says: The fixed chart is prarabdha, tied to the muladhara and to where Saturn sits, where Saturn is chief; yet human consciousness has the capacity to vary it.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's house marks the area where prarabdha is most fixed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 7th would put the fixed destiny theme in partnership and marriage.
Derived: Saturn in the 2nd would put the fixed theme in family, speech and savings.

ambiguity: The caption says 'मुन्ना', likely garbled 'मूल' (root); 'मुखिया' suggests Saturn as head, not that other planets are absent.
classical_check: Classically Saturn is a karaka for karma, not the sole signifier of prarabdha; this is his own emphasis.

hindi: यदि आप में गुर्दा है जान है तो आप उन चीजों को ऑप्टिमम बेस्टेस्ट लेवल तक उठाकर ले जा सकते हैं इसलिए आपके अपने अंदर का दम होना चाहिए
says: With personal courage and effort, a native can lift the fixed chart's indications to their best possible level; inner strength decides how far the chart's promise is realised.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with purushartha over daiva, though classical texts give no measure.

gist: Greeting, welcome, thanks for joining, and that today is the second part on Jyotish.

hindi: हमारा ज्योतिष सिर्फ ज्योतिष विज्ञान पर नहीं चलेगा क्योंकि वह 12 प्र होता है लेकिन यह इतना ज्यादा महत्त्वपूर्ण है कि यह रीढ़ की हड्डी की तरह है बदलता नहीं
says: His method will not rest on chart science alone since the chart is only the fixed (about 12 percent) part; but that part is as vital and unchanging as a spine, and the rest of life is flexible around it.
ambiguity: The number is garbled ('12 प्र' may be 12 percent); it echoes the earlier garbled '12 par'.
classical_check: Silent on percentages.

gist: Life pushes us to live with the same brothers and house; trying to raise ourselves we often cause decline.

hindi: अगर शुरू में देखा कि जीवन के अंदर किसी स्त्री होने के नाते पुरुष का सुख नहीं है तो भाई का नहीं होगा पिता का नहीं होगा पति का नहीं होगा पुत्र का भी नहीं होगा
says: If a woman's chart shows lack of happiness from men, he reads that lack across all male relations: brother, father, husband and son would all be missing.
cells_derived_method: The lack depends on which house and sign hold the relevant karakas (Jupiter for husband and son, Sun for father, Mars for brother) and their affliction.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: afflicted Mars-ruled 7th could weaken husband and brother significations together.
Derived: afflicted Jupiter in the 5th could weaken son and husband happiness together.

ambiguity: Which chart factor shows 'male happiness' is not named; he seems to treat it as one pooled indicator.
classical_check: Differs: classically each relation is judged from its own house and karaka, not as one pooled indicator.

hindi: अब रिलाइजेशन हो गई पति का तो ले लो नहीं है अच्छा पुत्र का ले लो अच्छा पुत्र भी नहीं तो जमाई का ले लो
says: Remedy by substitution: when a woman realises husband's happiness is not there, take it from the son; if not the son, then from the son-in-law, so happiness is redirected to another male relation.
classical_check: Silent; this redirection approach is his own and not a classical upaya.

hindi: पुरुष होने के नाते देख रहे हैं हमें माता का सुख नहीं मिला दादी भी नहीं थी साथ पत्नी से भी झंझट है बहन से अरे यार तो अपनी बिटिया का ही सुख ले लो कहीं तो परिवर्तन लाओ
says: For a man lacking happiness from mother, grandmother, wife and sister, the substitute is to take happiness from his own daughter; bring change somewhere since the fixed chart cannot be changed.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical remedy.

hindi: 12 पर तो फिक्स है अब भैया हड्डी में दर्द है मालिश कराते हैं तो क्या कर उपाय करते हैं उपाय का सबसे प्रमुख मुद्दा क्या है आप जैसे हो वैसे ही हो
says: The fixed part stays fixed; remedies are like massage for a bone ache, giving relief but not changing the structure, and the main point of a remedy is awareness of what one is.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut off and the line about 'you are as you are' is unclear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मैं सिर्फ ग्रहों की चलती पुती पुड़िया हूं जो ग्रह मुझे जैसा बना रहे हैं वैसे ही जी रहा हूं मैं मस्त हूं कि नहीं हूं मजे में हूं कि नहीं हूं
says: He says he is a packet moved by planets, living as the planets make him; the key awareness is whether you are cheerful and at ease or fretting, and that awareness is the first step of any remedy.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea of planets as carriers of karma; the awareness step is his own.

hindi: अगर यह ज्ञान हो गया है तो बहुत सी नेगेटिविटी धो डालूंगा और पॉजिटिविटी अपनी जगह स्वस्थ और मस्त हो जाएंगी इस चीज को धोना यदि आपने सीख लिया
says: Once the awareness is there, much negativity can be washed away and positivity settles back healthy and cheerful; learning this washing is the practical remedy he is leading to.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut off at 'कहते हैं भाग'; the conclusion is missing.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बदल दिया लेकिन भाग बदलता नहीं है हम बदलते हैं अगर मैं बदल गया मैंने अपने कमरे में एसी चला लिया तो सूरज नहीं बदला वो वही है
says: Fortune/destiny itself does not change; what changes is us and our surroundings. Running an AC in my room does not alter the sun, which stays exactly as it was. So any 'change' is on our side, not in the underlying fate.
ambiguity: Caption word 'भाग' is most likely भाग्य (fate/luck), but could literally be 'part/portion'; the first clause is also cut off ('बदल दिया लेकिन').
classical_check: Classical texts allow shanti and remedies to soften karma-phala; the 'remedy only changes how you meet fate, never fate itself' stance is Gautam's own school view, so it differs from the softer BPHS position.

hindi: इसलिए भाग बदलना एक ऐसी क्रिया है जिस क्रिया के अंतर्गत हम मान सकते हैं कि अगर नसीब में लिखा है कि यह आंखें ऐसे ही चलेंगी कमजोर हो गई तो क्या करें चश्मा लगाओ भाग बदल गया
says: What people call changing fate is just an action taken inside fate: if destiny says the eyes will weaken, you put on spectacles and people say fate has changed. He uses eyesight only as an everyday illustration, not as a chart reading or a medical statement.
ambiguity: The 'fate has changed' phrase is ironic: he means it only looks changed, as the next sentence shows.
classical_check: Silent in BPHS on this framing; the spectacles analogy is his own.

hindi: कुछ बदला धेला भी नहीं बदला जिंदगी वही है जो पत्थर जितनी दूर पड़ा था वही है जो होना है वो होना है जो गड्ढा था वही चश्मा लगा के दिख गया
says: With the spectacles nothing real changed, not even a paisa: life is the same, the stone lies exactly where it lay, and what is to happen will happen. The pothole was always there and the glasses only made it visible, so a remedy gives awareness and a safer path rather than a different event.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with the 'remedy as a lamp in the dark' idea found in some later astrology commentary but not stated in BPHS.

hindi: तो आप अपने जीवन के अंदर बेहतरी कैसे लाएंगे सर्वप्रथम आपकी ह्यूमन कॉन्शसनेस में बहुत शक्ति है आपके अंदर यह कॉन्फिडेंस होना चाहिए अहम ब्रह्मास्मि
says: To improve life, the first step is to recognise that human consciousness holds great power, and you must carry the confidence of 'Aham Brahmasmi' (I am Brahman). Confidence in oneself is the base of every improvement he will suggest.
classical_check: Aham Brahmasmi is Upanishadic (Brihadaranyaka), not a Jyotish rule; classical astrology texts are silent on it.

hindi: कॉन्फिडेंस के लिए आप साथ लेकर के चलेंगे किसी ना किसी अपने पसंदीदा ईश्वर को इसका जो स्वाभाविक ईश्वर है वह है हनुमान इसके लिए हमारा प्रमुख देवता है हनुमान हनुमान वो देवता है जो कॉन्फिडेंस लेकर आता है
says: For confidence, keep some favourite deity as a constant companion; the natural deity for confidence is Hanuman, who is the god that brings confidence. This is stated as a remedy, with Hanuman as the main deity for it.
ambiguity: At this point he names no planet; the Hanuman = Mars link comes in the next sentences.
classical_check: Hanuman worship for courage is popular tradition (Tuesday); BPHS does not name Hanuman as a remedy deity.

gist: Popular story that Hanuman fetched Sita back for Ram, which he reads as Hanuman bringing feminine energy to male masculinity; used only as colour for the Hanuman point.

hindi: तो वो हनुमान कौन है वह हम ज्योतिषीय संदर्भ में यदि कहे तो वह है मंगल ग्रह
says: In astrological terms Hanuman is the planet Mars. So the confidence-giving deity of the previous sentences maps to Mars, which makes Mars the planet of confidence in his scheme.
classical_check: Hanuman = Mars is a popular remedial equation (Tuesday worship); classical presiding deities of Mars are other figures (for example Skanda/Agni), and BPHS is silent on Hanuman.

hindi: मंगल ग्रह की कॉन्शसनेस कहां रहती है नाभि पर यह नाभि है जहां मंगल ग्रह रहता है
says: Mars's seat of consciousness in the body is the navel; the navel is where Mars lives. This is a body-map claim placing Mars at the navel centre.
classical_check: BPHS kalapurusha does not assign the navel to Mars; the navel/Manipura-fire link to Mars (or Sun) comes from later chakra-planet schemes, so classical text is silent.

hindi: मंगल क्या है अग्नि आग
says: Mars is agni, fire. This is the nature he gives the planet, from which the navel-fire idea follows.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts class Mars as fiery (agneya) in nature and element.

hindi: यह 4 पर अग्नि का स्रोत है जहां से हम मां के गर्भ से प्लेसेंटा के द्वारा जुड़कर के जन्म लेने लायक हुए
says: This spot is the source of fire, the point through which we were joined to the mother by the placenta in the womb until we became fit to be born. So the Mars fire sits where the umbilical connection was.
ambiguity: Caption says '4 पर' (on 4); most likely a garble of 'नाभि पर' (at the navel) given the placenta context, but it could also be read as a fourth house or sign, which is the mother/womb place classically.
classical_check: Silent; the 4th house as mother is classical, but navel as fire source is not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: तो सर्वप्रथम यदि आपका कॉन्फिडेंस डाउन है तो के नीचे आपका जो बृहस्पति और शनि का स्थान है कुंडलिनी का वो वहीं पड़ी रहेगी
says: If your confidence is down, kundalini stays lying in the zone below the navel, which he assigns to Jupiter and Saturn. Low confidence keeps the energy parked in that Jupiter-Saturn region of the body.
ambiguity: The reference point before 'के नीचे' is missing in the caption; it is most likely the navel (Mars) from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Silent in BPHS; Jupiter-Saturn placement of kundalini is Gautam's own body-planet map.

hindi: लोग कहते हैं कुंडलिनी जागृत करनी है कुंडलिनी जागृत करनी है वो साला नीचे ही पड़ा रहता है सब कुछ सारी शक्ति नीचे रहती है व्यक्ति सेक्स के चक्र में फंसा रहता है माया के चक्र में फंसा रहता है
says: People keep saying they want to awaken kundalini, but all the power stays in the lower zone and the person remains trapped in the cycle of sex and the cycle of maya (worldly illusion). His complaint is that awakening is talked about while the energy never rises.
ambiguity: He does not name the planets in this sentence; Jupiter and Saturn are inferred from the preceding sentence about their zone.
classical_check: Silent in BPHS; kundalini stages belong to tantra, not Parashari Jyotish.

hindi: इसके नीचे यूरेनस नेप्चून प्लूटो है डर के भय के परेशानी के चक्र में और मौत मौत मौत प्यार की मौत पैसे की मौत रिश्तों की मौत हर किसम की प्रोजेक्ट की मौत होती है
says: Below that zone sit Uranus, Neptune and Pluto, the cycle of fear, dread and trouble, and of repeated 'deaths': death of love, of money, of relationships, of every kind of project. 'Death' here means endings and losses of those things, not physical death.
ambiguity: 'इसके नीचे' could mean below the Jupiter-Saturn zone or below the navel; he lists them as the lowest layer. The word 'मौत' is figurative (loss/ending of love, money, relationships, projects).
classical_check: Classical Jyotish has no outer planets (Uranus, Neptune, Pluto), so this is outside BPHS entirely.

hindi: इसके ऊपर उठने के लिए जरूरी है सर्वप्रथम कॉन्फिडेंस कॉ हमें खुद नहीं आता
says: To rise above these lower layers, confidence is the first requirement, and it does not come to us by ourselves. This sets up the need for outside help.
ambiguity: Caption has a stray 'कॉ' that looks like a garble of 'जो' (which); read as 'confidence, which does not come to us on our own'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कॉन्फिडेंस को देने के लिए हमें कौन चाहिए कोई गुरु अब गुरु कौन है गुरु वो वाला गुरु नहीं है कि बैठ कर के धोती पहन रखी है आशीर्वाद दे रहा है घंटी बजा रहा है
says: To get this confidence we need a guru, but not the ritual figure sitting in a dhoti, giving blessings and ringing a bell. He rejects the conventional priest or guru image as the answer.
ambiguity: 'गुरु' is also the name of Jupiter, but here it plainly means a human guide, not the planet.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कोई अच्छी राय दे दे जो आपको गाइडेंस दे सके जो आपको पंप करके कहे अरे बैठा हूं मैं ऊपर उठ जैसे मर्जी आप चलो जिसके भरोसे पर आप भरोसा कर सको क्योंकि खुद पर तो भरोसा है नहीं
says: The guru he means is anyone who gives good advice and guidance, pumps you up by saying 'I am here, rise and go your way', and whom you can trust, because you do not yet trust yourself. The test of this guide is trust, not ritual status.
classical_check: Silent; guru as Jupiter karaka is classical but he is describing a human mentor.

hindi: खुद पर भरोसा करने वाले व्यक्ति में कॉन्फिडेंस बहुत जबरदस्त होता है
says: A person who has trust in himself carries tremendous confidence. This is the goal state the borrowed trust from a guide is meant to produce.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Ramayana episode: Jambavan reminded Hanuman he had great powers, and Hanuman then made the leap across the sea; used as an example of confidence given by another.

hindi: खुद पर भरोसा नहीं हो तो मनुष्य व्यर्थ है इसीलिए हम किसी दूसरे के थ्रू खुद पर भरोसा करना सीख ले
says: Without self-belief a human being is of no use, so if you cannot trust yourself directly, learn that trust through someone else. Borrowed trust is accepted as the route to self-trust.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो कृष्ण को ले लो राम को ले लो हनुमान को ले लो कोई तो साथ लेकर चलो जिसके द्वारा यह गति बन सके मिल सके अन्यथा दुर्गति होती है
says: Take Krishna, Ram or Hanuman, but take someone along as a companion through whom forward movement (gati) can come; otherwise the result is durgati, a bad or miserable state. This is a remedy: adopt a chosen deity as a daily support.
ambiguity: 'दुर्गति' means a wretched condition or downfall, not death.
classical_check: Ishta-devata worship is traditional; BPHS is silent on this specific framing.

hindi: हमारे जीवन के अंदर जो भी काम हम कर रहे हैं उसमें हमारे लिए सबसे पहले इस खोपड़ी ह्यूमन कॉन्शसनेस को शुद्ध होना जरूरी है तो हमें हर किस्म के वहम और सपे से निकलना है
says: In whatever work we do, the first requirement is that the skull, meaning human consciousness, be purified, so we must get out of every kind of delusion and (garbled word) thinking. Clean thinking comes before any action or remedy.
ambiguity: 'सपे' is garbled; probably 'शक' (doubt) or 'सपनों' (dreams), but the exact word cannot be recovered.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हमारी इस खोपड़ी में सारा दिन रात वहम फसे रहते हैं यह वहम मारते हैं
says: Our head is stuck with delusions (vahm) day and night, and these delusions strike or hurt us. He treats vahm as a constant condition of the untrained mind.
ambiguity: 'वहम मारते हैं' could be 'hit/harm us' or 'kill (our progress)'; taken as harm, not literal death.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इन वहम के अंतर्गत हमारे ही ग्रह ऐसे होते हैं जो हमें वहमी बनाते हैं
says: Behind these delusions it is our own planets: some of them are such that they make us delusional. The tendency to worry or mislead oneself is placed in the birth chart, not in character alone.
ambiguity: He does not say which planets cause vahm in this sentence.
classical_check: Classical texts link the Moon, Mercury and Rahu or afflicted 5th house with confusion of mind, but he names none here.

gist: List of the usual moral lectures parents give a child: speak the truth, do not get angry, that is a bad thing, respect elders, you should study and understand.

hindi: अब आप मान समझ के चले जो जो व्यक्ति एक पुतला है ग्रहों के द्वारा बनाया हुआ मान लेते हैं आप धीरे-धीरे समझेंगे इसके विस्तार में समय आते-आते
says: Take it as a working assumption that every person is a puppet built by the planets; the detail will come gradually as the course goes on. This is his basic model: behaviour comes from planetary make-up.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with the classical view that the birth chart shows innate nature and karma, though stated more deterministically.

hindi: किसी व्यक्ति के बृहस्पति में एक दोष है बृहस्पति का वक्र है वक्री क्या होता है इसकी बात करेंगे हम यह दोष होता है एक किस्म का जब जन्म पर पैदा हुआ उस व्यक्ति का कंसंट्रेशन उड़ाई हुआ होगा
says: Suppose a person's Jupiter is retrograde (vakri), which he calls a kind of defect (dosha), to be explained later. A person born with it will have blown-away, scattered concentration.
cells_derived_method: He states it for retrograde Jupiter in any house and sign. Concentration is a mind and learning matter, so the area where it shows depends on the house Jupiter holds (5th learning, 4th mind-peace, 10th work focus), and the sign colours how.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: retrograde Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius in the 5th house (lagna Leo); scattered attention shows in study, exams and learning.
Derived, not said by him: retrograde Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries); strong planet but a restless inner mind, so focus is disturbed by home and emotional surroundings.
Derived, not said by him: retrograde Jupiter in its own sign Pisces in the 10th house (lagna Gemini); attention scatters across work tasks and the person finds it hard to stay on one career line.

ambiguity: Caption 'बृहस्पति का वक्र है' read as 'Jupiter is vakri (retrograde)'. 'उड़ाई हुआ' read as 'blown away'.
classical_check: Differs: BPHS and Phaladeepika treat a retrograde planet as strong (cheshtabala), not as a defect; poor concentration from retro Jupiter is not a classical rule.

hindi: अब उसको डंडे मार लो उसके ट्यूशन लगा लो उसकी ऐसी तैसी फैर लो वो बच्चा नहीं पड़ेगा उसकी कंसंट्रेशन उड़ी हुई है जब तक उसका बृहस्पति ठीक नहीं करोगे उसे मत समझाओ उसका बृहस्पति ठीक करो
says: Beating, tuitions or scolding will not make such a child study, because his concentration is blown away; until his Jupiter is corrected do not lecture him, correct his Jupiter instead. The 'beat him' phrase is rhetorical, not advice. This is a remedy claim: treat the planet, not the child's behaviour.
ambiguity: 'ठीक करो' (fix Jupiter) does not say how; the gemstone method comes later in the batch.
classical_check: Silent; graha-shanti for Jupiter is classical, but the claim that tutoring fails until Jupiter is fixed is his own.

gist: Analogy of a doctor who finds a kidney problem and wants to beat the patient for drinking, but the patient says he is a teetotaller (a Sufi), so the stick is cancelled.
Joke continues: the doctor says it must be stress since there is no liquor to blame, which is a big problem for him; the point is that the real cause must be treated, not the assumed one.

hindi: तो उस बच्चे को मत समझाओ अपनी खोपड़ी मत खराब करो उसे समझाने में कि बेटा तुझे पढ़ना चाहिए अरे उसकी समझ का बटन ही बंद है
says: So do not waste your own head trying to persuade such a child that he should study: his 'understanding button' is simply switched off. Explaining cannot work on a faculty that is not working.
ambiguity: This follows the Jupiter-defect discussion, so the switched-off comprehension is attributed to Jupiter by context, not named in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter as karaka of intellect and learning is classical, but the 'button off' claim is his.

hindi: यदि बृहस्पति वक्री है तो बहस करेगा इतना तेज चिल्लाएगा
says: If Jupiter is retrograde the child will argue back and shout very loudly. Retro Jupiter shows as combative, noisy debating in a growing child.
cells_derived_method: He says it for retrograde Jupiter without a house or sign. The house decides where the arguing shows (2nd speech and family, 9th beliefs and elders, 3rd siblings and communication) and the sign decides the style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: retrograde Jupiter in its own sign Pisces in the 2nd house (lagna Aquarius); loud arguing at the family table and in everyday speech.
Derived, not said by him: retrograde Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 9th house (lagna Scorpio); argues over beliefs and rules with father, teachers and elders.
Derived, not said by him: retrograde Jupiter in Gemini in the 3rd house (lagna Aries); the arguing runs through talk, messages and quarrels with siblings.

classical_check: Classical texts treat retrograde Jupiter as strong, not as combative; this reading is his own.

hindi: प्यारा बेबी था जब तक तुम्हारा गुलाम था तुम उसकी शुश पोटी धोते थे रोटी खिलाते थे वो गुलाम था अब नहीं करेगा अब उसका बृहस्पति ऑन हो गया है बृहस्पति होता है गुरु मैं ही गुरु हूं
says: While the child depended on you for cleaning and feeding he was a sweet obedient baby, almost your slave; now his Jupiter has switched on, and since Jupiter means guru, he thinks 'I am the guru', so he will no longer obey. As Jupiter activates with growth, obedience gives way to self-assertion.
ambiguity: No age is given for when Jupiter 'switches on'; it is implied to be around the teen years, but he does not say.
classical_check: Jupiter as guru and karaka of wisdom is classical; the age-based switching-on idea is not in BPHS.

hindi: और उसका गुरु वक्री है मींस बिगड़ा हुआ वो आपका का खून कर देगा बहस कर कर के
says: Since the child's guru (Jupiter) is retrograde, which he calls spoiled, the child will wear the parent down with endless arguing. 'Khoon kar dega' is hyperbole for exhausting or destroying the parent's peace, not a prediction of violence.
ambiguity: 'खून कर देगा' is figurative; it must not be read as a harm prediction.
classical_check: Differs from classical treatment: he equates retro with 'spoiled', whereas classical texts call retro planets strong.

hindi: और यदि बुद्ध में वकृत्व है तो बच्चा ही थप्पड़ मार देगा
says: If Mercury is retrograde (vakritva), the child may actually slap the parent. So retro Mercury is tied to impulsive physical lashing out at the parent.
cells_derived_method: He states it for retrograde Mercury in any house and sign. The house decides who the reaction is aimed at and the sign decides the temper, so the examples differ by life area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: retrograde Mercury in Virgo (own and exalted sign) in the 3rd house (lagna Cancer); sharp impulsive hand and tongue reactions, often towards siblings or close family.
Derived, not said by him: retrograde Mercury in its own sign Gemini in the 5th house (lagna Aquarius); the child himself is clever but acts out impulsively when corrected.
Derived, not said by him: retrograde Mercury in Scorpio (Mars sign) in the 6th house (lagna Gemini); quarrels and disputes tend to turn physical.

ambiguity: 'बुद्ध' is Mercury (बुध), not the Buddha. 'वकृत्व' is read as vakritva (retrogression) by parallel with the Jupiter sentence, but it could be a garble of 'वक्तृत्व' (speech skill).
classical_check: Differs from classical texts: retrograde Mercury is treated as strong in speech and intellect, with no slapping rule.

hindi: यदि सूर्य शनि का दोष साथ हो गया तो बाप को लाथ मार के घर से बाहर निकाल देगा
says: If the Sun-Saturn defect occurs together, the child will kick the father and throw him out of the house. Sun is the father and Saturn is his opposite, so a Sun-Saturn affliction ends in a break with the father.
cells_derived_method: He gives the Sun-Saturn defect without a house or sign. The house decides where the break with father appears (9th father, 4th home, 10th status) and the sign changes the strength of each planet.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in its own sign Aquarius, joined by the Sun, in the 9th house (lagna Gemini); clash with father and elders over beliefs and authority.

Derived, not said by him: Sun and Saturn together in Libra in the 4th house (lagna Cancer). Libra is Saturn's exaltation sign. The Sun is debilitated there, so home becomes the arena, with the father's standing weak against a strong, cold Saturn.
Derived, not said by him: Sun in its own sign Leo with Saturn in the 10th house (lagna Scorpio); conflict centres on status and authority between father and child.

ambiguity: He does not say whether the defect is in the child's chart or the father's; the next sentence suggests the father's chart.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: Sun-Saturn conjunction or aspect is classically a pitri-dosha style affliction and shows friction with the father; the throwing-out outcome is his own.

hindi: अब लोग कहेंगे कितना गंदा व्यक्ति है कितना बुरा बेटा हुआ इनके बेटा बुरा नहीं हुआ वोह बाप की कुंडली के खुद के अंदर ही यदि पितृ दोष है तो बेटा घर से बाहर ही निकालेगा
says: People will call the son rotten, but the son is not bad: if pitri dosha is in the father's own chart, the son will push him out of the house. The cause is placed in the father's chart, not in the son's character.
ambiguity: Planets are inferred from the preceding Sun-Saturn sentence; here he says only 'pitri dosha' with no planets or house.
classical_check: Pitri dosha is classical (Sun afflicted, 9th house factors) but classically it relates to ancestral karma; the specific outcome of the son expelling the father is not in BPHS.

hindi: अब कितनी विचित्र बात है वो बाप बैठ के राम मंदिर हनुमान मंदिर कृष्ण मंदिर जा रहा है वास्तु के उपाय कर रहा है रोते रहो कुछ नहीं होगा वो ग्रहों का खेला है आपको ग्रह सेट करने हैं
says: The father keeps visiting Ram, Hanuman and Krishna temples and doing vastu remedies, but he can cry on, nothing will happen, because this is the play of the planets and the planets are what must be set right. In his view temple visits and vastu fixes do not cure a problem that comes from a planetary defect.
ambiguity: This sits oddly with his earlier advice to keep Ram, Krishna or Hanuman as a companion for confidence; there the deity is for inner strength, here it is dismissed as a cure for planetary trouble.
classical_check: Differs from classical practice, where temple worship and pilgrimage are standard graha-shanti, and mildly inconsistent with his own earlier remedy advice.

hindi: यदि किसी व्यक्ति का ये बताया जाता है कि तेरा नॉर्थ ईस्ट डिस्टर्ब है तो नॉर्थ ईस्ट डिस्टर्ब वाला घर ही वो चूज करेगा क्योंकि बृहस्पति में दोष है
says: Even if a person is told his north-east is disturbed, he will still pick a house whose north-east is disturbed, because of the defect in his Jupiter. This is a vastu-link claim: a Jupiter defect drives the wrong home choice.
cells_derived_method: He ties the north-east (Jupiter's direction) to a Jupiter defect in any house or sign. Home choice is a 4th-house matter, so a defective Jupiter in or near the 4th or 12th (rented or far homes) would make the pattern show most.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: defective Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius in the 4th house (lagna Virgo); the home itself is the arena, so the wrong-north-east pick is likely for the main house.
Derived, not said by him: defective Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 4th house (lagna Libra); strongest version, poor judgement on property and a tendency to accept flawed homes.
Derived, not said by him: defective Jupiter in its own sign Pisces in the 12th house (lagna Aries); the wrong north-east shows in rented, distant or foreign accommodation.

ambiguity: 'बृहस्पति में दोष' is not specified (retrograde, afflicted or debilitated), but the preceding sentences use retrograde Jupiter.
classical_check: North-east as Jupiter's direction (Ishan) is classical vastu; the claim that a Jupiter defect makes you choose such a home is his own.

hindi: उसके नॉर्थ ईस्ट में टॉयलेट हो जाएगा नॉर्थ ईस्ट में स्टोरेज बना देगा उसकी खोपड़ी भारी रहेगी
says: That person's north-east ends up with a toilet or is turned into storage, and his head stays heavy. The home defect and the mental heaviness are described as the same Jupiter problem.
ambiguity: 'खोपड़ी भारी' (heavy head) is figurative for a burdened mind, not a medical statement.
classical_check: Agrees with classical vastu that a toilet or heavy storage in the north-east is a defect; the Jupiter-defect cause is his own addition.

hindi: अब उसके लिए बृहस्पति की ट्रीटमेंट यदि कुंडली के थ्रू जैसे पुखराज पहनाते हैं एग्जांपल अगर उसका ट्रीटमेंट कर दिया जाए तो उसकी खोपड़ी यहां ठीक होगी
says: Treat Jupiter through the horoscope, for example by having him wear a yellow sapphire (pukhraj); if that treatment is done, the person's head or thinking gets corrected. Yellow sapphire is given only as an example of the Jupiter remedy.
ambiguity: 'यहां' (here) in 'खोपड़ी यहां ठीक होगी' points to the head; it is a spoken gesture.
classical_check: Gem wearing for Jupiter is later tradition; BPHS lists gem donation within graha-shanti but does not give the claim that a stone fixes this behaviour, and wearing a gem for a retro or afflicted planet is debated.

hindi: और इस खोपड़ी के द्वारा ऑटोमेटिक वो ऐसा घर लेगा जहां नॉर्थ ईस्ट में स्टोरेज नहीं होगी जहां टॉयलेट नहीं
says: Once the head is corrected, the person will automatically choose a home where the north-east has no storage and no toilet. The sentence is cut off in the caption, but the claim is that fixing Jupiter fixes the home choice without any vastu effort.
ambiguity: The sentence is truncated at the end of the slice ('जहां टॉयलेट नहीं ...').
classical_check: Silent; this reverses the usual vastu order by claiming the planet remedy fixes the building choice.

gist: Main point is to fix the beginning (the root) first; everything else is side detail (chole bhature) to be taken up later; this opens his rant on superstition.

hindi: आजकल लोग वहम के शिकार हैं चार नंबर का घर नहीं लेना चाहिए सात नंबर के घर में जेई तई फिर जाती है आठ नंबर परिवर्तनशील है
says: He mocks common house-number (flat or door number) superstitions: never buy a number-4 house, a number-7 house causes some kind of trouble (caption garbled), number 8 is changeable. He presents these as myths people absorb, not as rules he accepts.
ambiguity: He means property or door numbers, not bhava numbers, though 'number 8 is changeable' echoes the 8th-house idea of transformation. The phrase about the number-7 house is garbled.
classical_check: Silent; house-number numerology is not part of classical Parashari Jyotish.

hindi: सोशल मीडिया राहु जिस-जिस की कुंडली में राहु का पंगा है वह सारे कहेंगे मैंने यह सुना मैंने वो सुना
says: Social media belongs to Rahu. People whose Rahu is troubled in the chart are the ones who keep saying 'I heard this, I heard that' and spread rumour-based fears.
cells_derived_method: He says Rahu in general; how the rumour-mania shows would depend on the house Rahu holds (what area of life gets filled with hearsay) and the nature of its sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived (lagna Aries): Rahu in the 3rd house of communication and media, in a communicative sign, would make forwarded messages and social-media chatter the main channel of rumour.
Derived (lagna Leo): Rahu in the 5th house of mind and speculation, in a belief-oriented sign, would make the person absorb borrowed advice, fads and half-heard religious claims.

classical_check: Rahu as foreign, illusory and media-like influence is a modern extension of the classical Rahu karakatva; social media itself is not classical.

gist: Complains that a myth has been planted that your life is hell, then sets up the question of which numbers are auspicious and which inauspicious.
Example of Sharma ji living in a number-8 house where something bad happened, after which neighbours and friends start worrying about their own house number.

hindi: हमारा भी तो बनता है 17 आठ हो गया उनका ए आ है तो वह न बना बी आ है तो 10 बना जिसका एक बनेगा
says: Shows how house-number numerology is done: digits are added and reduced (17 becomes 8 by 1+7), and a letter suffix on the plot changes the sum, for example one case reaching 10 and then 1. His point is that the method is arbitrary.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled around the A and B suffix cases, so the exact sums he gave are not reliable.
classical_check: Silent; digit-sum numerology of house numbers is not in classical texts.

hindi: अगर उन्होंने एक डैश लगा दिया तो अलग झंझट हो गया यह भी चेंज कर दिया नंबर चेंज हो गया यह बहुत कॉम्प्लिकेटेड है वहम के शिकार मत बनो
says: Adding a dash or letter to a house number changes its reduced digit, so the number-based verdict flips again. He calls this too complicated to trust and tells the audience not to become victims of such superstition.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपका घर आठ नंबर का आपकी खोपड़ी खराब हो चुकी है और आपकी कहती है खराब है तो उसके आगे कुछ नहीं करना एक डॉट लगा दो इसी से हो जाएगा
says: If you are already convinced your number-8 house is bad, his fix is trivial: put a dot (a small change) on the number plate and the belief resets. The remedy works by changing the mind's belief, not by changing any planet.
ambiguity: Says dot on the number; unclear whether he means a physical dot on the plate or changing the written number.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own belief-based remedy, not a classical upaya.

gist: Comic example of a patient who fears death and ruin, gets one tablet and one injection from the doctor, and half an hour later laughs off Yamraj and death.

hindi: एक क्षण में मौत देख के एक क्षण में मौत को लात मार देता है देवता है भाई भगवान है भगवान का ही तो स्वरूप है
says: Munna (his pet word for the inner self or mind) is so changeable that it can see death in one moment and kick the fear away in the next. He says this mind is divine, a form of God, so a belief can be reversed instantly.
ambiguity: Munna is not tied to any planet in this passage; it may mean the mind (Moon) or the self generally.
classical_check: Silent; the Moon as manas is classical, but this passage does not name it.

hindi: आपके मुन्ना को कोई डिफेक्टिव ना करे आपका मुन्ना यानी आपका औरों के द्वारा इन्फ्लुएंस होकर यदि डिफेक्ट आता है
says: Do not let anyone make your munna defective. His definition: your munna is you, and the defect arrives when you are influenced by other people's opinions and fears. This is the root cause he wants to guard against.
ambiguity: Sentence continues into the next chunk with the consequence.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपके लाइफ के अंदर सर्वप्रथम आपका मूलाधार खराब होगा मूलाधार यह शनि है अगर आपका शनि खराब हो गया है जो सबसे पहले छड़ता है
says: When outside influence damages your mind, the first thing to go is the Muladhara (root chakra). He equates Muladhara with Saturn, so a spoiled Saturn is the first thing to slip.
ambiguity: The last words 'जो सबसे पहले छड़ता है' are garbled; read as 'the one that slips first'.
classical_check: Chakra-to-planet mapping is not classical Parashari; Saturn as the base and stability karaka fits the idea loosely.

hindi: सबसे डेंजरस प्लेनेट है क्योंकि यह सूर्य का ही बेटा है उसके जैसे ही शक्तिशाली है लेकिन यह एक बार धरती के 30 साल के बराबर समय लेता है सारी राशियों में घूमने में
says: Saturn is the most dangerous planet because, as the Sun's son, it is as powerful as the Sun. Its trip through all twelve signs takes about 30 earth years, so its punishment is spread over very long stretches of time.
ambiguity: 'Most dangerous' is his own ranking, not a measured claim.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is Surya putra and its zodiac cycle is about 29.5 years (roughly 2.5 years per sign).

gist: Repeats twice that you must not come under others' influence.

hindi: यह आपकी नाभि थी कॉन्फिडेंस हनुमान कॉन्शसनेस इसके नीचे बृहस्पति आ गया फिर शनि आप नीचे गिर गए यह कुंडलिनी का लास्ट पहरा है
says: Going down the body: the navel is confidence and consciousness (Hanuman), below it comes Jupiter, then Saturn. Falling down to Saturn means you have reached the last layer of the kundalini ladder.
ambiguity: He does not name the planet for the navel in this sentence; from the earlier class it is probably the Sun, which is only an inference. Caption is noisy around Hanuman.
classical_check: Not classical; this is his chakra-planet ladder.

hindi: इसी के साथ प्लूटो आता है पांव के पंजे प्लूटो यही है यमराज और यमराज इसका भाई है मौत ही ले जाएगा मौत तक पहुंचाएगा
says: Pluto sits at the very base along with Saturn; he ties it to the toes of the feet and calls it Yamraj, Saturn's brother, who leads things to the end. This records his karaka claim only; it gives no timing or prediction of anyone's death.
ambiguity: Garbled in places; the claim about death is mythological or general, not a specific prediction.
classical_check: Yama as Saturn's half-brother is Puranic. Pluto as a planet is not classical, so the mapping is his own.

gist: Says again that you should not fall into superstition and starts a list: 'number one is bad...'; the list continues in the next chunk.

hindi: ऐसी कृपा लो कि साला ऑटोमेटिक ठीक हो जाए कृपा या तो भगवान से लो बहुत लंबी प्रक्रिया है नहीं तो गुरु बना वो गुरु घंटाल गलत बता देगा
says: Instead of calling numbers good or bad, take grace so that things fix themselves. Grace comes from God, which is a long process needing many classes; otherwise you pick a guru who may turn out fake and mislead you.
classical_check: Silent; guru-kripa as a remedy is a general devotional tradition.

hindi: नमन करो वाहेगुरु गुरु नानक तब कृपा करते हैं यदि आप सच्चे में शिष्य बनते हैं तो आपकी डेडिकेशन जब तक नहीं होगी रा भी सही नहीं मिलेगी
says: Bow to Waheguru and Guru Nanak; they give grace only if you are a true disciple (he plays on Sikh meaning shishya). Without your own dedication, the energy flowing from the teacher to you will not come through properly.
ambiguity: The word 'रा' is cut; it probably means the flow of energy or grace.
classical_check: Silent; devotional claim, not from Jyotish texts.

hindi: आप लालच से मांग रहे हैं लोभ लालच षड विकार यूरेनस नेप्चून प्लूटो नीचे के चक्र पर आप चले गए
says: If you ask for things out of greed, you have dropped to the lower chakras. Greed, lust for gain and the other six vices (shad vikar) are governed by Uranus, Neptune and Pluto, which he links to the lower centres.
ambiguity: It is not stated which vice belongs to which of the three planets; he treats them as a group.
classical_check: Not classical; the six vices (kama, krodha, lobha, moha, mada, matsarya) are Vedantic and their planet mapping here is his own.

hindi: जैसे ही लोभ लालच माया मोह किया उसी समय आप इंद्र वरुण यम नीचे के चक्र पर गए और आपकी कुंडली में जहां जहां बैठे हैं वो पावर पर लेगा
says: The moment you act on greed or attachment, you move into the chakras of Indra, Varuna and Yama (Uranus, Neptune, Pluto), and whichever houses and signs they occupy in your chart take power. If they are well placed, greed gives enjoyment; if badly placed, envy and greed ruin you.
cells_derived_method: He gives only good-versus-bad placement. The area of life hit comes from the classical topic of the house they sit in, and how kindly they behave comes from sign nature, taking his lordship scheme where Scorpio is Uranus, Libra is Neptune and Aquarius is Pluto.

derived_examples.reading: Derived (lagna Aries): Uranus in a sign his scheme gives it, in the 8th house of sudden gains and hidden matters; greed would tend to deliver sudden windfalls, the good case.
Derived (lagna Cancer): Neptune in a sign his scheme gives it, in the 4th house of home and peace; greed or fantasy about property and comforts is cushioned, the milder case.
Derived (lagna Gemini): Pluto in a sign not assigned to it, in the 12th house of loss and expense; greed for material comfort tends to drain money or peace, the bad case.

ambiguity: 'वो पावर पर लेगा' is garbled; read as 'they take the power'. Which placements count as good or bad is not specified.
classical_check: Differs; the classical system has no outer planets, so there is no placement rule for them.

hindi: जाओगे आप बेसिकली षट विकार ऑन कर रहे हो
says: Acting on envy or greed means you are in effect switching on the six vices; that is the mechanism by which an ill-placed Uranus, Neptune or Pluto can wreck you.
ambiguity: Continues the previous sentence from the 16:07 chunk. Caption writes 'शट विकार' for shad vikar.
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: इसलिए हम हमेशा कहते हैं मत कुढ़ो मत लड़ो मत कोसो तू गंदा तू बुरा यह सब बंद करना पड़ेगा
says: His standing don'ts: do not fret, do not fight, do not curse, and do not call others dirty or bad. All of this has to stop, since it feeds the lower vices.
ambiguity: The first word (caption 'सो मत') is garbled; I read it as a don't-fret verb, so one item of the list is uncertain.
classical_check: Silent; this is general conduct advice.

hindi: यह आपके नंबर्स है जिनको नाम दिए गए हैं कौन-कौन से ग्रह का क्या नंबर है जो एक वहम है यह कुंडली में होते हैं अभी हम उस पर आएंगे
says: Each planet has been given a number and a name, and these numbers exist in the chart; people turn this into a superstition. He announces he will explain the planet-number scheme next.
ambiguity: No actual number or planet is given in this sentence.
classical_check: Planet numbers belong to numerology (Chaldean or Indian), not to classical Parashari texts.

hindi: याद करने का सादा तरीका है एक मंत्र सब चिंता गुरु रोके बस शुकराना करो शांत यह हो गया सूर्य एक दो तीन चार पाच हो गए
says: Memory trick for the planet numbers: recite the phrase 'sab chinta guru ro ke bas, shukrana karo shant', where each syllable stands for a planet in order. He says the first is the Sun as number 1, then Moon, Jupiter, Rahu and Mercury carry numbers 2 to 5. That planet-by-planet decoding is mine, not spoken.
ambiguity: The caption does not list the planets, only 'Sun' and the counts 1 to 5. The mapping Moon 2, Jupiter 3, Rahu 4, Mercury 5 is my reading of the mnemonic and matches Indian numerology; Ketu is confirmed as 7 later in this batch.
classical_check: Matches the Indian numerology order Sun 1, Moon 2, Jupiter 3, Rahu 4, Mercury 5, Venus 6, Ketu 7, Saturn 8, Mars 9; this is not a classical Jyotish table.

hindi: आपने बोला मेरा सात नंबर यार यह तो बहुत अशुभ होता है आपका केतु
says: People look at their own planet number and declare it bad with their mind, for example saying 'my number is 7, it is very inauspicious'. Seven is the Ketu number, and he treats that verdict as a self-made belief and not a fact of the chart.
ambiguity: Spans the boundary to the next chunk: 'very inauspicious... is your Ketu'.
classical_check: Ketu as 7 is Indian numerology, not classical; calling Ketu simply inauspicious is also contested in classical texts.

hindi: केतु के साथ की जो वाइब्रेशन आपकी जुड़ी हुई है आपके बॉडी के साथ जो कस्प कर रहे हैं इलेक्ट्रोमैग्नेटिक सिग्नल्स यूनिवर्स में कॉस्मस से
says: Ketu is the planet whose vibration is tied to your body, acting like a receiver that catches electromagnetic signals from the cosmos. When you call that Ketu number bad, you are condemning your own cosmic antenna.
ambiguity: 'कस्प कर रहे हैं' is probably 'capture'; the electromagnetic framing is his own and not testable.
classical_check: Not classical; Ketu as a subtle, psychic and moksha karaka is classical, but the body-antenna idea is his.

hindi: मेरा तो पेट ही इसलिए खराब है मेरे तो सिर में दर्द इसलिए खराब है सबकॉन्शियस माइंड ट्रेंड हो गया यह बिलीफ बन गया
says: When you swear that your stomach trouble or headache exists because of a planet or number, the subconscious mind gets trained and the idea hardens into a belief. He is saying that blaming a planet for ailments creates the problem; this is his psychological claim, not a medical statement.
classical_check: Differs from the classical approach, which does link planets to body parts and ailments; he is deliberately denying that causal route.

gist: Analogy of conditioned reaction: mother-in-law speaks, uncle visits, aunt picks up the baby, and the same triggered reaction switches on each time a stimulus appears.
Joke about a wife who is sure a dog chases her whenever she talks on the phone, so a dog does come each time and the husband is the dog.

hindi: यदि मुझे बिलीफ है राम भला करेंगे तो राम ही करेंगे कृष्ण नहीं करेंगे बस इस टीले वाले बाबा ने मौज करानी है तो वही करेगा क्योंकि मेरी तार जुड़ गई
says: Your belief system decides who helps you: if you believe Ram will do good, only Ram does it, not Krishna; if you believe a particular local baba will bring joy, he will, because your wire got connected to him. Belief picks the channel of grace.
ambiguity: 'टीले वाले बाबा' is a generic reference to a hill-shrine saint, not a named person.
classical_check: Silent; this is a devotional or psychological claim, not from Jyotish texts.

hindi: मानसिकता आपके 12 पर की स्टिमुलेशन के अकॉर्डिंग चलती है और चलाती है इसे कहते हैं बॉडी और माइंड सिंक
says: Definition of body-mind sync: your personal mentality moves according to the stimulation coming from the 12 (houses or planets, caption unclear), and it in turn drives you. A percentage figure is mentioned but is garbled in the caption.
ambiguity: '72 पर' and '12 पर' look like percentages or counts, and the numbers may be wrong captions; the 12 could mean 12 houses or 12 planets.
classical_check: Silent; the 12 houses as drivers of prarabdha is a standard idea, the body-mind sync term is his own.

hindi: आपका माइंड चलता है 12 घरों के द्वारा प्रारब्ध के लिए और आपका 72 प्र योगदान है कि आपकी बॉडी कैसे वाइब्रेट कर रही है आप उससे जुड़ते हैं या नहीं
says: The mind is run through the 12 houses for prarabdha (destiny), which he gives as one share of the outcome, while about 72 percent is your own contribution: how your body vibrates and whether you tune in to it. The numbers are uncertain from the caption.
ambiguity: The percentages (12 and 72) may be garbled; the idea that the houses give the fixed part and your response gives the larger part is clear.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with the classical split of prarabdha and purushartha, but gives no classical percentages.

hindi: आपकी कुंडली कहती है फ्री होकर काम करो आप कहते हो नहीं मैं ज्यादा मेहनत करूंगा आपकी लाइफ में सक्सेस कम हो जाती है
says: Work in the style your chart indicates: if it says do one thing, you shoot up like a rocket; if it says work freely and you force more effort against it, your success drops. Sync yourself to the chart's direction rather than fighting it.
ambiguity: He does not say which chart feature indicates 'work freely' versus 'do the one thing'; it is a general illustration.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts would read such an indication from specific yogas and the 10th house, which he does not cite here.

hindi: ब्लूटूथ और मोबाइल सिंक हो गए तो परमात्मा से कितना बढ़िया कनेक्शन आपका बना यह डिपेंड करेगा कि आप में वहम कितने कम है
says: Body and mind syncing is like a Bluetooth device pairing with a mobile. How good your connection with the divine becomes depends on how few superstitions you carry.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो पहली बात कोई नंबर गंदा अच्छा नहीं है आठ तारीख को जन्म लोग फलाने होते हैं अबे यार
says: First point of the lecture: no number is inherently good or bad. He dismisses claims such as 'people born on the 8th are such-and-such', meaning birth-date numerology, as superstition.
ambiguity: The sentence trails off; it is unclear whether he finishes the claim about the 8th.
classical_check: Silent on birth-date numerology; classical astrology uses the full chart, not the date digit.

hindi: बेवकूफी वाली बातें हैं आपको शनि की सड़ सति ने ठोक दिया राम और रावण के भी हालात वही थे
says: He calls it foolish to blame Saturn's sade sati for a person's troubles, noting that Ram and Ravan faced the same kind of planetary situation yet ended very differently, so the transit alone does not decide the outcome.
cells_derived_method: Sade sati is Saturn transiting the 12th, 1st and 2nd signs from the natal Moon, so which houses from lagna it presses on depends on the Moon's house. The felt result is those house topics x Saturn's nature, modified by chart strength and by the person's own conduct, as he stresses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Aries in the 10th gives Cancer lagna; Saturn passes Pisces, Aries, Taurus, which are the 9th, 10th and 11th houses, so pressure falls on fortune, career and gains in turn.
Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 8th gives Sagittarius lagna; Saturn passes Gemini, Cancer, Leo, the 7th, 8th and 9th houses, so partnership, sudden change and luck are the themes.

ambiguity: Caption does not say whether Ram and Ravan both had sade sati or only similar hardships; unclear if he rejects sade sati itself or only the habit of blaming it.
classical_check: Sade sati is a later popular transit concept; classical texts judge Saturn's transit by chart strength, so a blanket 'sade sati hit you' is not universally supported.

hindi: आपकी कुंडली में इतने गुण मिलते हैं आपका घर सीता माता और राम का कहते हैं 36 मिले थे 36 कभी मिल ही नहीं सकते 35 से ऊपर मिलते नहीं है यह सब बातें हैं
says: He rejects the popular claim that Ram and Sita matched all 36 gunas, saying a perfect 36 can never be found and nothing above 35 occurs in real matching, so such statements are just talk.
ambiguity: Unclear whether he means guna-milan (Ashtakoota) arithmetic can never reach 36, or only that real couples never do.
classical_check: Texts set the Ashtakoota maximum at 36 and do not say it is unreachable; 'never above 35' is his own claim and the Ram-Sita 36 story is folk lore.

gist: Metaphor: life's journey starts in a coal mine with black hands and choking breath, and only a rare person keeps digging until a diamond is found.
Continuing the metaphor: first you meet fake gurus and 'Bengali baba' types, and only later a genuine diamond; keep digging and searching.
Many people reach him after wandering from place to place for ten or more years.

hindi: अब उनके पास ऑप्शन नहीं है हम तो 10 साल से इलाज करा रहे हैं जी सही डॉक्टर नहीं मिला तुम्हारे पास 11वें साल 12वें साल 15वें साल भी कोई ऑप्शन नहीं होगा क्योंकि तुमने अभी तक ह्यूमन कॉन्शियस के साथ जुड़ना सीखा नहीं
says: He says people who claim ten years of treatment without finding the right doctor will still have no option in the 11th, 12th or 15th year, because they have not learned to connect with their 'human conscious'; until they do, things go badly and no benefit comes automatically. This is his mindset teaching, not a chart rule, and no medical statement is made.
ambiguity: 'Human conscious' is his own term and is not defined in this slice; it may mean inner awareness or a collective consciousness.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own consciousness-based framing, not found in classical texts.

hindi: मिलेगा ऑटोमेटिक आप ऐसी बुद्धि के साथ जाओगे कि आपको डॉक्टर ही सही नहीं मिलेगा इसके लिए आपके ऊपर कृपा चाहिए
says: He says that with a clouded intellect a person will not even land on the right doctor or helper, so finding the right guidance needs grace (kripa) on the person; effort and intelligence alone do not guarantee it.
ambiguity: Source of grace is not named here; later in the slice he links it to the chart (how much kripa is on the person) and to faith-related houses.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts speak of purva-punya (5th/9th) but he does not name a house in this sentence.

hindi: इसलिए आप यदि किसी भी हालत के अंदर किसी को भी कोस पीट रहे हो आपकी कुंडली के अंदर उस ग्रह को खराब कर रहे हो
says: He says that cursing or beating down any person, in any circumstance, damages in your own chart the planet that stands for that person; so abusing a relative is spoiling your own planet. This is a do-not (do not curse people) given as a tradition claim.
cells_derived_method: The planet harmed is the significator of the person cursed (father Sun, mother Moon, siblings Mars, spouse Venus or Jupiter, children Jupiter, boss Saturn); the house it sits in and the strength of its sign show which life area absorbs the damage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: cursing the father harms the Sun; with Sun exalted in Aries in the 9th (Leo lagna) the damage would fall on luck, dharma and guidance.
Derived: cursing the mother harms the Moon; Moon in its own sign Cancer in the 4th (Aries lagna) would show the damage as loss of home peace and mental calm.
Derived: cursing a brother harms Mars; Mars in its own sign Aries in the 3rd (Aquarius lagna) would show it as loss of courage and sibling support.

ambiguity: He does not say which planet is harmed for which person; the person-to-planet map is the standard karaka list, supplied here.
classical_check: Classical texts give karakas but not a rule that cursing a person damages the planet; this is his own principle.

gist: 'Number four is dirty, number five is dirty, do not stay in these cycles': cannot tell if this means houses 4 and 5, or labelling people as dirty or bad.
No human is simply good or bad: the same woman can be a lovely daughter, a bad daughter-in-law, a good mother and a bad wife, or the reverse.
Children may call their mother bad; who is good or bad depends on the viewer's mindset, as some say Rama did not listen and Krishna was good; it is each head's own game.

hindi: प्रथम बात बी अवेयर अब यदि आपकी जन्म पत्रिका में ग्रह डिस्टर्ब है कुछ इस प्रकार लगे हुए हैं तो आपको यह जानने के बाद इंप्लीमेंट नहीं होने देगा
says: First be aware: if the planets in your birth chart are disturbed in certain arrangements, then even after you learn the right advice the chart will not let you implement it, so knowing is not the same as doing.
ambiguity: 'Certain arrangements' is not specified here; the next sentences point to Jupiter and to the faith-related combinations.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not frame it as 'cannot implement advice'.

hindi: बृहस्पति के वक्री होने से या डिस्टर्ब या खराब होने से व्यक्ति किसी के बाप की नहीं सुनता
says: When Jupiter is retrograde, disturbed or spoiled in a chart, the person listens to nobody, not even the closest authority; the refusal to take advice is the signature of a damaged Jupiter.
cells_derived_method: The house Jupiter sits in decides whose advice is refused (9th: teachers and father; 4th: mother and home elders; 10th: bosses), and the sign's strength decides how hard the refusal is: own sign or exaltation gives proud certainty, debilitation gives confused resistance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Jupiter in its own sign in the 9th (Aries lagna) would show as refusing guidance from gurus, father and tradition while feeling sure of one's own view.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 4th (Libra lagna) would show as resisting mother and home elders, with muddled reasoning behind it.
Derived: retrograde Jupiter in its own sign in the 10th (Gemini lagna) would show as not accepting instructions from bosses and seniors at work.

ambiguity: He lumps retrograde, disturbed and spoiled together; he does not say how much of the effect is due to retrogression alone versus affliction.
classical_check: Classically Jupiter is the guru and counsel karaka, so an afflicted Jupiter troubling guidance matches; the 'listens to nobody' wording is his own.

hindi: उससे भी तगड़ा कोई कमीना बृहस्पति वाला मिलता है ना उसके आगे झुकता है हां आंसर खत्म हो गया र समझ नहीं आ रहा क्या करें उसे गुरु समझो जो आपकी बोलती आपके अंदर बंद करा दे
says: Such a stubborn person bows only before someone whose Jupiter-type nature is even tougher, and when his own answers run out and he does not know what to do, he should treat that person as his guru, the one who shuts the mouth of his ego.
ambiguity: The caption around 'आंसर खत्म हो गया र समझ नहीं आ रहा' is partly garbled; 'कमीना' is used loosely for a tough, uncompromising person.
classical_check: Silent; this is his practical guidance on recognising a guru, not a classical rule.

hindi: पर यह खम चिल्ली वाली बात होती है ऐसी स्थिति कुंडली में होती है जिसकी इंप्रूवमेंट और करेक्शन की जरूरत है ताकि आप इंप्लीमेंट कर सके
says: He says this inability to take advice is a real condition in the kundli, not mere talk, and it needs improvement and correction (remedial work) so that the person becomes able to implement guidance.
ambiguity: The phrase 'खम चिल्ली' is garbled in the caption and its meaning is a guess; the type of correction is not named here.
classical_check: Classical texts prescribe graha shanti for afflicted planets in general; he names no specific remedy in this sentence.

gist: People who say they heard much advice but cannot implement it are proud, accepting words but doing things their own way; he calls this ego.

hindi: आपकी ईगो को बहुत ज्यादा आपके ही जीवन में अड़ने वाला चिल्ला के बुलवाने वाला यह मेजर प्लेनेट आपका जुपिटर है बृहस्पति
says: He names Jupiter as the major planet behind the ego that obstructs a person's own life and makes them shout to get things said and done; the stubborn, loud pride is traced to Jupiter.
cells_derived_method: The house holding Jupiter shows the area where this ego blocks the person; Jupiter's sign strength shows whether the ego is inflated (own or exalted sign) or defensive (debilitated sign).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 1st (Cancer lagna) would put the ego in self-image and personal authority.
Derived: Jupiter in Virgo in the 7th (Pisces lagna) would put stubborn pride into marriage and partnerships.

ambiguity: He calls it 'major planet' without saying whether it applies only when Jupiter is afflicted or to every Jupiter.
classical_check: Jupiter is classically wisdom and humility, not ego, though an afflicted Jupiter can give pride; this reading is stronger than the texts.

hindi: बृहस्पति अपने आगे किसी की चलने नहीं देता क्योंकि वो गुरु ग्रह है यदि गुरु ही डिस्टर्ब या घातक या खराब हो जाए तो किसी की भी नहीं सुनता वो व्यक्ति
says: He explains why: Jupiter is the guru planet and lets nobody overrule it, so if the guru itself turns disturbed, harmful or spoiled, the person has no one above them to listen to; he adds that there are multiple reasons behind this stubbornness.
ambiguity: 'Multiple reasons' are not listed in this slice.
classical_check: Matches Jupiter as guru karaka; the inward turning of that guru role into stubbornness is his own interpretation.

hindi: इसलिए किसी ग्रह के वक्री हो जाने मात्र से उस ग्रह की पॉइंट्स नेगेटिव होने शुरू हो जाते हैं
says: He states that merely being retrograde makes that planet's points start turning negative in his scoring, so retrogression by itself lowers a planet's result, whichever planet it is.
cells_derived_method: The size of the drop depends on the planet's house and sign: a retrograde planet in a strong sign still has weaker points than direct, while in a debilitated sign or a dusthana house the negative effect compounds.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Jupiter in its own sign in the 5th (Leo lagna) loses points in children, intelligence and merit despite the strong sign.
Derived: retrograde Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 6th (Libra lagna) takes a double reduction, affecting analysis, speech and dealings with rivals and illness matters.
Derived: retrograde Saturn exalted in Libra in the 7th (Aries lagna) gets reduced points in partnership despite exaltation.

ambiguity: 'Points' is not defined here; it may be his own scoring or a general sense of strength.
classical_check: Differs: BPHS gives a retrograde planet extra cheshta bala (strength) and later tradition treats vakri as intensified, not automatically negative.

gist: Transition: 'what does retrograde mean? let us understand this small thing together'.

hindi: किसी व्यक्ति की एक जन्म कुंडली बनाई जाती है जन्म के समय और उस जन्म कुंडली में उस समय का एक स्नैपशॉट होता है कि अंतरीक्ष में राहु केतु मंगल बुध बृहस्पति कहां बैठे थे
says: A birth chart is made for the moment of birth and works as a snapshot of the sky at that time, recording where Rahu, Ketu, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and the others were sitting; all reading proceeds from that snapshot.
ambiguity: He names only some planets as examples; the snapshot covers all of them.
classical_check: Agrees: the nativity is a sky snapshot at birth; Rahu and Ketu are lunar-node points rather than bodies in space, which he glosses over.

hindi: और भैया उसी हिसाब से हम चलेंगे यह ग्रह ही बताते हैं कि यह व्यक्ति नास्तिक होगा आस्तिक होगा मानेगा कि नहीं मानेगा
says: He says the planets in that snapshot tell by themselves whether the person will be an atheist or a believer, and whether he will accept (faith, advice) or not, and that his reading follows from this.
ambiguity: Which planets or houses decide belief is not stated here; the following sentences point to the 9th and the past-life house.
classical_check: Classically faith and dharma are read from the 9th house, Jupiter and the 5th; he does not name them in this sentence.

hindi: हमारे पल्ले जब लोग आते हैं तो सबसे पहले यही मैं देख लेता हूं कि भैया इस पर कृपा कितनी है
says: In his consulting practice, when a client comes, the first thing he checks in the chart is how much grace (kripa) is on that person, before looking at anything else.
ambiguity: How kripa is measured is not given in this sentence; the next sentences suggest the faith and past-life houses.
classical_check: Silent; the nearest classical notions are purva-punya (5th) and bhagya (9th).

hindi: जैसे पिछली क्लास में हमने बात की थी अगर यह वाला भाव प्रथम भाव है यह फिक्स रहता है
says: Recalling the previous class, he sets the box he is pointing at as the first house and says it stays fixed as the reference point, so the other houses are read from it.
ambiguity: He is pointing at a drawn chart not visible in the caption; 'fixed' may mean the lagna box position is fixed in the diagram or that the first house is the fixed starting point.
classical_check: Agrees in general: houses are counted from the lagna as the first house.

hindi: यह पाच छ और यह नौ यह भाग्य का है धर्म में बिलीव करने वाला
says: Pointing at the chart, he says the 9th house is the house of fortune and of belief in dharma, the one that shows whether a person believes in religion.
cells_derived_method: The signs touching the 9th change the flavour of belief: fire signs give zeal and philosophy, earth signs give ritual and practicality, water signs give emotional and secret faith.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius on the 9th (Aries lagna) gives open, devotional and philosophical belief.
Derived: Virgo on the 9th (Capricorn lagna) gives analytical, ritual-checking belief that questions before accepting.
Derived: Scorpio on the 9th (Pisces lagna) gives intense, private or occult-leaning faith.

ambiguity: The caption 'यह पाच छ और यह नौ' is garbled; he may be pointing at the 5th, 6th and 9th boxes, but only the 9th is clearly tied to fortune and dharma.
classical_check: Agrees: the 9th is the house of bhagya and dharma.

hindi: धर्म में बिलीव करने वाला यह पूर्व जन्म का हो गया
says: He says the other box he points to, taken here as the 5th house, represents the past life, the stored merit that decides how faith shows up in this birth.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 5th colours the kind of past-life merit: fire signs give creative or leadership merit, water signs give emotional and spiritual merit, and the sign lord's strength shows how much of it is available.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo on the 5th (Aries lagna) shows past merit in leadership and creativity, with pride as a risk.
Derived: Scorpio on the 5th (Cancer lagna) shows intense, hidden past karma that returns as crises of faith and depth.
Derived: Pisces on the 5th (Scorpio lagna) shows spiritual merit and an inclination to devotion.

ambiguity: He says only 'this one is of the past life'; the caption does not name the house, and the 5th is inferred from the earlier 'पाच' and from classical purva-punya.
classical_check: Agrees if it is the 5th: purva-punya is read from the 5th house.

gist: If a certain combination sits in this box, such combinations will be understood slowly; it is very detailed and intricate.
Remark that many classes are needed to cover the combinations in this area.

hindi: मान लो यह कॉमिनेशन डिस्टर्ब है और वह कॉमिनेशन उसको व्यक्ति को धर्म के प्रति क्या आस्था है ऐसा दिखाता है तो पहले पता लग जाता है
says: If the combination that shows a person's faith in dharma is disturbed in the chart, you can know in advance that the person will lack belief, before he says anything.
cells_derived_method: The faith combination is the 9th house and its lord (and the 5th for past merit); an affliction by Saturn, Rahu or a debilitated planet in those houses, or a weak lord, shows doubt or rejection of dharma, and the sign on the house colours the kind of doubt.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 9th (Leo lagna) would show cold cynicism towards religion and elders.
Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 9th (Libra lagna) would show a restless, unorthodox, argumentative approach to belief.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 5th (Virgo lagna) would show thin past-life merit and a practical, doubting attitude to faith.

ambiguity: 'That combination' refers to the box he was pointing at; the caption does not name it, so the 9th and 5th are inferred from the previous sentences.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: 9th house and Jupiter rule dharma and faith, and their affliction is read as weak belief; the specific afflictors are supplied here.

gist: Consulting anecdote: he tells such a disbelieving client bluntly 'why did you come, you have no belief, you came in vain', and the client is stunned because it is true.
He does not try to give the client belief; the client must give it to himself, and it is up to the consultant how far to push using reverse psychology.

hindi: यदि आप यह जान जाते हैं कि व्यक्ति इस हिसाब से चलेगा नहीं मम्मी पापा लड़ते रहते हैं बेटा काम कर ले काम कर ले उसका काम का ग्रह है ही नहीं हो सकता राज होग बैठे बिठा नोट छापे तो उसको बैठे बिठाए के लायक बनाओ
says: If the chart shows a person will not run along the usual path, and parents keep nagging him to work while he has no planet for work, then do not force it: he may be fated to earn without labour, so prepare him for that instead.
cells_derived_method: The 'work planet' is the 10th house and its lord with Saturn as karma karaka; if these are weak while the 2nd, 5th or 11th houses carry strong planets, income comes through inheritance, speculation-free gains or network rather than daily labour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 10th (Cancer lagna) would mark a weak work planet, with hard routine work not suiting him.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 11th (Virgo lagna) would suggest gains arriving through contacts and blessings with little daily effort.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 2nd (Aries lagna) would suggest family wealth and inherited support carrying him.

ambiguity: The caption 'राज होग बैठे बिठा नोट छापे' is garbled; he means a person who may earn sitting at home, not a promise of wealth. No investment claim is made.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: weak 10th with strong 2nd/11th gives non-labour income; but 'no work planet' is his phrase, not a classical term.

hindi: लेकिन हमारी मानसिकता इसमें लगी हुई है के यार यह तो पढ़ ही नहीं रहा यह कैसे काम करेगा उसको आशीर्वाद दो
says: As a do-and-don't, he says the parent mindset of doubting 'he does not even study, how will he work' is wrong; instead of doubting the child, give him blessings (ashirvad). Offered as a tradition remedy.
ambiguity: The sentence follows a half-heard line; 'उसको आशीर्वाद दो' may be an order to the parent or an example of what parents should do.
classical_check: Silent; a mindset remedy, not found in classical texts.

hindi: हमें यह नहीं पता 24 घंटे एक मां या पिता जो भजन करे जा रहा है ना हाय बच्चा कुछ नहीं करता हाय बेटी कुछ नहीं करती हाय ये सुनती नहीं वो भजन चल रहा है वो उसकी फोटोकॉपीज बन रही है मुन्ना बना रहा है
says: He says a parent who keeps repeating all day that the child does nothing and does not listen is in effect chanting a bhajan; this chant produces photocopies, so the child turns into exactly what the parent keeps saying. Offered as a tradition claim about words and outcomes.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना बना रहा है' is loosely captioned; it is read as 'he is making the child into a copy'.
classical_check: Silent; this is his mind-and-speech principle, not a classical rule.

gist: Example repeating the same point: the mother wails to her husband that strife is going on at home, and her inner turmoil has turned into the very words she speaks, such as 'the son does not listen'.

hindi: अरे यार बहु तो बहुत ही बुरी है यार बहुए होती ही बुरी है आपको बुरी ही मिलेगी आपकी ह्यूमन कॉन्शियस अविश्वास करती है तो आपको बुरा व्यक्ति ही मिलेगा अच्छे व्यक्ति को आप खुद ही नहीं मिलोगे
says: He says that someone who keeps declaring daughters-in-law are all bad will be given a bad one: a distrusting human conscious attracts bad people, and the good ones will not even cross your path. Offered as a tradition claim about mindset and what one attracts, not a chart rule.
ambiguity: 'Human conscious' is his own undefined term; he does not tie this to the 7th house or any planet here.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts read a daughter-in-law through the son's chart, not through the mother-in-law's speech.

hindi: इसलिए सर्वप्रथम है कि आपके मानसिकता में विश्वास होना चाहिए और विश्वास के मुद्दे के लिए बहुत जरूरी है कि कहीं झुकना सीखो
says: As the first remedy, he says belief must be present in your mindset, and for faith to grow it is essential to learn to bow before someone or something; humility comes first. Offered as a tradition remedy.
ambiguity: He does not say before whom to bow; the Jupiter and guru theme earlier in the slice suggests a guru or teacher.
