classical_check: Silent; classical remedies for Jupiter include respect to gurus and elders, which is close but not stated here.

gist: Satire on people who bow and then demand payment for having bowed: 'Guruji, we respect you so much, so now take our respect' as if respecting the guru were a favour.
People show respect to someone only because they want something back; he calls that useless and not real respect.
Sentence breaks off: you must stay in your own dignity, 'for this...' with no continuation in this slice.

hindi: आपको रिलाइज करना है कि आपके जन्म के समय जो कुंडली आपकी बनी है वह कुंडली के ग्रह आपको डिस्टर्ब कर रहे हैं
says: He wants the listener to realise that the trouble in their life is caused by the planets of the chart formed at their moment of birth, not by outside agents.
classical_check: Agrees in general with the classical view (BPHS) that natal planets shape what a person experiences; no specific rule is given.

gist: Says the 27 nakshatras and the rashi from name letters are taught in his classes and available online, so he will not go into them here.

hindi: हम यह मान के चल रहे हैं आपने ज्योतिष सीखा कि नहीं सीखा अगर आपकी कुंडली अलाव नहीं करती ज्योतिष बनना तो बन भी नहीं सकते इसलिए माथा मारने की जरूरत नहीं है
says: If your own chart does not permit you to become an astrologer, you cannot become one however much you study, so there is no point straining over it.
ambiguity: No planet, house or yoga is named; 'अलाव' is his word for what the chart permits.
classical_check: Silent: no yoga, planet or house is named, so there is nothing to compare.

gist: Anecdote that many people came to him over the years and set up industries which were in their own destiny; he guided them but could not set up his own because his chart has no such yoga.

hindi: भैया तुम तो जो सी हो तुमने क्यों नहीं अपनी लाइफ का भला किया भैया हमने उतना ही भला किया जो तुम्हें दिख नहीं रहा लेकिन वही कर सकते हैं जो कुंडली अलाव करेगी
says: Answering the objection 'if you are an astrologer why have you not fixed your own life', he says an astrologer too can do only what his own chart permits, and the good he did is simply not visible to others.
ambiguity: The word 'जो सी' in the objection is garbled (likely 'ज्योतिषी').
classical_check: Fate-bound claim; classical texts do not state it as a rule, so silent.

hindi: अगर हम ऐसे ही कर लेते तो राम ही सब बदल लेते कृष्ण ही सब कुछ बदल लेते रावण तो महान प्रतापी था य ऐसे ही दो जिन्नात भेजता टोने करता टोटके करता रूम फट स्वाहा राम खत्म क्यों
says: Argument that destiny cannot be bent by will or black magic: if it could, Rama and Krishna would have changed everything, and the mighty Ravana with jinn, tona and totka would have finished Rama; he did not, so such methods do not override the chart.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the chunk edge; the answer 'it did not happen' follows in the next chunk.
classical_check: Not a Jyotish rule, the Ramayana is used as an argument. Classical texts do prescribe mantra, dana and puja remedies, so his rejection targets only popular tantra and totka practices.

hindi: नहीं हुआ क्योंकि यह व्यर्थ की बातें है यह बात हम पहले भी कर चुके हैं
says: Gives the answer to the Ravana question: tantra, jinn and totka practices are useless things, a point he says he has already covered in earlier videos.
classical_check: Differs from popular totka practice; classical texts are silent on tantra as a way to change fate.

gist: Rhetorical argument that if jinn, ghosts and tantrik babas worked, Hamas would have destroyed Israel by throwing skulls from cremation grounds and Biden and Trump would sit with tantriks instead of fighting elections.

hindi: इसलिए यह जो व्यर्थ की बातें हैं इसमें नहीं उलझना है आपकी खुद की ह्यूमन कॉन्शियस डिसाइड करेगी आपके लिए आप कौन से पोर्टल से क्या रिसी वेबल ले रहे हो
says: Advises not to get tangled in tantra and totka; he says your own human consciousness decides what you receive and through which channel, using a portal and receivable metaphor.
ambiguity: The portal and receivable wording is a garbled metaphor and could mean which source or teacher you take guidance from.
classical_check: Not a Jyotish rule; general advice, so classical texts are silent.

hindi: और वह खुद नहीं ले पा रहे किसी की मदद ले लो राम ने भी केवट की मदद ली नैया पार लगाने के लिए लेकिन उसका मेहनताना सीता की अंगूठी दी
says: If you cannot manage on your own, take help from someone; even Rama took the boatman's help to cross the river and paid him with Sita's ring, so such help should be paid for.
ambiguity: 'वह खुद नहीं ले पा रहे' has no clear subject because of the caption.
classical_check: Not a Jyotish rule; a Ramayana analogy for seeking and paying a guide.

hindi: फ्री सेवा के चक्कर में कभी मत रहो ज्ञान लो पैसे नहीं देने प्रेम दो वह भी एक ऊर्जा है
says: Never chase free service; every exchange needs energy, and if you take knowledge without paying money, give love, because love is also a form of energy.
ambiguity: 'ज्ञान लो पैसे नहीं देने' could mean 'take knowledge but do not pay' or 'take knowledge and money need not be given'; the sense is that something must be given back.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish texts; similar in spirit to the dakshina custom of rewarding a teacher or astrologer.

gist: Says money is not everything; people who keep earning excessively leave a lot behind at death, and beyond a limit money gives punishment, not pleasure.
Says beyond a limit even husband and wife punish each other, and that this much love is enough.

hindi: पहले तो तू य माथा प लिखा ले श्री राम तू भगवान है तू ठीक करेगा उनसे अपना भी ना हुआ उन्हो को भी वही करना पड़ा जो उनके ग्रह चाहते थे
says: Even Shri Ram, a god, could not set his own life right and had to do what his planets wished, so no ordinary person should think he can set everything right for others.
ambiguity: The opening words 'let me fix it, let me fix it' are garbled and the exact target of the fixing is unclear.
classical_check: Philosophical claim; classical Jyotish texts are silent on it as a rule.

hindi: इसलिए दूसरों को समझाने का प्रयास दूसरे को ठीक कर दू यह मूर्खता है खुद को करो खुद पर काम करो खुद के राहु के त सेट करो
says: Trying to explain things to or fix other people is foolishness; work on yourself and set your own Rahu in order (the word after Rahu is cut off).
ambiguity: 'राहु के त सेट करो' is garbled; likely 'tune' or 'taar' set, meaning to put Rahu's pull in order, but the caption does not show it.
classical_check: Classical Rahu remedies are mantra, dana and Durga worship; self-work as a way of setting Rahu right is his own framing.

hindi: आपकी जन्मपत्रिका में यह खाने होते हैं 12 खाके होते हैं यह 360 डिग्री की गोलाई है अंतरिक्ष के अंदर इसके लिए य 12 हिस्से बने हुए हैं
says: The birth chart has 12 boxes (khane); they stand for the 360° circle of the sky around the earth, which is divided into 12 parts.
ambiguity: 'Boxes' could mean houses or signs; he treats them as the 12 divisions of the 360° circle.
classical_check: Agrees: 12 divisions of 30° each make the 360° zodiac.

hindi: अब 360 डिग्री में हर दो घंटे का मोटे तौर पर 12 दुनी 24 घंटे मोटे तौर पर क्योंकि धरती ऐसे गोल नहीं घूमती धरती ऐसे घूमती है अंडा तो इसके अंदर कोई ज्यादा कोई कम छोटा कोई बड़ा चलता है
says: Each sign (lagna) lasts roughly two hours, 12 x 2 = 24 hours, but only roughly, because the earth is egg-shaped and does not spin like a perfect ball, so some signs take longer and some shorter.
cells_derived_method: Not house or sign specific in his words. Classically the rising time differs by sign and latitude, so a lagna with a short rising time flips sooner when the birth time is off by a few minutes; he gives no per-sign figure.
classical_check: Agrees that signs take unequal time to rise (ascensional times differ by sign and latitude); his egg-shaped-earth reason is not the classical one (obliquity of the ecliptic and latitude).

hindi: प्लेनेट डिग्री वाइज घूमता है सूरज चल रहा है यह 12 बजे य होगा 12 बज गए फिर ये ऊपर आया टक टक टक लगन नीचे को जा रहा है चेंज हो रहा है क्योंकि धरती ऐसे घूमती है
says: Planets move through the circle degree by degree; the Sun comes to the top of the sky at 12 noon, and meanwhile the lagna keeps shifting and changing because the earth rotates.
ambiguity: He is pointing at a drawn diagram, so 'top' and 'down' are gestures; the caption does not say which house is the top.
classical_check: Agrees with basic astronomy: the lagna runs through all 12 signs in about 24 hours as the earth rotates, and the Sun is at the upper meridian near noon.

hindi: जोडियक ऐसे पड़ा हुआ है एंटी क्लॉक वाइज घूमते हैं क्लॉक वाइज घूमते हैं कुछ ग्रह हम एंटी क्लॉक वाइज घूमते हैं तो ये आपका पीछे को जा रहा है
says: Describes the layout of the zodiac on the chart and says things move anticlockwise (with a mention of clockwise motion for some planets), so the sign order on the chart looks as if it is going backwards.
ambiguity: Clockwise and anticlockwise are used for different things and the caption is garbled; cannot tell which motion he assigns to planets, signs or the earth.
classical_check: Silent; the standard North Indian chart counts houses anticlockwise from the lagna.

hindi: इसलिए एक दो तीन चार ऐसे नहीं है एक दो तीन आगे को होना चाहिए दो तीन चार तो ये पीछे को क्यों है ये पीछे नहीं है इसका सीधा यही है क्योंकि ऐसे ही घूमता है ईस्ट टू वेस्ट
says: Asked why the chart's numbers 1, 2, 3, 4 seem to run backward, he says it is not backward; the reason is simply that the sky turns from east to west.
ambiguity: Whether he means house numbers or sign numbers is not clear from the caption.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard layout; the order follows the signs as they rise. The classical reason is the eastward order of the zodiac, so his explanation is loose but workable.

hindi: आपका यहां पर सुबह का टाइम है यह 12 बजे का टाइम है यह शाम 6:00 बजे का टाइम है यह आधी रात 12 बजे का टाइम है तो यह आपका सुबह से शाम दोपहर से रात
says: Assigns times of day to points on the chart circle (morning here, 12 noon here, 6 pm here, midnight here), so the 12 signs carry the whole day's sky as the cosmic planets go round all day; the caption does not say which house each time sits at.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's house follows the time of birth: about sunrise the 1st, noon the 10th, sunset the 7th, midnight the 4th. For any such pair the lagna is sign number minus house number plus 1, so the same time of day gives a different lagna for each Sun sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: a birth around sunrise puts the Sun in the 1st house; with the Sun in Taurus that gives lagna Taurus, the Sun and lagna sharing a sign.
Derived, not said by him: a birth around noon puts the Sun in the 10th house; with the Sun in Aries the lagna at noon is lagna Cancer.
Derived, not said by him: a birth around sunset puts the Sun in the 7th house; with the Sun in Leo the lagna at sunset is lagna Aquarius.
Derived, not said by him: a birth around midnight puts the Sun in the 4th house; with the Sun in Scorpio the lagna at midnight is lagna Leo.

ambiguity: His pointing gestures are lost in the caption; the standard mapping (sunrise 1st, noon 10th, sunset 7th, midnight 4th) is assumed in the derived examples, not stated by him.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard mapping of Sun-time to houses.

hindi: अब इसमें जब ग्रह घूमा तो ये 30 डिग्री है
says: Begins the degree lesson: when a planet moves through one box of the chart it covers 30°, so every sign is 30° wide.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the chunk edge.
classical_check: Agrees: each sign spans exactly 30° of the zodiac.

gist: Announces that today he will settle the 'ishta' (personal deity) question, joking that people used to ask about ishq (love) and now ask only about ishta.

hindi: आपका 30 डिग्री का हर खाना है 30 डिग्री अब कोई बच्चा मान लो सुबह 6 बजे पैदा हो गया तो उसका ना लगन एक्चुअली यहां है 3 डिग्री का लगन है
says: Each box is 30°; in his illustration a child born at 6 am has the lagna at only about 3° of the rising sign, so a lagna has a degree within its sign, not just a sign name.
cells_derived_method: none; the lagna degree set here is used in the later rows to decide which planets fall in the 1st versus the 12th house.
ambiguity: The 6 am and 3° figures are illustrations, not a rule for a real birth.
classical_check: Agrees: the lagna is a degree (the ascendant longitude), not only a sign.

hindi: अब कोई 615 पर पैदा हो गया उसका 45 डिग्री का हो गया कोई 7 बजे पैदा हो गया तो उसका 15 डिग्री का लगन हो गया
says: As the birth time moves later the lagna degree rises: 6:15 gives a larger degree (caption says 45, garbled) and 7:00 gives a lagna at 15°; the numbers are illustrations of the movement, not an exact formula.
ambiguity: The 6:15 value '45' is garbled (maybe 4.5 or 6); his figures also imply about 12° per hour, below the average of about 15° per hour.
classical_check: The lagna advances about 1° every 4 minutes on average, faster or slower by sign; his numbers are only rough.

hindi: यानी कि इस लगन में यहां से एंटर करके यहां से यहां यह घूमा 6 बजे से 8 बजे तक है मान लो ये तो 6 बजे 7 बजे 8 बजे यह ग्रह घूम रहा है
says: In his example the lagna sign is rising from about 6 to 8 o'clock; the lagna point enters at one end and crosses to the other, so everyone born in that two-hour window shares the lagna sign but has a different lagna degree.
ambiguity: He says 'this planet is moving' while describing the lagna; the diagram gestures are lost.
classical_check: Agrees that a sign takes roughly two hours to rise, varying with sign and latitude.

hindi: यह समझना बहुत जरूरी है ताकि इष्ट को समझे इष्ट का बहुत स्यापा चल रहा है आजकल इष्ट ही चल रहा है दिमाग का दही कर देते हैं लोग समझ है नहीं उन्हें गलती उनकी नहीं है नॉलेज नहीं
says: Says this degree-level understanding of lagna and planets is essential before one can understand ishta (personal deity); the market is full of ishta advice from people who lack the knowledge, which he calls ignorance rather than fault.
ambiguity: He does not yet give the ishta method; this is only the statement that degrees are a prerequisite.
classical_check: Jaimini ishta devata uses the atmakaraka (highest degree planet) and the 12th from karakamsha, so degrees do matter classically; no method is given here.

hindi: मान लो यहां पर आपका राहु बैठा है मंगल बैठा है मंगल बिठा लेते हैं हम यहां मंगल ग्रह बैठा हुआ है अब मंगल ग्रह जो है अंतरिक्ष में उसकी भी अपनी डिग्रियां है
says: Places Mars in the box for his example and notes that Mars in space has its own degrees, separate from the lagna's degree.
ambiguity: He first says Rahu sits there and then switches to Mars for the example; which box 'here' is cannot be seen in the caption.
classical_check: Agrees: every planet has its own longitude within its sign.

gist: Says it is complicated and not a halwa: one cannot learn one's ishta casually and carry God in the pocket; the art has a whole syllabus behind it and must be learnt.

hindi: मंगल मान लेते हैं 7 डिग्री का है आपका मंगल 7 डिग्री का हो गया अब लगन है 15 डिग्री का यानी 7:00 बजे बंदा पैदा हुआ है मंगल 7 डिग्री का चल रहा है
says: Sets up his worked example: the person is born around 7:00 am so the lagna is at 15° of its sign, and Mars sits in that same sign at 7°.
cells_derived_method: none by itself; the consequence for Mars comes in the later rows.
ambiguity: Both 7° (Mars) and 7:00 (time) appear; Mars is shown in the same box as the lagna, but the sign is not named.
classical_check: Silent; this is the setup for the degree rule.

hindi: यह मंगल जो है कम से कम डेढ़ दो महीने भी चल सकता है एक राशि के अंदर एक ही राशि को यह तो चलेगा दो घंटे यह हो सकता है कई महीनों चल रहा है चार महीने भी चलता
says: Mars stays in one sign for at least about 1.5 to 2 months and sometimes up to four months when it turns retrograde and direct again, while the lagna crosses the same sign in about two hours.
ambiguity: The sentence is rambling; 'दो घंटे' refers to the lagna sign's duration, not Mars.
classical_check: Mars averages about 57 days per sign over its roughly 687-day cycle, more with retrogression; his 1.5 to 2 months is close and four months or more is possible.

hindi: अब ये 7 डिग्री का है 15 डिग्री के लग्न में जिस व्यक्ति का जन्म हुआ है मंगल उसका 7 डिग्री का है तो यह गांठ बांध लो मंगल इस जगह काम ही नहीं कर रहा मंगल यहां काम ही नहीं कर रहा है
says: Key rule: if the lagna is at 15° and Mars in the same sign is at only 7°, Mars does not work in the lagna at all, even though the sign chart shows it there; the planet is behind the lagna degree.
cells_derived_method: He does not name the house Mars works from; 'behind' (next rows) implies the previous house. Generalised by me with equal houses starting at the lagna degree: a planet in the sign of house H whose degree is lower than the lagna degree works from house H-1 (1 goes to 12), and one at or above it stays in H. The sign and dignity of the planet do not change; only the house it works from changes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars at 7° Aries (own sign) with lagna Aries at 15°. By the degree rule Mars works from the 12th bhava (Pisces 15° to Aries 15°), so a loss, expense and foreign-stay reading replaces the 1st-house self and body reading.

Derived, not said by him: Mars at 7° Cancer (debilitated) with lagna Cancer at 15°. Mars works from the 12th bhava (Gemini 15° to Cancer 15°); the debilitation in sign stays, but the 1st-house reading is replaced by a 12th-house one.

Derived, not said by him: Mars exalted in Capricorn at 7° with lagna Capricorn at 15°. A Ruchaka-yoga reading (Mars exalted in a kendra) would fail by the degree rule, because Mars works from the 12th bhava (Sagittarius 15° to Capricorn 15°), not the 1st.

Derived, not said by him: Mars at 7° Libra shows in the 4th house of the sign chart (lagna Cancer at 15°), but the 4th bhava starts at Libra 15°, so Mars works from the 3rd bhava (Virgo 15° to Libra 15°): effort, courage and siblings instead of home and mother.

ambiguity: He compares degrees but does not state the general rule or the house boundary; whether he means equal houses from the lagna degree, Sripati midpoints or another system is not said.
classical_check: Agrees with the bhava chalit and equal-house logic (a planet before the lagna degree moves to the previous bhava); a whole-sign Parashari reading would still count it in the 1st, so he differs from that method.

hindi: और सारे के सारे लोग बेच रहे हैं इं पर बिक रहा है ट पर बिक रहा है लगन का मंगल यह करेगा अरे वो लगन में बैठा ही नहीं वो दिख रहा है लगन में वह स्थापित दिखा रहे हैं
says: Criticises online astrologers who sell readings like 'Mars in the lagna will do this': the planet only appears in the lagna box of the sign chart and is not actually seated there, so such generic readings are wrong.
cells_derived_method: The same objection applies to any planet-in-house reading when the planet's degree puts it on the other side of the house boundary. With Mars at 7° and the lagna at 15° (his numbers) the 7th-house and 12th-house Mars readings, which matter for Manglik judgement, can also shift to the neighbouring bhava.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars at 7° Taurus is in the 7th house of the sign chart (lagna Scorpio at 15°), a classic Manglik placement, but the 7th bhava starts at Taurus 15°, so Mars works from the 6th bhava (Aries 15° to Taurus 15°), which is not on the usual Manglik list.

Derived, not said by him: Mars at 7° Gemini is in the 12th house of the sign chart (lagna Cancer at 15°), but the 12th bhava starts at Gemini 15°, so Mars works from the 11th bhava (Taurus 15° to Gemini 15°), turning a 12th-house loss reading into an 11th-house gains reading.

ambiguity: 'इं' and 'ट' are garbled platform names (likely Instagram and YouTube).
classical_check: Differs from whole-sign (rashi) readings used by most online astrologers; agrees with the bhava chalit method used in KP and Sripati-based schools.

hindi: लगन में मंगल हो सकता है आपका यहां काम कर रहा है डिग्री कोई चेंज है म चार डिग्री हो सकता है यहां काम कर रहा है पता नहीं कहां पीछे आ गया आपका मंगल वहां है ही नहीं
says: Repeats the point with another degree (about 4° is mentioned): Mars may show in the lagna box but has slipped somewhere behind it, and he says your Mars is not there at all; the first half of the sentence is garbled.
ambiguity: 'यहां काम कर रहा है' appears twice and the caption does not show which place is meant; the 4° may be a different degree for Mars or for the lagna.
classical_check: Same as the previous degree rule; the garbled text gives nothing new to check.

hindi: मजे की बात यह घर आपका राशि थी हम इधर ले लेते हैं दोबारा यह वाली राशि है मान लो यह राशि आपकी हो गई 22 डिग्री है यहां राशि 22 डिग्री घूम चुका है सात नंबर है यहां 22 डिग्री आगे
says: Starts a second worked example: the lagna sign is number 7 and has already advanced 22° of its 30°.
cells_derived_method: none by itself; the consequence of a lagna at 22° is worked out in the next row.
ambiguity: 'सात नंबर' is read as sign number 7 (Libra), supported by Scorpio being the next sign a few lines later, but he could have meant house 7.
classical_check: Silent; this is the setup for the example.

hindi: शाम को 6:30 बजे 22 डिग्री आगे चला गया है और हो सकता है 7:30 बजे यह इस लगन को छोड़ के आगे चला जाए फिर यहां पर राशि गोल घूम जाएगी अगली राशि आगे वृश्चिक
says: In the evening example the lagna stands at 22° at about 6:30 pm and may leave this sign around 7:30 pm, when the next sign, Scorpio, becomes the lagna; a high lagna degree therefore means the birth is close to a change of lagna.
cells_derived_method: With equal houses from the lagna degree, a lagna at 22° of its sign makes each house mostly the next sign (8° of the lagna sign plus 22° of the next), so the lagna sign is the minor share of the 1st house and the following sign the major share; shortly after the lagna changes, the house borders move by almost a whole sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with Libra lagna at 22° the 1st bhava is Libra 22° to 30° plus Scorpio 0° to 22°, so Scorpio supplies most of the 1st house and Libra the minor share; a planet in Libra below 22° falls in the 12th bhava.

Derived, not said by him: with Libra lagna at 22° the 2nd house is Scorpio 22° to 30° plus Sagittarius 0° to 22°, so Sagittarius dominates the house of wealth and speech and Scorpio gives only an 8° share.

Derived, not said by him: after the lagna moves into Scorpio (a few degrees in), a planet at Libra 25° is in the 12th bhava, while with the earlier Libra 22° lagna the same planet is in the 1st; a birth-time gap of under an hour changes its house.

ambiguity: His clock times are rough: about 8° left at the average rate is roughly 30 to 40 minutes, not an hour; sign 7 is read as Libra only because Scorpio follows.
classical_check: Agrees that the lagna sign changes about every two hours; the multi-sign share of each house is my derivation (equal-house view), not his words.

gist: Chunk ends mid-sentence ('the interesting thing will be, when this is 22 degrees then ...'); the point he was about to make is cut off and continues in the next slice.

hindi: …21 डिग्री तक वो भी यहां काम कर रहा है तो आपके जब एक लगन होता है या एक राशि कहीं होती है हो सकता है वह दो राशि काम कर रही हो हो सकता है तीन राशि
says: A single lagna or sign spot is not one sign's territory: at the same point two, even three, zodiac signs can be active together. A neighbouring sign (its number was lost at the start of the caption) is said to count up to its 21 degrees and also act at this spot.
cells_derived_method: Every house in every lagna can carry up to three signs: its own sign (major) plus the sign before and/or after it, where the bhava start or end or a degree overlap spills over. So each (house, sign) cell has neighbour cells (same house, adjacent signs) that share its effect, with weight depending on how many degrees each sign covers there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries with a late rising degree (say 25 degrees): the first-house span runs past the end of Aries into Taurus, so a planet near the edge is read as house 1 in Aries and partly as house 1 in Taurus (neighbour cell 1/Taurus), mixing Mars and Venus colouring on self, body and temperament.

Derived: lagna Aries, 7th house Libra: if the 7th bhava begins in the tail of Virgo, partner matters are read partly as 7th in Virgo (neighbour cell 7/Virgo) and partly as 7th in Libra, so Mercury's analytical nature colours the Venus-ruled partnership reading.

ambiguity: The caption starts mid-sentence: the sign number before 'राशि' is missing, and it is unclear whether '21 degrees' means the first 21 degrees of that sign or a reach of 21 degrees into this house.
classical_check: Bhava chalit and Sripati put a planet in the house whose bhava arambh-to-samapti span contains it, which can differ from its rashi house, so one house can touch two or three signs. Classical texts are silent on a '21 degree' rule.

hindi: मंगल बैठा है नीच का है चार नंबर में नीच का होता है नेगेटिव होता है बुरा होता है लेकिन अगर यहां पर राशि नंबर तीन भी काम कर रही है और हो सकता है पांच भी तो आपका मंगल तीन नंबर सा और पांच नंबर से होकर महा शुभ है महा गुड और चार नंबर हो के महा बुरा
says: Mars in sign 4 (Cancer) is debilitated and normally bad, but if signs 3 (Gemini) and maybe 5 (Leo) also operate at that same spot, Mars acts through each sign at once: very good through Gemini and Leo, very bad through Cancer. The verdict is a blend of the signs working at the point, not Cancer alone.
cells_derived_method: Take the Mars-in-Cancer cell for each house and add its Gemini and Leo neighbour cells. Mars's dignity in each sign (debilitated in Cancer, enemy Mercury's Gemini, friendly Sun's Leo) is combined with what the house signifies (4th: home and mother, 7th: spouse, 10th: career), weighted by how many degrees each sign covers at that house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Mars (lagna and 8th lord) debilitated in the 4th: home peace, mother and property are under strain; if Leo (sign 5) also covers the 4th-house point, Mars in a friend's sign adds drive and some property gain, softening the reading.

Derived: lagna Libra, Mars (2nd and 7th lord) debilitated in the 10th: career sees conflict, and pay or partnership gets strained; if Gemini (sign 3) also touches this house point, Mars gains courage and initiative at work, which blunts the weakness.

Derived: lagna Capricorn, Mars (4th and 11th lord) debilitated in the 7th: weak partnership and home comfort in a pure Cancer reading; if Leo also operates at the 7th-house point, Mars is in a friend's sign and the spouse-related harm looks smaller.

ambiguity: 'नंबर तीन/चार/पांच' are read as sign numbers (Gemini, Cancer, Leo) because Mars is debilitated in sign 4; he does not say which house the point is in, nor how the three signs are weighted. 'सा' looks like a caption slip for 'से'.
classical_check: Mars debilitated in Cancer is classical. Gemini is an enemy sign for Mars (Mercury is its natural enemy), so calling it 'maha shubh' differs from Parashari sign dignity; Leo (Sun's sign, a friend) agrees. Blending the verdicts of overlapping signs is not a classical method.

hindi: अब यह ह्यूमन कॉन्शियस नेस चाहिए एक्सपीरियंस व्यक्ति की जो बताएगा कि मंगल मां को जान से मार रहा है या एक्सीडेंट कर रहा है या प्रॉपर्ट बनवा रहा है भाई या विदेश यात्रा करा रहा है या पढ़ाई में फेल करा रहा है
says: Once the signs at a spot are sorted out, deciding which of a planet's many possible results actually happens needs human consciousness and an experienced reader. Mars in a weak spot could be hurting the mother (his word is 'killing', recorded only as his illustration of a death-type result, not as a prediction rule), causing an accident, building property, giving foreign travel or failing the native in studies; the chart alone does not pick one.
cells_derived_method: The candidate results come from Mars's house topics and rulerships: mother, home and property (4th), accidents and sudden events (8th), foreign travel (12th or 9th), study (4th or 5th). Which one fires depends on the house Mars sits in, the houses it owns for that lagna and the sign blend; the sentence gives no rule that selects between them.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, Mars (4th and 11th lord) in own sign in the 4th: property, vehicle and home gains are the likelier signification, rather than harm to the mother.

Derived: lagna Virgo, Mars (3rd and 8th lord) in own sign in the 8th: sudden events and accident-type results, plus effort-related setbacks through the 3rd lord, are the candidates, while property and study are not.

Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Mars (5th and 12th lord) in own sign in the 12th: foreign travel or living abroad is the likelier signification, with expenses; study results come only through the 5th lordship.

ambiguity: 'भाई' after 'प्रॉपर्ट बनवा रहा है' is most likely the colloquial address 'bro', not 'brother' as an outcome, so brother is not counted among the results. 'मां को जान से मार रहा है' is a death example he uses for illustration, not a stated rule.
classical_check: Classical texts give Mars's karakatvas (brothers, property, accidents, courage) and say results must be judged with house, lordship and aspects, so 'decide by an experienced reader' fits the general method; no classical rule picks between the outcomes.

hindi: तो जो एक बिकता है इंटरनेट पे चौथा मंगल ये करेगा शनि छठे घर का यह करेगा नहीं करता इसलिए इष्ट का निर्धारण बड़ा भरी टफ है जिसकी बात हम
says: He rejects the stock internet one-liners ('4th-house Mars will do this, 6th-house Saturn will do that'): such fixed results often do not happen, which is why pinning down the real outcome of a placement is very hard. He promises to go into the method in detail.
cells_derived_method: none: he is rejecting fixed house-only results, not giving a rule that varies by cell; the later rows replace them with multi-sign blending.
ambiguity: 'इष्ट का निर्धारण' (determining the desired result or deity) is probably a caption garble for 'फल का निर्धारण', deciding the actual result; 'नहीं करता' means it does not do that.
classical_check: Classical texts do give stock results (Mars in the 4th troubles home and mother, Saturn in the 6th defeats enemies) but also insist on sign, lordship, aspect and strength modifiers, so he agrees with the need for modifiers and differs only in doubting the stock lines.

hindi: डिटेल करेंगे आज जरूर क्योंकि आपके एक ही पॉइंट पे एक राशि दो राशि तीन राशि काम कर सकती है मैक्सिमम तीन
says: At any one point of the chart one, two or three signs can be working, never more than three. This is the cap on how many signs share a house point, and he will work it out in detail today.
cells_derived_method: Each house point has 1 to 3 signs: its own sign plus at most one neighbour on each side. So every house is a blend of at most three of the 144 cells (same house, adjacent signs), and a fourth sign is never added.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, 3rd house Gemini: the house point can also be touched by Taurus (2) and Cancer (4), so a planet there answers to the signs of Venus, Mercury and the Moon together, but never a fourth sign.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, 9th house Leo: fortune and father matters can be coloured by Cancer, Leo and Virgo together at most, so a planet there is a blend of those three signs only.

ambiguity: It is not stated whether three is a strict physical limit or only the most he has seen; he says 'maximum three'.
classical_check: Bhava chalit houses of about 30 degrees normally touch two signs, and three only when a house is much wider than 30 degrees (unequal Sripati or KP houses, higher latitudes), so a cap of three is plausible; classical texts do not state it as a rule.

hindi: यानी यहां पर जो 14 डिग्री था यहां एक नंबर थी अब यहां पर ये मान लो 14 डिग्री का था इसके अंदर भाव आरंभ और भाव समाप्त भी होता है तो पता लगा यहां पर 12 नंबर भी आ गया और यहां दो नंबर भी आ गया
says: Worked example: a lagna at 14 degrees of sign 1 (Aries) still has a bhava start (arambh) and bhava end (samapti) around it. That span reaches back into sign 12 (Pisces) and forward into sign 2 (Taurus), so three signs, 12, 1 and 2, work in this one lagna.
cells_derived_method: The same method applies to any house: take the cusp degree, the bhava start and the bhava end, and every sign whose degrees fall inside that span is a working sign. For a house centred at 14 degrees of a sign, an equal 30-degree house runs from 29 degrees of the previous sign to 29 degrees of its own sign (two signs); only a house wider than 30 degrees (Sripati or KP spans) reaches a third sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces: Venus is exalted in Pisces, so a Venus in the first-house stretch that lies in late Pisces counts as an exalted-sign Venus for self and looks, but the share lying in Aries (a neutral sign for Venus) pulls the result down to a milder version.

Derived: lagna Taurus: the Moon is exalted in Taurus, so a Moon in the part of the first house lying in Taurus reads strong for mind and temperament, while the share in Aries (Mars's sign, neutral for the Moon) keeps it decent; the blend is firmer than a Moon in Aries alone.

ambiguity: '12 नंबर' and 'दो नंबर' are read as sign numbers (Pisces, Taurus), not house numbers. With equal houses a 14-degree lagna would reach only signs 12 and 1; sign 2 appears only if the house is wider than 30 degrees, and he does not say which house system he means.
classical_check: Consistent with Sripati and bhava chalit, where a house runs from the midpoint with the previous cusp to the midpoint with the next; classical texts do not usually say that all three signs 12, 1 and 2 can enter the first house.

hindi: अब मान लो य शनि बैठा है तो शनि नीच का भी है और गुड भी है दो नंबर का गुड भी होता है दो है तीन है यह भी दो ले लिया चलो अब गुड भी अब शनि बुरा फल दे रहा है कि अच्छा दे रहा है लगन में बैठा शनि एक नंबर का यह करेगा नहीं करेगा
says: Saturn at a multi-sign point can be debilitated (sign 1, Aries) and good at the same time, because sign 2 (and possibly 3) also working there treat it well. So for Saturn in the lagna in sign 1 you cannot simply say it will give its debilitation harm; whether it gives a bad or a good result has to be answered by blending the signs that work at the spot.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's dignity flips with the sign (debilitated in Aries, friend's sign in Taurus and Gemini), so for each house the blend shifts; the house decides what is helped or hurt.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Saturn (10th and 11th lord) in the 1st in its debilitation sign: low stamina and shaky self-confidence in a pure debilitation reading; if Taurus also covers the lagna point, Saturn works from a friend's sign and the same placement reads steadier and more disciplined.

Derived: lagna Cancer, Saturn (7th and 8th lord) debilitated in the 10th: career delay in a pure reading; with Taurus also operating at the point, Saturn gets a friend's sign and effort slowly pays, so work looks slow but stable.

Derived: lagna Aquarius, Saturn (lagna and 12th lord) in a friend's sign in the 5th: steady for studies and children; if Cancer (the Moon's sign, an enemy of Saturn) also touches the 5th-house point, part of that benefit is diluted.

ambiguity: 'दो है तीन है यह भी दो ले लिया' is unclear: possibly 'sign 2 and sign 3 are both here, count sign 2 too'. Only signs 1 and 2 are put in cells_stated; sign 3 (Gemini) may also be meant. 'यह करेगा नहीं करेगा' means 'will it or will it not do its (usual) harm'.
classical_check: Saturn debilitated in Aries and friendly in Taurus and Gemini (Venus and Mercury are its friends) agree with Parashari; blending dignities across overlapping signs is not classical.

hindi: इसलिए कईयों के सातव घर में पत्नी का स्थान होता है नीच का बैठा होता तलाक नहीं होता क्योंकि वो काम ही नहीं कर रहा एक तो यह स्थिति है
says: This is why in many charts a debilitated planet sits in the 7th house, the spouse's place, yet no divorce happens: at that spot the debilitating sign is not the one actually operating, so the planet is not working as debilitated. He gives this as the first of two situations (KP is the second).
cells_derived_method: A debilitated planet in the 7th reads as harmful to marriage only if the debilitation sign really controls the point; if the bhava span puts another sign there, the debilitation falls away. Which planet and which signs matter changes with the lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra, Saturn (4th and 5th lord) debilitated in Aries in the 7th: coldness or delay with the partner is the usual fear; if Pisces (Jupiter's sign) also covers the 7th-house point, Saturn is not fully debilitated there and the fear is only partly active.

Derived: lagna Aries, Sun (5th lord) debilitated in Libra in the 7th: ego clashes with the spouse in a pure reading; if Virgo (sign 6) also operates at that point the Sun is not debilitated in Virgo, so the clash reading weakens.

Derived: lagna Capricorn, Mars (4th and 11th lord) debilitated in Cancer in the 7th: quarrels and heat in partnership under a pure reading; if Leo also works at the point, Mars sits in a friend's sign and the break-up fear is cut down.

ambiguity: He names no planet, so it is any debilitated planet in the 7th. 'तलाक नहीं होता' describes those cases only; it is not a promise that divorce never happens with a debilitated 7th-house planet.
classical_check: Classical texts explain such cases by neecha bhanga (cancellation of debilitation), not by the debilitating sign being absent, so his reason differs; the observation that a debilitated 7th-house planet does not always break a marriage is common.

hindi: एक हो गई केपी कुंडली कृष्ण मूर्ति पद्धति वह इतनी मजेदार है कि उसमें भाव आरंभ कब हुआ और अंत कब हुआ आपके लिए इसकी वजह से कई बार यह कुंडली चल रही है
says: The second situation is the KP (Krishnamurti Paddhati) chart: what makes it interesting is that it fixes exactly where each bhava begins and ends, so the house boundaries by degree, not the sign boundaries, decide where a planet really counts.
cells_derived_method: In KP each house is the stretch from its cusp to the next cusp (exact degrees from the house system), and a planet's house comes from the cusp longitudes. So the same sign position can land in different houses for different births, and the (house, sign) cell is fixed by cusp degrees, not by the sign alone.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for a Taurus ascendant a planet at 3 degrees of Gemini is in the 2nd house by sign; if the KP 3rd cusp begins at 1 degree of Gemini it counts in house 3 (cell 3/Gemini), so a family-and-wealth reading turns into an effort-and-siblings reading.

Derived: for an Aries ascendant a planet at 28 degrees of Libra is in the 7th house by sign; if the KP 8th cusp falls at 27 degrees of Libra the planet counts in house 8 (cell 8/Libra), so partnership themes become sudden-change and shared-resources themes.

ambiguity: The sentence trails off at 'यह कुंडली चल रही है' and the rest is a garbled run (see the next row). He names no house system for KP.
classical_check: Not classical. KP (K.S. Krishnamurti) uses Placidus-type cusps, assigns planets to houses by cusp longitude and judges through star lord and sub lord; classical Parashari uses whole-sign or equal houses.

gist: Garbled run ('यहां राशि है छ सात यह सारे उड़ा देते हैं हम ... एक सात 10 च तो यहां आठ और न है'): sign numbers and what is thrown away cannot be recovered; possibly he says KP sets the sign numbers aside and goes by cusp degrees, but this is not clear enough to record.

hindi: लेकिन केपी कुंडली में ऐसा हो सकता है कि ग्रह की एग्जैक्ट मूवमेंट देख रहे हैं कि जन्म के टाइम तो यहां पर एक ग्रह है लेकिन वो ग्रह एक्चुअली बैठा ही है यहां डेड है इफेक्ट काम ही नहीं करेगा जीरो है जीरो
says: In KP, where the planet's exact position at birth is checked, a planet that appears to be in a given house on the sign chart can turn out not to be inside that house's real span; for that house it is 'dead', its effect does not work at all, zero.
cells_derived_method: For a planet at a given degree, KP compares it with the house cusp degrees; it may be pushed to the previous or next house, so the house results expected from its sign drop to zero and the adjacent house gets them instead.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for an Aries ascendant a planet at 3 degrees of Virgo is in the 6th by sign (debts, service, rivals); if the KP 6th cusp falls at 10 degrees of Virgo the planet belongs to house 5 (cell 5/Virgo), so the 6th-house effect expected from the sign chart is zero and it acts for children, study and creativity instead.

Derived: for a Leo ascendant a planet at 25 degrees of Sagittarius is in the 5th by sign (children, study); if the KP 6th cusp falls at 20 degrees of Sagittarius it belongs to house 6 (cell 6/Sagittarius), so the 5th-house effect is zero and it acts for service, debts and rivals instead.

ambiguity: 'एक्चुअली बैठा ही है यहां डेड है' is garbled: either 'actually sits (elsewhere)' or 'is dead here'. Recorded as 'exact cusp degrees can take a planet out of the house the sign chart shows'. 'Zero' is his own strength claim.
classical_check: Not classical. KP does assign houses by cusp longitude but judges results through star lord and sub lord; it has no 'dead, zero effect' rule, so that part is his own claim.

hindi: या बृहस्पति बैठा मान लो 10 नंबर में बृहस्पति नीच का होता है यानी कि काम नहीं करेगा बेरोजगार रखता है आदमी को
says: Ordinary reading: Jupiter in sign 10 (Capricorn) is debilitated, which means it does not deliver and keeps the man without a job.
cells_derived_method: The joblessness link is strongest when the debilitated Jupiter touches the 10th (career) or the 2nd and 11th (income), or rules those houses; in other houses the debilitated Jupiter weakens that house's topic instead.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Jupiter (9th and 12th lord) debilitated in the 10th: luck and support fail the career and the job search drags, which matches his joblessness claim most directly.

Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Jupiter (lagna and 4th lord) debilitated in the 2nd: family wealth and speech build slowly and savings come late; career is judged separately through the 10th house, so the joblessness claim is weaker.

Derived: lagna Cancer, Jupiter (6th and 9th lord) debilitated in the 7th: partnerships and clients bring weaker support and work through others is uneven; joblessness is not the main signification here.

ambiguity: '10 नंबर' is read as sign 10 (Capricorn) because Jupiter is debilitated there; it could also be house 10 (career), but the debilitation points to the sign. 'बेरोजगार रखता है' is a general claim, not tied to a house.
classical_check: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn is classical. Joblessness as the result is not classical; it depends on neecha bhanga and house lordship, so his claim is a strong simplification.

hindi: बृहस्पति यहां काम ही नहीं कर रहा बृहस्पति यहां काम कर रहा है और मजे की बात क्या होगी केपी कुंडली के अंतर्गत हो सकता है यह नौ नंबर राशि यहां तक एक्सटेंडेड है ये कुंडली में 10 नंबर है ही नहीं अब वहां बृहस्पति नेगेटिव फल देगा ही नहीं
says: The twist: under KP, sign 9 (Sagittarius) can extend right over this spot and sign 10 may not be present there at all. Then Jupiter works through Sagittarius, its own sign, so the debilitated reading is simply wrong for it and Jupiter cannot give negative results, however you try to read it the usual way.
cells_derived_method: This holds for any planet whose sign changes at a KP cusp boundary: its dignity becomes that of the sign actually covering the degree. Jupiter in Sagittarius (own sign) is strong in every house, and the house decides what flourishes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces, Jupiter (lagna and 10th lord) in own sign in the 10th: a strong kendra placement, with career and standing supported, the opposite of the joblessness reading.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Jupiter (4th and 7th lord) in own sign in the 4th: home, mother and comfort are protected, and it forms the Hamsa pattern (Jupiter in own sign in a kendra).

Derived: lagna Taurus, Jupiter (8th and 11th lord) in own sign in the 8th: sudden changes are cushioned and gains come through the 11th lordship, though 8th-house topics (hidden matters, inheritance) remain.

ambiguity: 'नौ नंबर राशि यहां तक एक्सटेंडेड है' is read as sign 9 stretching over this point, and 'ये कुंडली में 10 नंबर है ही नहीं' as sign 10 not occurring at this house point. He does not explain how sign 10 can be absent. The caption continues 'आपको उसकी रीडिंग नहीं आ रही है' at the next timestamp (you cannot get its reading).
classical_check: Not classical. Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in a kendra is Hamsa and strong, which is classical; but treating an extended sign as removing sign 10 entirely is his own view (an intercepted sign normally keeps its own dignity).

gist: Audience banter: a member wants to ask something, says he is coming and even offers payment; garbled, no astrology.

hindi: क्या ये राशि 30 डिग्री के ब भी चली जाती है राशि 30 नहीं जाएगी भाव चला जाता है
says: Asked whether a sign continues past its 30 degrees, he answers that a sign never goes beyond 30 degrees, but the bhava (house) can run beyond the sign boundary into the next sign; the overflow comes from house spans, not from sign spans.
cells_derived_method: A house running from its start to its end can begin in one sign and finish in the next, so a point near a sign edge can belong to the house of the neighbouring sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, 5th house Leo: if the 5th bhava runs on past 30 degrees of Leo, a planet at 2 degrees of Virgo still counts for the 5th house (children, learning) even though its sign puts it in the 6th.

Derived: lagna Taurus, 2nd house Gemini: the 2nd bhava can begin before 0 degrees of Gemini, so a planet in the last degrees of Taurus can already deliver 2nd-house wealth and speech results although its sign is still the 1st.

ambiguity: The first part is an audience question and the caption is cut ('के ब भी' is probably 'के बाद भी'); the answer treats 'राशि' as sign and 'भाव' as house.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical fixed 30-degree sign width and with bhava chalit, where a house centred on its cusp runs from the earlier midpoint to the later midpoint and may cross sign limits.

gist: Calls the earth-rotation question lovely, jokes about how badly he draws the circle on the board and tells the audience to rotate it in their heads instead.

hindi: एक्चुअली धरती के लिए हम बोलते हैं गोला ये होना चाहिए जीरो होना चाहिए वो जीरो में नहीं घूमती वो एलिप्टिकल है थोड़ा सा डिजू करके जाती है 25 डिग्री पर घूमी है धरती थोड़ा सा डिजू करती है जुंग याद रखना बाकी कुछ भूल जाओ
says: As the astronomical basis for shifting house boundaries, he says the earth should ideally spin upright at zero tilt, but it moves in an elliptical path, tilted about 25 degrees, and wobbles slightly. He asks the audience to remember this crooked, wobbling motion and forget the rest; it is the cause of the next point, lagnas drifting.
cells_derived_method: none: this is astronomy background and does not depend on a particular house or sign.
ambiguity: 'डिजू' and 'जुंग' are garbled English words (perhaps 'jerk/wobble' and 'just'). The 25 degrees is his figure; the real axial tilt is about 23.4 degrees.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish is silent on axial tilt as a cause, though the Surya Siddhanta uses an obliquity of about 24 degrees; the astronomical facts (tilt, elliptical orbit) are standard.

hindi: आपके लग्न आगे पीछे घूमते हैं जोडियक का 360 डिग्री का स्फीयर एगजैक्टली 360 है लेकिन हम उसमें बदतमीजी से घूम रहे तभी तो वेदर चेंज होते हैं
says: Because of the earth's crooked motion, lagna points shift forward and back; the zodiac is an exact 360-degree sphere, but we travel through it unevenly, which he says is also why weather changes. House and lagna boundaries therefore cannot be treated as fixed equal blocks from birth to birth.
cells_derived_method: House boundaries move from birth to birth, so the same (house, sign) cell has a different span in different charts; exact degrees must be used instead of assuming 30 degrees per house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini: with a rising degree of 2 the first house starts back in Taurus, and with 28 it reaches almost into Cancer, so the same lagna sign carries a different blend of neighbouring signs in different births.

Derived: lagna Taurus, 7th house Scorpio: with a late rising degree in Taurus the 7th-house span slides forward into Sagittarius, and with an early degree it reaches back into Libra, so partner matters are coloured by different signs.

ambiguity: 'बदतमीजी से घूम रहे' means moving unruly or awkwardly. 'लग्न आगे पीछे घूमते हैं' could mean the ascendant degree shifting day to day or the house boundaries shifting; it is treated here as lagna and house boundary drift.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish already says sign rising times (lagna mana) differ by sign and latitude because of the ecliptic's obliquity, which agrees in spirit; the weather link is not a Jyotish claim.

hindi: और इसीलिए कभी भी धरती पर एक समय दोबारा नहीं आ सकता भले प्लेनेट की कॉमिनेशन सेम हो जाए क्योंकि धरती अंतरिक्ष में कहीं और है
says: No moment on earth can ever repeat: even if the planets form exactly the same combination again, the earth itself is at a different place in space, so one chart is never an exact copy of another and the same planetary combination can read differently.
cells_derived_method: none: it applies to every cell alike and is not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'एक समय दोबारा नहीं आ सकता' means an exact moment cannot recur; he does not say how the earth's changed position alters the reading in practice.
classical_check: Classical texts say similar yogas give different results according to place, time and strength (desha, kala), but do not give his astronomical reason; partly agrees.

hindi: जोडियक में उसकी किरणें कहीं कहीं से अलग अलग जा रही है इस कारण से आपके कई बार राशियां ही गायब हो जाएंगी
says: Since the earth's rays toward the zodiac come from a different spot each time, whole signs can go missing at a house point: a sign you would expect in a house may not be operating there at all.
cells_derived_method: For any house the expected sign may be absent: only signs overlapping the house's real span count, so the whole-sign occupant of the house can drop out and a neighbouring sign takes its place in that cell.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: where the 10th house would be Capricorn for an Aries ascendant but that sign is missing at the spot and Sagittarius covers it, a planet sits in cell 10/Sagittarius, so career is judged through Jupiter's sign and not Saturn's.

Derived: where the 4th house would be Cancer for an Aries ascendant but Gemini covers the spot instead, a planet sits in cell 4/Gemini, so home, mother and property pick up Mercury's nature rather than the Moon's.

ambiguity: 'उसकी किरणें' (its rays) is vague, probably the line from the earth to the zodiac; the mechanism is not explained, only the claim that signs can be absent.
classical_check: Not in classical texts; the nearest idea is the intercepted sign in Placidus or KP houses, where a sign lies wholly inside a house without a cusp.

gist: Rant on how it takes 20 years of schooling just to be a graduate earning 10 to 15 thousand, even an unsure job, a course afterwards and passport ECR trouble; sets up the point that astrology cannot be learnt quickly.
People think they have learnt astrology after watching 50 to 2000 reels; he says he himself is still learning while teaching and that it is never-ending.
Compares reel-based learning to an opium high: it feels good, wears off and needs more and more doses of knowledge.

Says he is pushed to make reels like 'Mars here, Saturn there' but cannot, because with Mars at a spot a given result often does not happen and he would blurt wrong things; repeats the earlier point about stock placement results, and says extra followers gain him nothing.
No follower will go with him on his deathbed, so he does not need followers.
Spiritual aside: if you are content within yourself the world's maya will not drive you mad, but we cannot be content.

hindi: यह योग है ऐसे कई बार कहते हैं बड़े बड़े अच्छे विद्वान है जो बोलते हैं जिनको प्रणाम है क्योंकि बहुत सुंदर मैसेज दे रहे हैं मांस ना खाए मदिरा ना पिए कुंडली में योग है मदिरा पीने का ऐसी की तैसी तुम्हारी शिक्षा गई तेल लेने
says: Respected scholars give the lovely moral advice 'do not eat meat, do not drink'. He says that if the chart carries a yoga (combination) for drinking, such advice is useless and the habit follows the chart. He names no yoga; recorded only as his claim, with no advice implied.
cells_derived_method: none: no planet, house or sign is named for the drinking yoga.
ambiguity: 'यह योग है' may refer to the inability to be content (the previous aside) rather than a named yoga; the phrase 'कुंडली में योग है मदिरा पीने का' is the astrological part. Which combination he means is not stated.
classical_check: Classical texts list combinations for intoxicant use, but he names none, so there is nothing to compare.

gist: Medical-style asides on uric acid, bones, beer and meat-eating, with what a doctor would say about non-veg food; health claims, not astrology, so not recorded as rules.

hindi: अगर तो आपकी कुंडली के अंदर मंगल आपका खराब है यानी कि चार नंबर को इफक्ट करता है नीच का तो आप रेड मीट नहीं खाएंगे आपका मंगल डिस्टर्ब होगा यस अब आपके लिए रेड मीट खाना नुकसानदायक है
says: If Mars is afflicted in the chart, specifically touching sign 4 (Cancer, Mars's debilitation sign), the person should avoid red meat; eating it disturbs an already weak Mars and is harmful for that person.
cells_derived_method: The sign is fixed (debilitated Mars in Cancer); the house decides which life area the disturbance lands on. In the 1st or 4th it hits body, chest and home peace; in the 10th it shows as friction at work; in the 7th as partner conflict. Red meat is the Mars item, so the avoidance holds in every house but the cost differs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Libra, Mars (lord of 2nd and 7th) sits debilitated in the 10th; red meat would feed temper and clashes with bosses and authority.
Derived: for lagna Aries, Mars is the lagna lord, debilitated in the 4th; red meat would aggravate heat in chest and stomach and unrest at home.
Derived: for lagna Capricorn, Mars (lord of 4th and 11th) is debilitated in the 7th; red meat would feed quarrels in marriage and partnerships.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर' is read as sign 4 (Cancer) because he says 'नीच का'; it could be the 4th house. Also unclear whether Mars must sit in Cancer or may be linked to it by aspect or sign rotation (he explains rotation a few lines later).
classical_check: Classical texts are silent on avoiding red meat for an afflicted Mars; Mars as karaka of meat and blood foods and Mars debilitated in Cancer are both traditional.

hindi: अगर आपका चंद्रमा एक नंबर या आठ नंबर राशि से इलेक्टेड है वह वहां बैठा है स्थापित है दृष्टि दे रहा है राशि घूम रही है
says: He defines what 'Moon affected by sign 1 or 8' means: the Moon counts as linked to that sign if it sits there, is established there, throws an aspect on it, or if the sign rotates into the house where the Moon is.
cells_derived_method: none: this only defines when a sign link counts (placement, aspect, rotation); it gives no house-dependent result by itself.
ambiguity: 'इलेक्टेड' is a caption spelling of 'affected'; 'स्थापित' (established) is not defined and could mean strong or just posited. Signs 1 and 8 are taken as Aries and Scorpio because he says 'राशि'.
classical_check: Placement and aspect links are classical; 'sign rotating into the house' is his multi-sign house idea, not found in Parashari texts which give one sign per house.

hindi: हो सकता है चंद्रमा सात नंबर का बैठा हो लेकिन अभी जो कहानी बताई राशि घूम के आठ नंबर भी यहां गई हो
says: Worked example of rotation: the Moon may be placed in sign 7 (Libra), but if sign 8 (Scorpio) has also rotated into that same house, the Moon is treated as affected by sign 8 as well, because a house touches more than one sign.
cells_derived_method: Applies to any pair of adjacent signs that share a house: a planet in the first sign of the pair also takes the second sign's character, and the reverse. Which houses carry two signs depends on the lagna degree, so the same planet-sign cell can be single-sign in one chart and double-sign in another.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Leo, a Moon in Libra in the 3rd with the cusp late in Libra would also pick up Scorpio (the 4th sign), so Moon-8 conditions apply at the 3rd/4th border.
Derived: for lagna Taurus, a Moon in Libra in the 6th with the house reaching into Scorpio would carry Moon-8 effects into the 6th/7th border (service, disputes shading into partnership).
Derived: for lagna Capricorn, a Moon in Libra in the 10th with Scorpio spilling in would let Moon-8 conditions colour career and public standing.

ambiguity: 'सात नंबर' and 'आठ नंबर' are read as signs (Libra, Scorpio) because he is talking of 'राशि'. 'यहां गई हो' points at a board position we cannot see; it could be the same house or an aspect target.
classical_check: Parashari D1 gives one sign per house; the shared-sign idea resembles cusp overlap in bhava chalit but is stated here as his own method.

hindi: तो आप वाइट मीट नहीं खाएंगे आप वाइट मीट लोगे आपके बैंड बज जाएगी
says: When the Moon is linked to sign 1 or sign 8 in any of those ways, the person should not eat white meat; if they do, it goes badly wrong (his phrase: your band will play, meaning big trouble).
cells_derived_method: Sign pair fixed; the house decides what is spoiled. Moon-8 is a debilitated Moon (Scorpio), so mind, stomach and mother matters suffer most; Moon-1 is the Moon in a Mars sign, a milder link in classical terms. White meat is the Moon item here; the house shows where the damage is felt.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Libra, a debilitated Moon in the 2nd (food, speech, family) is the most direct food link; white meat would damage eating habits and household peace.
Derived: for lagna Aries, a debilitated Moon in the 8th; trouble would be hidden and recurring, emotional or digestive, hard to trace to the diet.
Derived: for lagna Capricorn, the Moon in the 4th in Aries; the home kitchen and the mother's influence are where white meat becomes the issue.

ambiguity: 'एक नंबर या आठ नंबर' is taken as Aries or Scorpio; why Aries is included is not explained since the Moon is debilitated only in Scorpio. 'White meat' is not defined (chicken, fish, eggs).
classical_check: Moon debilitated in Scorpio is classical; Aries is not a Moon debility sign classically, so sign 1 is his own scheme. The diet rule is not found in classical texts.

hindi: अगर आपका केतु इफेक्टेड है तीन नंबर से केतु सबसे डेंजरस है क्योंकि गणेश जी है
says: He ranks Ketu linked to sign 3 (Gemini) as the most dangerous of the planet-sign links he is listing for food and drink, because Ketu is Ganesh and its influence reaches from anywhere.
cells_derived_method: none: this is a severity ranking of the Ketu-Gemini link; the house-specific outcomes are in the seafood, court case and smoking rows that follow.
ambiguity: 'तीन नंबर' is read as sign 3 (Gemini), confirmed later when he says Ketu is debilitated there and 'राशि नहीं हिली'. 'सबसे डेंजरस' is relative to the other planets in this list and is not stated outright.
classical_check: Ketu as Ganesha's planet is traditional. Ketu debilitated in Gemini follows the school that exalts Rahu in Gemini; BPHS differs (Ketu's debility is Taurus).

hindi: यह कहीं से भी दृष्टि फेंक देता है यह पूरी कुंडली में दो तीन भाव छोड़ता है बाकी सब जगह इसने अपनी हवा फैला रखी है
says: Ketu throws its aspect from almost any position: in a whole chart it leaves out only two or three houses and has spread its influence over all the rest.
cells_derived_method: none: he does not say which two or three houses Ketu skips, so the reach cannot be worked out house by house.
ambiguity: Which houses are skipped is not stated. Could be his own wide-aspect scheme or loose talk to explain why Ketu is so dangerous.
classical_check: Differs: Parashari gives Rahu and Ketu no aspect, or at most 5th/7th/9th in some schools; 'all but two or three houses' is not classical.

hindi: केतु तीन नंबर से ड है आप सी फूड नहीं खाएंगे खाएंगे तो ऐसी की तैसी होगी
says: If Ketu is linked to sign 3 (Gemini), the person should not eat seafood; eating it makes things go badly wrong.
cells_derived_method: Sign fixed at Gemini; the house sets where the seafood penalty is felt. In the 2nd it hits food, speech and family; in the 8th it turns hidden and recurring; in the 11th it touches social eating, friends and gains.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Taurus, Ketu sits in the 2nd (food, mouth, family); seafood is the most direct trigger and family-table habits suffer.
Derived: for lagna Scorpio, Ketu in the 8th; the reaction to seafood would be hidden, recurring and hard to trace rather than immediate.
Derived: for lagna Leo, Ketu in the 11th (gains, friends); seafood tied to social and business dinners, with losses of friends or income as the cost.

ambiguity: The caption 'तीन नंबर से ड है' is cut off (probably 'डिबिलिटेटेड' or 'डैमेज'); sign 3 as Gemini is inferred from later lines.
classical_check: Classical texts are silent on seafood and Ketu; Ketu is traditionally linked to the sea and marine matters only loosely.

hindi: जहां केतु बैठा है अगर आपका केतु यहां बैठा है शत्रु स्थान में सोचो कितना कॉम्प्लिकेटेड है और नीच का है और यह तीन नंबर ही है राशि नहीं हिली है तो नॉनवेज सी फूड खाकर जाओगे कोर्ट केस
says: If Ketu is in an enemy place, debilitated in sign 3 (Gemini) with no sign rotation changing that, then eating non-veg or seafood leads the person into a court case; he calls this a very complicated combination.
cells_derived_method: Sign fixed at Gemini; if 'enemy place' means the 6th house the litigation theme is native to that house; in other houses the dispute takes the colour of the house (partners in the 7th, expenses in the 12th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Capricorn, debilitated Ketu in the 6th (litigation, debts, enemies); the court-case result sits naturally in its own house.
Derived: for lagna Cancer, Ketu in the 12th; the case would bring legal fees and losses rather than a win or loss in court.
Derived: for lagna Sagittarius, Ketu in the 7th; the dispute would come from a partner, a contract or a business associate.

ambiguity: 'शत्रु स्थान' could mean the 6th house (house of enemies, which fits court cases) or a sign owned by an enemy planet. 'यहां' points to a board position we cannot see. The clause 'जहां केतु बैठा है' is cut by the caption.
classical_check: Litigation belongs to the 6th house classically; the food-to-court-case link is not in classical texts.

hindi: कोर्ट केस सिर्फ कोर्ट केस अपना उधार मांगने डेट्स पैसे मिल जाएंगे कैसी अजीब विडंबना है
says: The court case in this Ketu combination is only about recovering the person's own lent money (hearing dates spent demanding a loan back), and the money does get recovered; he calls it a strange irony.
cells_derived_method: Continues the Ketu-in-Gemini case. The house decides how the money comes back: through the legal route in the 6th, as delayed gains in the 11th, entangled with others' money in the 8th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Capricorn, Ketu in the 6th; lent money is recovered through a court or legal notice, which is the house's own theme.
Derived: for lagna Leo, Ketu in the 11th (gains); dues from friends or clients come back but only after hearings and delay.
Derived: for lagna Scorpio, Ketu in the 8th; the recovery gets tangled with other people's funds, estates or shared accounts.

ambiguity: 'डेट्स' is read as court hearing dates; it could be 'debts'. 'अपना उधार मांगने' means demanding one's own lent money, not repaying a loan taken. The planet is not named in this sentence and is carried over from the previous one.
classical_check: Classical texts are silent; debt and recovery belong to the 6th house and gains to the 11th.

hindi: लेकिन य कमर में दर्द दे देगा इसलिए यह नहीं कह रहा कि खाओ बट इसकी स्पेसिफिकेशन समझिए साइड इफेक्ट तो मारेगा ही मारेगा क्योंकि वो नेगेटिव तो है
says: The same Ketu combination also gives waist pain, so he is not telling anyone to eat these foods; the side effect will certainly strike because Ketu is a negative planet. Recorded as his tradition claim about body ache, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The body area follows the house Ketu occupies (he says so two sentences later). The waist is the Libra / 7th house region in the body-as-chart scheme, the arms and shoulders go with Gemini or the 3rd, the thighs with the 9th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Sagittarius, Ketu in the 7th; the waist-area complaint he mentions fits the 7th (Libra region) naturally.
Derived: for lagna Aries, Ketu in the 3rd; the complaint would shift to arms, shoulders or hands instead of the waist.
Derived: for lagna Libra, Ketu in the 9th; the complaint would shift to hips and thighs.

ambiguity: He does not say which house gives the waist pain. 'इसकी स्पेसिफिकेशन समझिए' means understand the exact outcome; read as a caution, not permission.
classical_check: Body-part assignment by house is classical (Kalapurusha); the food-to-waist-pain link is his claim.

hindi: केतु आपका तीन नंबर का है आपको सुट्टा पीना उपाय करके पियो नहीं तो यह केतु तीन नंबर का जहां बैठा है वहां की तकलीफ दे देगा
says: For a Ketu-3 person who smokes, he says do a remedy first and then smoke, otherwise Ketu will give the trouble of whichever house it sits in. Recorded as his caution only, not as advice to smoke or a health claim.
cells_derived_method: The trouble is the topic of the house Ketu occupies: body and vitality in the 1st, chest, lungs and home peace in the 4th, work and reputation in the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Gemini, Ketu in the 1st; the penalty for smoking lands on body, head and personal vitality.
Derived: for lagna Pisces, Ketu in the 4th; the penalty lands on chest, lungs and peace at home.
Derived: for lagna Virgo, Ketu in the 10th; the penalty lands on work and reputation.

ambiguity: 'उपाय करके पियो' does not name the remedy and may be sarcasm. 'सुट्टा' means a cigarette or smoke.
classical_check: Ketu remedies (Ganesha worship, charity) are classical, but no classical text ties smoking to Ketu in Gemini.

hindi: स्मोकिंग सारी इसके पास है
says: All smoking falls under Ketu; smoking as a whole belongs to this planet.
cells_derived_method: none: a planet-level significator, independent of house and sign.
ambiguity: 'इसके' is read as Ketu from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Smoke (dhumra) is a Ketu significator in some lists, while tobacco and intoxicants often go to Rahu; the smoking habit is not explicit in BPHS.

hindi: राहु आपका न नंबर का है ... राहु यहां पर है न नंबर का आपको बियर नुकसान करेगी कई किस्म के अल्कोहल नुकसान करेंगे
says: If Rahu is linked to sign 9 (Sagittarius), beer and several other kinds of alcohol will harm the person.
cells_derived_method: Sign fixed at Sagittarius; the house decides what the drinking damages: speech, family and savings in the 2nd, judgement and children in the 5th, expenses and sleep in the 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Scorpio, Rahu in the 2nd; drinking hurts speech, family harmony and savings.
Derived: for lagna Leo, Rahu in the 5th; drinking clouds judgement and hits children, romance and speculation.
Derived: for lagna Capricorn, Rahu in the 12th; drinking brings expenses, sleep trouble and losses abroad.

ambiguity: The caption gives 'न नंबर', read as 'नौ नंबर' (9) because he later says 'नौ नंबर' for Rahu. The 'यूनिफॉर्म' remark in the middle is unreadable and is a separate row.
classical_check: Rahu as karaka of alcohol and intoxicants is classical; Rahu debilitated in Sagittarius follows the Rahu-exalted-in-Gemini school (BPHS puts it in Scorpio).

gist: Aside about 'uniform' and something being set apart on the board; the caption does not make sense.

hindi: यह भाग्य स्थान में बैठा है किस्मत फट जाएगी
says: If Rahu (the sign-9 case) sits in the 9th house, the house of fortune, the person's luck gets wrecked (his phrase: fate is torn apart).
cells_derived_method: The house is fixed at the 9th; the sign Rahu occupies there changes the flavour of the damage: Sagittarius (his debility) is the harshest, other signs act through their lords.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Aries, Rahu in its debility sign Sagittarius in the 9th; the strongest case, with luck, father and guru matters damaged and alcohol making it worse.
Derived: for lagna Aquarius, Rahu in Libra in the 9th; luck breaks through relationships and pleasure habits (Venus-ruled sign).
Derived: for lagna Sagittarius, Rahu in Leo in the 9th; clash with father or authority damages fortune (Sun-ruled sign).

ambiguity: Whether the luck damage needs alcohol is not said; it follows the beer sentence but the condition is only implied.
classical_check: Rahu in the 9th damaging dharma, father and fortune is a classical reading; the alcohol link is his.

hindi: अगर यह मृत्यु स्थान में बैठा है तो जब तक दारू या बियर लोगे साली मौत नहीं आएगी
says: If Rahu sits in the 8th house (house of death), then as long as the person keeps taking liquor or beer, death will not come. Said sarcastically; read as the 8th-house suffering continuing, not as any claim about lifespan.
cells_derived_method: House fixed at the 8th; the sign changes how the habit shows: a hidden compulsion in Scorpio, a restless excess in Sagittarius, escapism in Pisces.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Aries, Rahu in Scorpio in the 8th; drinking becomes a hidden, intense compulsion with sudden upsets.
Derived: for lagna Taurus, Rahu in Sagittarius (his debility) in the 8th; excess and risk-taking with drink, damage shown through belief and luck as well.
Derived: for lagna Leo, Rahu in Pisces in the 8th; drink used for escape and sedation, with the damage kept out of sight.

ambiguity: 'साली मौत नहीं आएगी' is sarcasm and can mean alcohol keeps one suffering without relief or that Rahu-8 delays an end; either way no death or lifespan claim is taken from it.
classical_check: Rahu in the 8th is classically a placement of prolonged or hidden ailment and occult interest; the alcohol link is his.

gist: Chants 'Hari Om' three times as an interjection.
Garbled lines about something being debilitated in the 8th house, 'nich nich uch', and what is found on the net; the caption does not give a clear claim.

hindi: आठवे घर में न नंबर राशि का अल्टरनेट सिचुएशन है ... राहु नौ नंबर यहां है तो ये भाग्य का नाश कर देगा यहां है तो मृत्यु का नाश कर देगा
says: Alternative situation for Rahu with sign 9: the 8th house can also carry sign 9, so Rahu-with-sign-9 may sit in the 9th house, where it destroys fortune, or in the 8th house, where it destroys the 8th-house matters (his phrase: it destroys death). Read as damage to the 8th house themes, not a death prediction.
cells_derived_method: The same planet-sign pair gives two different house results because Sagittarius touches both the 8th and 9th houses in some charts: fortune and dharma damage in the 9th, damage to the 8th themes (hidden matters, sudden change, shared money) when it sits in the 8th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Aries, Sagittarius is the 9th sign; Rahu there destroys fortune, as he says.
Derived: for lagna Taurus, Sagittarius is the 8th sign; Rahu there damages the 8th-house themes, and the alcohol link makes it a hidden, compulsive pattern.

ambiguity: 'न नंबर' is read as 'नौ नंबर' (9). 'यहां है' points at board positions we cannot see. 'मृत्यु का नाश' is odd phrasing, taken as ruin of the 8th house themes.
classical_check: Rahu damaging the 8th and 9th houses is classical; the multi-sign house idea is his own method.

gist: Complains that the whole thing is a big mess, nobody knows what suits whom, and asks whether we want to live or die.

hindi: अगर आपका चंद्रमा एक नंबर या आठ नंबर से लिंक है आप वाइट वाइन मत पियो वोड का मत लो वो वाइट शराब है
says: A Moon linked to sign 1 or sign 8 should avoid white wine and vodka, which he calls white liquor and puts on the Moon's side.
cells_derived_method: Signs fixed at Aries and Scorpio; the house shows where white spirits do their harm: body and mood in the 1st, partnerships in the 7th, social circle and gains in the 11th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Aries, the Moon (4th lord) in the 1st in a Mars sign; white spirits swing mood and the body together.
Derived: for lagna Taurus, a debilitated Moon (3rd lord) in the 7th; white wine in party and partner settings strains the relationship.
Derived: for lagna Capricorn, a debilitated Moon (7th lord) in the 11th; drinking in the social circle damages friendships and gains.

ambiguity: 'वोड का' is read as 'वोडका'. Same sign-1-or-8 reading as before.
classical_check: The Moon as ruler of white and clear things is traditional; the avoid-list is his own.

gist: Rhetorical joke: should a person keep doing this and keep banging his head by going to the astrologer.

hindi: मंगल चार नंबर का है रेड वाइन नहीं पी सकते आप
says: A Mars linked to sign 4 (Cancer) means the person cannot drink red wine.
cells_derived_method: Sign fixed at Cancer (debilitated Mars); the house sets where the red wine hits: the body in the 1st, children and judgement in the 5th, hidden harm in the 8th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Cancer, debilitated Mars (5th and 10th lord) in the 1st; red wine inflames body and temper together.
Derived: for lagna Pisces, debilitated Mars (2nd and 9th lord) in the 5th; drinking affects children, romance and judgement.

hindi: वो धुमक धुमक ढ ढा ढाढा कर देगी आपके ब्लड
says: For a Mars-4 person, red wine will make the blood pound and race (his sound-effect words), disturbing the blood, which Mars governs.
cells_derived_method: Mars as the planet of blood is fixed; the house changes where the disturbance shows: in the 6th as flare-ups and quarrels, in the 2nd as flushed face and sharp speech.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Aquarius, debilitated Mars (3rd and 10th lord) in the 6th; the blood heat shows up as acute flare-ups and fights with rivals after drinking.
Derived: for lagna Gemini, debilitated Mars (6th and 11th lord) in the 2nd; the heat shows in face, throat and sharp speech.

ambiguity: The caption 'धुमक धुमक ढ ढा ढाढा' is a sound effect for pounding or pumping; its exact words are garbled.
classical_check: Mars as karaka of blood is classical.

hindi: का यह छाती पर प्रॉब्लम देगी ब्लड प्रेशर के मरीज हो जाओगे फीमेल है तो ओवरी में सिस्ट हो जाएगी सेक्स लाइफ को खत्म कर देगा मेंसस की प्रॉब्लम हो जाएगी
says: He lists the damage red wine does to a Mars-4 person: chest trouble, high blood pressure, and in women ovarian cysts, a ruined sex life and menstrual problems. These are tradition claims about Mars-governed body areas, not medical diagnoses.
cells_derived_method: The listed outcomes are body areas that follow houses: chest with the 4th, reproductive and sexual matters with the 8th, bed pleasures with the 12th. The house decides which item on his list is the one felt first.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Aries, Mars (lagna lord) debilitated in the 4th; the chest-area complaint he mentions is the likely first sign.
Derived: for lagna Sagittarius, Mars debilitated in the 8th; reproductive and menstrual matters become the weak area.
Derived: for lagna Leo, Mars (4th and 9th lord) debilitated in the 12th; the complaint falls on bed pleasures and sexual life.

ambiguity: Starts mid-sentence with 'का' continuing 'ब्लड का'. 'फीमेल' is taken as a woman's chart; he does not say how a male chart differs.
classical_check: Classical texts give Mars rule over blood, muscles and the reproductive system, which fits; the wine-to-ailment link is his.

gist: Jokes that a man should not drink red wine and should drink wearing black glasses; the rest of the caption about 'red' is garbled.

hindi: अब शुक्र यदि नीच का है छ नंबर राशि थी हमारी य हटा देते हैं छ नंबर य ले रहे हम शुक्र य है या छ नंबर
says: He moves on to Venus: Venus is debilitated in sign 6 (Virgo), and the case he now studies is Venus linked to sign 6.
cells_derived_method: Sign fixed at Virgo (debilitated Venus); the house sets which Venus matter (partnership, money, comfort) is weakened.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Pisces, Venus (3rd and 8th lord) debilitated in the 7th; partnership and sensual life are the weak area.
Derived: for lagna Leo, Venus (3rd and 10th lord) debilitated in the 2nd; money, food and speech are touched.
Derived: for lagna Libra, Venus is the lagna lord debilitated in the 12th; comforts, sleep and expenses become the stress point.

ambiguity: 'हटा देते हैं' is a board action, removing something from the diagram. The sign number 6 is Virgo.
classical_check: Venus debilitated in Virgo is classical.

hindi: अगर पाच नंबर का है तो भी छ में जाने का खतरा है सात नंबर है तो भी छ में जाने का खतरा है
says: Even a Venus placed in sign 5 (Leo) or sign 7 (Libra) carries the risk of slipping into sign 6 (Virgo): neighbouring signs spill into each other when houses are multi-sign.
cells_derived_method: The risk exists for any house where sign 5 or 7 is bordered by sign 6, so it depends on the lagna degree. The house decides which Venus matter picks up the debility flavour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Leo, Venus (3rd and 10th lord) in Leo in the 1st with Virgo (2nd) next door; Venus picks up the debility flavour on speech and money.
Derived: for lagna Taurus, Venus (lagna lord) in the 4th in Leo with Virgo (5th) next door; home comfort gets the debility flavour while children and mind are touched next door.
Derived: for lagna Capricorn, Venus (5th and 10th lord) in its own sign Libra in the 10th with Virgo (9th) next door; career is good but luck and dharma pick up the weak Venus flavour.
Derived: for lagna Aries, Venus (2nd and 7th lord) in its own sign Libra in the 7th with Virgo (6th) next door; marriage can pick up the service-and-dispute flavour of the 6th.

ambiguity: 'जाने का खतरा' could mean the planet shifts by rashi rotation or that sign 6 overlaps the same house; he links it to the multi-sign house idea.
classical_check: Classical D1 keeps a planet in one sign; the spill idea is closest to bhava chalit shifts and is his own statement.

hindi: अगर सात नंबर का शुक्र हो सकता है राशि भी छ काम कर रही हो यहां पर से दृष्टि ले रहा है किसी का
says: A Venus in sign 7 can also act as a sign-6 Venus if sign 6 is also working in that house, or if Venus is receiving an aspect from a planet placed in sign 6 (he says it takes the aspect of someone).
cells_derived_method: Two routes bind Venus in Libra to Virgo: the Virgo sign overlapping the same house, or an aspect arriving from a planet in Virgo. Which houses allow this depends on where the Libra and Virgo borders fall.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Virgo, Venus (2nd and 9th lord) in Libra in the 2nd with the lagna sign Virgo pushing in from the 1st; money and food matters pick up the debility flavour.
Derived: for lagna Scorpio, Venus (7th and 12th lord) in the 12th with Virgo (11th) next door; gains and expenses get confused.
Derived: for lagna Gemini, Venus (5th and 12th lord) in the 5th with Virgo (4th) next door; romance and children are coloured by the home and comfort matters of the 4th.

ambiguity: Who is giving the aspect is not clear ('किसी का'). 'यहां पर से' refers to a board position.
