classical_check: Aspects from a planet are classical; making sign 6 operate on a sign-7 Venus is his method.

gist: Board setup: assumes Venus sits in sign 5 and uses a different colour for it, then drops that case and says he will complicate the example further; the caption of the final clause is garbled.

hindi: यह 11 नंबर में शुक्र बैठा है मान लेते हैं यहां दृष्टि पांच के साथ छ नंबर भी राशि बदल गई है तो शुक्र यहां काम करेगा नीच का हो गया
says: If Venus sits in number 11 and its aspect falls on 5, with sign 6 also rotated into that spot, then Venus works there as a debilitated Venus.
cells_derived_method: Venus in Aquarius casts its 7th aspect on Leo, and if Virgo overlaps that house the aspect carries a weak Venus. The house decides which matter is hit: the aspected house is the 7th from Venus's own house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Aries, Venus (2nd and 7th lord) in the 11th aspects the 5th house Leo with Virgo (6th) spilling in; children and romance get a weak-Venus aspect.
Derived: for lagna Scorpio, Venus (7th and 12th lord) in the 4th aspects the 10th house Leo with Virgo (11th) next door; career picks up the weak-Venus effect.
Derived: for lagna Leo, Venus (3rd and 10th lord) in the 7th aspects the lagna Leo with Virgo (2nd) overlapping; self and speech are touched.

ambiguity: '11 नंबर' could be sign 11 (Aquarius) or house 11. 'पांच के साथ छ' is read as aspect on sign 5 with sign 6 joining by rotation; the board is not visible.
classical_check: Venus aspecting the 7th from itself is classical; becoming debilitated in effect through sign overlap is his idea.

hindi: आप गौ मास खाएंगे तबा हो जाएंगे इसके साथ बीफ नहीं ले सकते आप बीफ
says: A person whose Venus works as debilitated (sign 6) cannot take beef: eating cow meat ruins them ('तबा' read as 'तबाह'). Venus is the planet he links to cow products.
cells_derived_method: Sign fixed at Virgo (debilitated Venus); the house decides where the ruin shows: family and money in the 2nd, service and disputes in the 6th, career in the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Leo, debilitated Venus in the 2nd (family, food); beef at the table damages family relations and savings.
Derived: for lagna Aries, debilitated Venus (2nd and 7th lord) in the 6th; the penalty shows as friction in service and with in-laws.
Derived: for lagna Sagittarius, debilitated Venus (6th and 11th lord) in the 10th; the penalty hits reputation and career standing.

ambiguity: 'तबा' is read as 'तबाह'. He links Venus to beef without saying why. Sensitive topic, recorded as stated.
classical_check: Venus as karaka of cattle and dairy is classical; a beef ban from a debilitated Venus is his claim.

gist: Stresses that this beef and smoking topic is very important and that many people are wandering lost around it.
Pun on 'sea food': it can be eaten as 'don't see food', i.e. without looking at it, and then there is no problem.
Says vodka and white wine are the same for Moon 8 as for Moon 1, repeating the earlier white-spirits rule.

hindi: बियर एक नंबर का शनि हो गया मान लो
says: Beer is the item he pairs with Saturn linked to sign 1 (Aries, Saturn's debilitation sign): such a Saturn makes beer harmful. This is a second planet trigger for beer, besides Rahu-9.
cells_derived_method: Sign fixed at Aries (debilitated Saturn); the house decides where the beer penalty falls: partnership in the 7th, career in the 10th, effort and courage in the 3rd.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Libra, Saturn (4th and 5th lord) debilitated in the 7th; beer strains the partnership.
Derived: for lagna Cancer, Saturn (7th and 8th lord) debilitated in the 10th; beer undermines career standing.
Derived: for lagna Aquarius, Saturn (lagna and 12th lord) debilitated in the 3rd; beer dulls effort, courage and enterprise.

ambiguity: The caption 'बियर एक नंबर का शनि हो गया' is terse; read as 'for Saturn in 1, beer is the item'. The sentence is cut by the next timestamp ('मान लो').
classical_check: Saturn debilitated in Aries is classical; Saturn is also tied to dark and tamasic substances, so a beer link is plausible but not listed.

hindi: लो स्कच विस्की रेड वाइन रेड मीट वाइट मीट बहन है
says: Taking a case where several afflictions stack up, scotch, whisky, red wine, red meat and white meat are all barred together (the caption 'बहन है' is read as 'ban hai').
cells_derived_method: none: he does not say which planets or signs trigger the whole list, so no house or sign dependence can be derived.
ambiguity: 'बहन' is a caption error, most likely 'बैन'. Which planet-sign combination bans the whole list is not stated; it follows the Saturn-1 beer sentence.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: आप नॉनवेज नहीं खाते सपा खत्म मत खाओ बहुत अच्छी बात है इट डन मेक डिफरेंस
says: If you do not eat non-veg anyway, the problem ends there and that is fine; he adds a remark that it 'doesn't make a difference', read as the veg or non-veg label itself not being what matters.
cells_derived_method: none: a general remark about vegetarians, not tied to a house or sign.
ambiguity: 'इट डन मेक डिफरेंस' could mean 'it does make a difference' or 'it doesn't'; read as 'doesn't' because the next sentence says veg versus non-veg is not the issue.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: इसलिए य वेज नॉनवेज का स्यापा नहीं है यह सब ग्रहों का स्यापा है
says: His conclusion: the food restrictions are not about vegetarian versus non-vegetarian ethics; they come from the planets in your own chart.
cells_derived_method: none: a general principle that diet rules are personal and come from the planets, not from a veg or non-veg label.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish does not set diet by planetary affliction in this way; planet-food correspondences exist but not personal bans.

hindi: आपकी लाइफ में आपका ग्रह उस चीज के लिए आपको एलर्जिक बनाता है यदि आप वो लेते हैं तो आप ड ऑन कर रहे हैं आप इसको छोड़ दे
says: A planet in your chart can make you allergic or intolerant to a particular item; if you still take it you are doing yourself harm (the verb is garbled), so give that item up.
cells_derived_method: none: a general statement; the planet and item pairs are given in the other rows.
ambiguity: 'ड ऑन कर रहे हैं' is garbled; it may be 'wrong kar rahe ho' or 'down kar rahe ho'. 'एलर्जिक' is used loosely for any bad reaction.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: वेज नॉनवेज ऐसे लोग हैं जिनको पालक से एलर्जी है ऐसी की तैसी सूर्य का दोष है
says: People who are allergic to spinach have a fault of the Sun (a Sun dosha) behind it. Recorded as his tradition claim, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: none: he does not say what form the Sun dosha takes (debility, Saturn or Rahu contact, house), so no cell can be derived.
ambiguity: 'वेज नॉनवेज ऐसे लोग हैं' is a loose lead-in. 'ऐसी की तैसी' is an expletive and not part of the claim.
classical_check: Differs: spinach is a leafy Mercury-type item classically, so tying its allergy to the Sun is his own link.

hindi: ग्लूटेन के एलर्जी है सूर्य का दोष आटे से एलर्जी दे रहा है बताओ बंदा जाकर का मरे
says: A gluten allergy is also a Sun fault: the Sun is giving the person an allergy to wheat flour; he asks mockingly where such a person is supposed to go. Tradition claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: none: the form of the Sun fault is not given.
ambiguity: 'बंदा जाकर का मरे' is a rhetorical complaint and not a claim about death.
classical_check: Agrees in part: wheat is the Sun's grain in classical correspondences.

hindi: चंद्र शनि मंगल और सूर्य इसका कॉमिनेशन अपसेट होगा आपका ग्लूटेन एलर्जी होगी स्टमक के अंदर
says: When Moon, Saturn, Mars and Sun are upset together as a combination, the person gets a gluten allergy in the stomach. Tradition claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: none: he does not say what 'upset combination' means (conjunction, aspect, joint affliction) or in which houses.
ambiguity: 'कॉमिनेशन अपसेट' does not say how the four planets are related. Read as a second cause for gluten allergy, besides the Sun fault in the previous sentence.
classical_check: Silent as a combination; individually the Moon (digestion, stomach) and Mars (digestive fire) fit classical body assignments.

gist: Mocks the gluten-allergy sufferer: what will you eat, you will spend your whole life searching for food.
Says gluten-free and vegan are new fads; earlier people died because lactose intolerance was unknown, and the vegan diet was made to protect them, but people turn vegan uselessly.

hindi: चंद्रमा आपका बहुत कमाल है आपको डेरी प्रोडक्ट खाने से फायदा देगा आप वीगन वगन पेल रहे हो क्या हो रहा है चंद्रमा को पावर ही नहीं मिल रही
says: If your Moon is very strong, dairy products will benefit you; going vegan starves the Moon of its power, so the Moon cannot deliver. Tradition claim, not dietary advice.
cells_derived_method: He gives no cell for the strong Moon. Taking 'kamaal' as the Moon in its own or exalted sign, the dairy benefit is read through the house: body and mind in the 1st, family wealth in the 2nd, children and intellect in the 5th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Cancer, the Moon is lagna lord in its own sign in the 1st; dairy supports body and mind directly.
Derived: for lagna Aries, the Moon (4th lord) exalted in the 2nd; dairy at the family table supports savings and household comfort.
Derived: for lagna Capricorn, the Moon (7th lord) exalted in the 5th; dairy supports intellect, children and creativity.

ambiguity: 'बहुत कमाल है' is not defined (own sign, exalted or well-aspected). 'वीगन वगन पेल रहे हो' is mocking slang for going vegan.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the Moon as karaka of milk and dairy is classical; the vegan consequence is his.

hindi: आपकी लाइफ के अंदर दिक्कत क्या बन रही है आप ग्रह के अगेंस्ट जा रहे हो ऑटोमेटिक स्थिति खराब होगी ही
says: The real source of trouble in life is acting against your planet's requirements; when you do that your condition automatically gets worse.
cells_derived_method: none: a general principle, not dependent on a particular house or sign.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts as a diet principle; consistent with the general idea of aligning conduct with planetary karakas.

hindi: यह कॉम्प्लिकेटेड है इसलिए जब हम नौवे घर की बात करते हैं जहां आपका इष्ट देखा जाता है
says: The 9th house is the place in the chart where one's Ishta (personal chosen deity) is read.
cells_derived_method: The 9th house sign and its lord colour the type of deity: a Jupiter-ruled sign points to guru or Vishnu-type worship, a Sun-ruled sign to solar worship, a Mars-ruled sign to Hanuman or Kartikeya-type worship (derived using the usual sign-lord convention, not stated by him).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Aries, the 9th is Sagittarius, ruled by Jupiter; the Ishta would lean toward a guru or Vishnu-type deity.
Derived: for lagna Sagittarius, the 9th is Leo, ruled by the Sun; the Ishta would lean toward a solar or Rama-type deity.
Derived: for lagna Pisces, the 9th is Scorpio, ruled by Mars; the Ishta would lean toward Hanuman, Kartikeya or Shakti worship.

ambiguity: 'नौवे घर' is the house here, not a sign.
classical_check: Differs in part: Parashari reads the Ishta devata from the 5th house, and Jaimini from the 12th from the Karakamsa; the 9th is the house of dharma and fortune.

gist: Says the Ishta needs discussing today because it has caused a big mess, and that other topics will keep coming.
Digression: says he will also discuss why he talks so much, that astrology is not understood and only those destined will grasp it, and that yogas will be covered in due course.
Frames the topic: he is taking a universal approach everyone can follow, that grace is needed, and asks grace of which god, to be decided.

hindi: अच्छा यार भगवान के एप्लीकेशन गलत लगी हुई है
says: People have filed their 'application' to God wrongly, meaning they approach the wrong deity, so the grace they want does not arrive.
cells_derived_method: none: a general point about the Ishta, not tied to a house or sign here.
ambiguity: 'एप्लीकेशन' is a metaphor; it could mean the wrong deity was chosen or that the person's own chart has a fault. Read as the wrong deity.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; consistent with the Ishta devata idea.

hindi: हमारी कुंडली में इस भाव में दोष नहीं है यहां रहते हैं भगवान गॉड यह हमारा ईश्वर का खाका है यह है गॉड का खाना ठीक है परमात्मा का भाई यहां इस कुंडली के अंदर ऐसे होता है
says: Pointing at a house on the chart, probably the 9th, he says God lives in this house: it is the chart's blueprint for Ishwar and Paramatma, and he says there is no fault in it.
cells_derived_method: none: a house-level definition; sign effects are covered in the Ishta row.
ambiguity: He says 'इस भाव' while pointing at a board we cannot see; the 9th is inferred from the lines before. 'दोष नहीं है' could be a question or a statement. 'खाना' is read as the house (box) in the chart.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 9th is the house of dharma, guru and fortune; the Ishta is classically read from the 5th or from Karakamsa, so 'God lives in the 9th' is his emphasis.

hindi: हमें देखना आता है चाहे नहीं आता लेकिन य गॉड होता है तो हमारे को अपना इष्ट पता होना चाहिए अगर इष्ट हमें सही पता है तो यार इष्ट का करना क्या है
says: Whether or not we can read the chart, God exists, so each person must know their own Ishta correctly; and once it is known, the next question is what to do with it.
cells_derived_method: none: a general principle, not tied to a house or sign here.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts as stated; knowing the Ishta devata is a classical idea.

gist: Jokes that if we do not know how to worship the Ishta we will make pickle of him.

hindi: इष्ट की साधना करेंगे इंटरनेट ने बता रखा है ओम नमो शिवाय कर लो शिवजी जेब में होंगे ऐसे नहीं होते
says: He warns against generic internet advice such as 'chant Om Namah Shivaya and Shiva will be in your pocket': worship of the Ishta does not work like that, which implies the practice has to be matched to one's own Ishta.
cells_derived_method: none: a general caution about remedies, not tied to a house or sign.
ambiguity: 'शिवजी जेब में होंगे' is mockery of quick-fix chanting. That the practice must match one's own Ishta is an inference from the surrounding lines, not said outright.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; mantra practice matched to the Ishta devata is a traditional idea.

gist: Calls it a big hassle and starts a Crocin tablet comparison that is cut off at the end of this batch.

Medical analogy: a doctor may blame a fever on chest congestion; Crocin or paracetamol only suppresses the fever while the real source lies elsewhere, so it is a temporary time-pass fix, like a generic remedy.
More medicine examples (a cold needing one drug, a stomach infection another); drug names are used only to show that different causes need different treatment.
Says he is only naming medicines, that one can manage without them, and that this remedy approach is free; no medical advice is recorded.

hindi: हमें पता है कि हमारे इष्ट जो है वो शिवजी है तो जाप करने का हमें जितनी अकल है यही पता है ओम नमः शिवाय ओम नमः शिवाय
says: He describes the usual do-it-yourself remedy: a person who believes his ishta (favourite deity) is Shiva just chants Om Namah Shivaya, the only mantra he knows, and treats it as a one-size-fits-all fix without checking the chart, much like taking a common painkiller.
ambiguity: He calls this approach 'universal' (यूनिवर्सल); it is unclear whether he means one-size-fits-all or a mantra anyone can use.
classical_check: Classical mantra texts accept ishta-devata japa as normal worship; he does not dispute the practice here, only its effect (next row).

gist: Joke that the Mahamrityunjaya mantra is far too long and nobody wants to bother with it, so people stay with Om Namah Shivaya.

hindi: ओम नम ओम नमः शिवाय से कुछ ना होता अगर आपके इष्ट सिद्ध नहीं हुए
says: Chanting Om Namah Shivaya gives no result if your ishta has not been established (siddha) for you; believing in a deity is not enough until that deity is actually the right, accomplished one for you.
ambiguity: 'इष्ट सिद्ध नहीं हुए' can mean the deity was never perfected through long sadhana, or that the correct ishta was never identified and installed; the following lines (find the right ishta, then install it) favour the second reading.
classical_check: Mantra shastra says a mantra bears fruit only after initiation and purascharana (siddhi), so this agrees in general.

gist: Rhetorical question voicing the audience's confusion: so what is one actually supposed to do with the ishta, it is not clear.

hindi: इष्ट को ना हम एक काम करते हैं घर के एक स्पेसिफिक एरिया में रखते हैं वरुण का स्थान है जो पिछली क्लास में हमने डिस्कस किया ईष्ट की मूर्ति को वहां रख देते हैं
says: Remedy: instead of chanting, place the idol of your ishta in one specific part of the home, Varuna's place that was covered in the previous class (shown a few lines later to be the west area), and just leave it there.
cells_derived_method: none; this is a direction-in-the-house (vastu) remedy and is not house-and-sign dependent as stated.
ambiguity: 'Varuna ka sthan' is a zone of the home, not a kundali house; Varuna is Neptune in his 12-planet scheme, but he does not repeat that here, and west is confirmed only in a later line.
classical_check: Vastu names Varuna as lord of the west, which agrees; but classical vastu puts the puja area in the north-east (Ishana), so keeping the ishta idol in the west differs from the usual rule.

hindi: गणेश जी है मान लो हमारे इष्ट केतु केतु की प्लेसमेंट है यहां और केतु अच्छा है शुभ है कैसे है वो सब बात करेंगे तो हमने गणेश जी की मूर्ति
says: Worked example for the idol remedy: suppose the chart's ishta is Ganesh ji, whom he ties to Ketu, with Ketu well placed and benefic; how a good Ketu is judged is postponed to later, and the Ganesh idol is the one to install.
cells_derived_method: Whether Ketu is benefic depends on its house and sign, which he defers. By classical logic Ketu does best in the upachaya houses 3, 6 and 11 and in moksha positions such as the 12th, and when its sign lord is strong; it is a harder fit in the 1st or 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in the 12th in Pisces sits in the house and sign of moksha and detachment, a clear benefic case, so Ganesh as ishta would be well supported.
Derived: Ketu in the 6th in Scorpio, an upachaya house in Mars's sign, tends to cut down enemies, debts and disputes, another benefic placement.
Derived: Ketu in the 7th in Cancer brings detachment into partnership and home life, so it is not the easy 'shubh' case he describes; it would need support from a strong Moon or Jupiter.

ambiguity: 'यहां' (here) points to a chart on the board that we cannot see; 'ishta = Ganesh = Ketu' is an assumed example ('मान लो'), not a stated rule for every chart.
classical_check: Navagraha texts give Chitragupta (with Brahma) as Ketu's deity, while the Ganesha-Ketu tie is a widespread popular and tantric link; Ketu being good in 3, 6 and 11 is classical.

hindi: को लेकर के गणेश जी की मूर्ति स्पेसिफिक यह मोटा पेट होना चाहिए नहीं नंबर नहीं आ रहे अभी अभी नंबर का तो खेल बहुत लंबा है
says: Take a Ganesh idol and do not worry about a specific belly size or shape; he refuses to enter exact numbers now, saying the numbers game (a numeric method for such details) is very long and is left for a later stage.
ambiguity: 'नंबर नहीं आ रहे' can mean 'the numbers are not coming to mind' or 'we are not going into numbers now'; it is also unclear whether 'numbers' means idol proportions, mantra counts or his own numeric method.
classical_check: Jyotish texts are silent on idol proportions; shilpa and pratima texts do give them, but he does not use them.

hindi: गणेश जी का पेट इतना निकला होना चाहिए सूंड बड़ी होनी चाहिए लेफ्ट मुड़ हो राइट मुड़ी हो कितनी डिग्री मुड़ हो हे भगवान गणेश जी से पूछना पड़ेगा यह है जो पागलपन है आपके अंदर आस्था चाहिए
says: He ridicules over-precise idol rules (how big the belly, how long the trunk, left or right turn, how many degrees) as madness; what the remedy needs is faith (astha), not iconographic exactness.
classical_check: Differs from the puja tradition, where left-trunk and right-trunk Ganesha carry different worship rules; Jyotish texts are silent.

hindi: तो भगवान अहम ब्रह्मास्मि हमारी चेतना के अंतर्गत चलते हैं
says: God, in the sense of Aham Brahmasmi, works inside our own consciousness, so what a deity does for you depends on your inner awareness and belief and not on the outer form of the idol.
ambiguity: The link to the previous line (faith) is inferred from the flow; the line is short and leads straight into a joke.
classical_check: Agrees with Advaita Vedanta (Aham Brahmasmi), but this is philosophy and not a Jyotish rule.

gist: Joke that the soul lives in the liver and does not leave even after drinking liquor.
Argues liquor is not a bad thing because homeopathic medicines and cough syrups are made in alcohol, and says our misconception is thinking liquor is dirty; this is an opinion, not advice to drink.
Tells listeners they may simply not drink if they do not want to, so long as they do not brand it a sin.

hindi: यह पाप है तुमने यह कर दिया पाप है तुम यह सोचना बंद करो तुमने पाप पुण्य की संज्ञा में डटी ऑन कर दी है आपका मुन्ना शनि डिस्टर्ब हो जाएगा
says: Stop thinking in terms of sin; if you label things as sin or virtue you switch on a 'dirty' tag inside yourself, and this disturbs your 'Munna', which he names together with Saturn, meaning the raw base instinct of the person.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना' is his pet word for the base instinct or inner child; its identity with Saturn is read from 'मुन्ना शनि' and the next lines on Saturn and the root chakra. 'डटी' is the English word 'dirty' in Devanagari.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn as karaka of restriction and guilt is a loose fit, but sin-labelling as a Saturn disturbance is his own idea.

hindi: शनि के पास सारी माया है शनि के पास लक्ष्मी है
says: Saturn holds all of maya (the pull of the material world) and Lakshmi (wealth); he presents Saturn as the owner of material resources and not only a planet of hardship.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's wealth role is coloured by the house (which resource: 2nd savings, 4th property, 11th gains) and by the sign: Saturn in Libra, Capricorn or Aquarius gives stable accumulation, while in Aries it strains resources.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in its own sign in the 2nd would make wealth a slow, disciplined accumulation, with savings, family assets and speech staying stable.
Derived: exalted Saturn in the 11th would give large, steady gains through networks and long-term business, Lakshmi arriving late but in volume.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in the 4th would make property and domestic comfort a strain, so maya shows up as a burden of upkeep.

ambiguity: 'माया' can mean wealth or illusion; both readings fit his next lines on the earth and the root chakra.
classical_check: Differs: classically Jupiter is the karaka of wealth and Venus of Lakshmi and comforts; Saturn gives gains mainly through labour and the 10th and 11th (Capricorn, Aquarius).

gist: Passing mention that a separate class exists under the name Shani Dev.

hindi: धरती के गर्भ से निकला हुआ सब कुछ शनि के पास है
says: Everything that comes out of the womb of the earth (minerals, metals, oil, coal, things dug from the ground) belongs to Saturn.
cells_derived_method: The earth-derived theme of Saturn shifts with the house (4th land and wells, 10th career in extraction or construction, 8th buried or hidden assets) and the sign's element and ruler.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 4th in Aquarius links land, wells, groundwater and underground resources to home and property gains.
Derived: Saturn in the 10th in Libra points to a career dealing in earth-derived goods such as construction material, oil or real-estate contracts.
Derived: Saturn in the 8th in Taurus can show hidden, buried or inherited land and metal assets that surface late.

ambiguity: 'सब कुछ' probably means all mined or earth-derived things; he gives no item list.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is the classical karaka of iron, oil, coal, minerals and what lies underground.

hindi: और मूलाधार चक्र कुंडलिनी वहीं से शुरुआत हो रही है वहीं से पंप होती है
says: Continuing from Saturn, the Muladhara (root) chakra is where Kundalini starts and from where the energy is pumped upward; so Saturn is the planet of the root, the base of the life-force.
ambiguity: 'वहीं' (there) points back to Saturn from the previous sentence; Saturn is not named in this particular line.
classical_check: Mixed: modern chakra-astrology links Muladhara to Saturn, Mars or Ketu; classical Jyotish texts do not map chakras at all.

hindi: आपको कोई चीज को गलत अच्छा नहीं कहना है वह है या नहीं
says: Do not call anything wrong or good; only ask whether it exists or not (a fact-based, non-judgmental stance), because moral labels create the disturbance he just described.
ambiguity: 'वह है या नहीं' is terse; it may mean 'does the thing exist or not' as the only test.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish texts; it is his psychological stance.

hindi: अगर माइंड ये कहता है मुन्ना तो बोलो मुन्ना कह रहा है मुन्ना को गुरु के पास ले जाएंगे ट्रेंड करेंगे मुन्ना से बातें करो उससे सेटिंग करो यह सीखो
says: When the mind urges something, say 'Munna is saying this' rather than obeying or condemning it; take Munna to a guru, train him, talk to him and reach a settlement with him; this is the skill to learn.
ambiguity: 'Munna' is read as the base instinct he tied to Saturn two lines earlier; that Saturn link is inferred, not repeated here.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn as a planet to be trained through discipline matches classical Saturn symbolism loosely.

hindi: नहीं तो आप को प्रेम में कमी आएगी हर चीज में डटी आ जाएगी
says: If the inner instinct is not handled this way, love will become scarce in your life and a 'dirty' feeling will creep into everything.
cells_derived_method: none; a psychological consequence not tied to a house or sign (Venus or the 7th would be my own guess and he does not say it).
ambiguity: 'प्रेम में कमी' could mean love received or love felt; the dirty feeling is again the English word 'dirty'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो आपने वरुण के स्थान में डब फ में गणपति की मूर्ति रख देनी है
says: Concrete instruction: put the Ganpati idol in Varuna's place, which he marks with a garbled letter code that most likely stands for the west sector of the home.
ambiguity: 'डब फ' is garbled and is probably 'W' for west, because the next line says 'वेस्ट के इलाके'.
classical_check: West as Varuna's direction is standard vastu; idol placement in the west rather than the north-east is not the classical default.

hindi: ध्यान सिर्फ इतना रहेगा कि गणेश जी वहां पर जो है वेस्ट के इलाके के अंदर जो एंटी एलिमेंट्स है कॉपर के नहीं होने चाहिए एलुमिनियम के नहीं हो तो बहुत अच्छा है चल सकते हैं
says: The only caution: in the west zone the idol should not be of an 'anti-element' material, so no copper; aluminium is best avoided too but is tolerable.
ambiguity: The last clause can mean 'better if not aluminium, but it is acceptable' or 'no aluminium is great, it can pass'; 'anti-element' is not defined, probably a material whose element opposes the zone, but he does not say.
classical_check: Silent in classical vastu; copper is normally welcome in puja vessels, so this ban looks like his own rule.

hindi: गणपति पीतल के चल जाएंगे आपके गणेश जी मान लो किसी और धातु के नॉर्मल है जैसे मिक्सड धातु होते हैं प्लास्टिक इत्यादि है वो सब चलेंगे पेपर में ऐसे होता है वह चलेंगे
says: Allowed idol materials in the west: brass is fine, any other ordinary metal, mixed-metal alloys, plastic and similar, and even paper images are acceptable.
classical_check: Silent; traditional texts prefer metal or stone idols for installation, so plastic and paper are a relaxation.

hindi: तो गणेश जी आपके वहां पर हमने रख दिए और वह कुछ नहीं कर रहे अब गणेश जी की दिया बत्ती धूप करना नहीं
says: Once the idol has been placed there nothing further is needed: no lamp, no incense and no routine worship for Ganesh ji; the installed idol itself is the remedy.
ambiguity: 'वह कुछ नहीं कर रहे' can mean 'he does nothing' or 'you do nothing more'; either way the next phrase rules out lamp and incense.
classical_check: Differs from standard puja practice, where lamp, incense and offerings are routine.

hindi: आपको इष्ट की साधना नहीं आती कुछ मत करो गणपति वहां है काफी है
says: If you do not know how to do sadhana of your ishta, do nothing at all; the idol being present there is enough.
classical_check: Differs from mantra shastra, which prescribes japa and ritual; consistent with his own no-ritual approach.

hindi: आप क्या करते हो अरे पिताजी माला लाओ फूल लाओ फूल चढ़ाओ दिया बत्ती करो कुछ नहीं करते हम पिताजी पड़े हैं काफी है उनकी सेवा ध्यान दे लिया हो गया
says: Analogy: the installed ishta is like aged parents lying in a room; you do not order them to fetch a rosary, offer flowers or light a lamp, you just give them some care and attention and that is enough, so the idol needs presence and care rather than ritual.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish texts; it is an everyday analogy for his no-ritual remedy.

hindi: आपके मन में स् है तो आप प्यार कर लोगे सेवा कर लोगे नहीं तो कुछ नहीं करोगे
says: Whether you tend the idol or the parent depends on the feeling inside: if there is affection you will love and serve naturally, and if there is none you will do nothing, so feeling is the real driver and not ritual.
ambiguity: 'स्' is a cut-off word, likely 'स्नेह' (affection) or 'श्रद्धा' (reverence).
classical_check: Silent; bhava (devotional feeling) over ritual is a common bhakti theme.

hindi: ऐसे गणपति को जाकर के डर डर के पूजा नहीं करनी आप डर के इष्ट की साधना कर रहे हो
says: Do not worship Ganpati, or any ishta, out of fear: going to the idol anxiously and doing puja in fright of what might happen is the wrong way to do it.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish texts; bhakti traditions also prefer love over fear in worship, so this is consistent.

hindi: आपके नाइंथ हाउस कभी एक्टिवेट नहीं होगा
says: Ishta sadhana done out of fear will never activate the 9th house, the house of dharma, luck and grace.
cells_derived_method: The 9th house means dharma, fortune, father, guru and higher learning; the sign on the 9th decides which of these themes stays dormant and how it would have shown.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: with Leo on the 9th, a dormant 9th would show as missing pride-giving fortune and weak backing from father or authority figures.
Derived: with Pisces on the 9th, a naturally devotional sign stays unused, so guru grace and spiritual calling stay quiet while fear drives the practice.
Derived: with Capricorn on the 9th, luck stays effort-and-delay based, and fearful worship does not unlock the reward this 9th would otherwise give.

ambiguity: 'Activate' is undefined: it could mean the 9th house giving results, or its period being triggered; the numbers are house numbers counted from the lagna, not signs.
classical_check: Agrees that the 9th is the house of dharma and grace; the claim that fearful worship blocks it is not in the classical texts.

hindi: आपका आठवा छठा बारवा और तीसरा एक्टिवेट होगा
says: In place of the 9th, fear-based worship activates the 8th, 6th, 12th and 3rd houses of the chart.
cells_derived_method: An activated house brings its own topic, tinted by the sign on it and that sign's ruler, so the same activation looks different in different cells.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an active 8th in Scorpio would bring sudden crises, secrecy and obstacles of a Mars kind, such as abrupt upheavals.
Derived: an active 6th in Sagittarius tends toward disputes with advisers or institutions, legal wrangles and over-promised debts.
Derived: an active 12th in Gemini would drain money through trade, travel, communication costs and scattered spending.
Derived: an active 3rd in Leo would show ego clashes with siblings and neighbours and misplaced bravado.

ambiguity: He numbers houses; they are read as house numbers from the lagna, not signs; 'बारवा' is the 12th.
classical_check: The 6th, 8th and 12th are the classical dusthanas, which agrees; the 3rd is an upachaya and the 8th from the 8th, so listing it as bad is only partly classical.

hindi: यह खराब खतरनाक एरिया है यह मृत्यु का मृत्यु भय चोट कष्ट डर भय बीमारी परेशानी कोर्ट कचहरी पैसा वेस्ट ये करते हैं
says: He calls these four houses bad, dangerous areas whose topics are death, fear of death, injury, suffering, fear, illness, trouble, court cases and waste of money.
cells_derived_method: He lists topics without matching them house by house; classical mapping: 8th for death, fear of death, hurt and sudden trouble; 6th for illness, litigation and enemies; 12th for losses and money waste; 3rd as the 8th from the 8th (injury, effort-borne trouble).
ambiguity: The list is not assigned to individual houses; 'वेस्ट' is the English word 'waste' (spent money), not the west direction.
classical_check: Agrees for the 6th, 8th and 12th; the 3rd as a trouble house is only partly classical.

gist: Repeats that one should not worship Ganpati out of fear and adds that this awareness is a very important thing in life that must be known.
Caption is garbled: something about homeopathy and allopathy doctors failing and then some treatment working; the intended meaning cannot be read.
Announcement that later he will also explain how allopathy and Ayurveda work in a chart; no rule is given here.
Audience-style question 'sir, where does this point come from?' voiced inside the lecture.

hindi: आप ऐसी कुंडली में योग होते हैं कि आप ठीक ही ज्ञान से होंगे आप झाड़ा लग के ठीक होंगे
says: Some kundalis carry yogas (not named) under which relief comes only through knowledge or spiritual healing (jhaada, a ritual sweeping-off) and not through conventional treatment; this is a tradition claim about chart indications and not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: none; the yoga is not named, so no house or sign can be derived.
ambiguity: 'ठीक ही ज्ञान से' is garbled (maybe 'ठीक सिर्फ ज्ञान से'); 'ज्ञान' may mean spiritual knowledge or a knowledgeable healer.
classical_check: Classical texts have daiva-vyapashraya remedies (mantra, japa, charity) for karmic troubles but no named yoga for jhaada healing; nothing here is a medical diagnosis.

gist: Repeats that in such yogas you would not be cured by homeopathy or allopathy doctors but by jhaada, and that these yogas exist too.

hindi: अगर वो आपने जान लिया तो पूरी जिंदगी इतना सही जान लो यही पॉइंटर लेकर आप किसी बंदे से मिल लो
says: If you learn this one thing (your correct ishta and how it works) it serves you for a lifetime; carry this pointer to an astrologer and check it with him.
ambiguity: 'किसी बंदे से' (some person) is taken to mean an astrologer, though he does not say so; 'वो' refers back to the ishta idea.
classical_check: Silent; classically ishta is chart-derived and should be confirmed by a competent astrologer.

hindi: समझ लो सही नहीं मिला घूमते रहो फीस देते रहो जिस दिन कोटा पूरा हो जाएगा कोटा क्लास देखना कोटा पूरा हो जाएगा सही बंदा मिल जाएगा
says: If the first astrologer you meet is wrong, keep going and keep paying fees; the right person turns up only on the day your 'quota' (of wandering or learning) is complete, an idea he covers in a separate Quota class.
ambiguity: 'कोटा' is not defined here; it is read as a karmic or experience quota whose details sit in another class.
classical_check: Silent; it loosely parallels prarabdha karma deciding when a teacher arrives.

gist: Once the right person is found, he says to make a set of about ten rules (garbled) for life and enjoy it; general life advice.
Restates that the Ganesh idol is simply to be kept there, whether or not any worship is done.
Food analogy: with twenty dishes on the table you take about four and your stomach is full, meaning a few essentials suffice.
Personal remark that for the last twenty years he was not interested in teaching this class.
Says there is heavy pressure from students behind him to teach this, that devotees will understand it bit by bit, and that he will do it if God and Munna allow.
Personal remark that otherwise he keeps running on God-consciousness, whose taste and joy is different.

hindi: इसे समझना नहीं जानकारी है कि आप अपने इष्ट को एक बार जान ले किसी से पूछ के फिर उसको स्थापित करके छोड़ दो
says: Do not try to understand all of this; the only information you need is your ishta: find it once by asking a knowledgeable person, then install it (in the home area described) and leave it alone.
ambiguity: 'इसे समझना नहीं जानकारी है' is slightly garbled; read as 'it is not about understanding, it is information'.
classical_check: Differs from usual practice of continuing daily worship; consistent with his no-ritual approach.

hindi: अब कहते हैं हमारे इष्ट तो शंकर जी है प्यार तो हमें कृष्ण जी से प्रॉब्लम आप कृष्ण भजन करो हमें तो शंकर जी को मैं रखना है
says: Objection and answer: if the chart's ishta is Shankar ji but your love goes to Krishna, you may keep doing Krishna bhajan out of love, while Shankar ji, the chart's ishta, is the one installed in the home.
ambiguity: 'हमें तो शंकर जी को मैं रखना है' does not say clearly who keeps Shankar ji; 'प्रॉब्लम' may be the objector's word or his.
classical_check: Classical practice also separates the chart-based ishta devata from personal bhakti or the family deity, so this agrees in spirit.

hindi: सबके अलग होते सबके अलग होते हैं इष्ट मतलब स्पेसिफिक देवता जो कुंडली कहती है
says: Definition: ishta means the specific deity that the kundali indicates, and it differs from person to person, so it is not simply the god one prefers.
cells_derived_method: He does not say here which house, planet or sign gives the ishta; classically the 5th house and its lord, or the planet in the 12th from Karakamsha (Jaimini), is used. That is my pointer, not his statement.
classical_check: Agrees that the ishta devata is chart-derived (Jaimini: 12th from Karakamsha; Parashari practice: 5th and 9th houses and their lords).

hindi: अन्यथा आप निराकार को पूजो कोई जरूरत ही नहीं है
says: If you would rather not deal with a specific deity, worship the formless (nirakar) instead; there is no need for any particular deity at all.
ambiguity: 'कोई जरूरत ही नहीं है' may mean no need for a deity, or no need for the whole idol exercise.
classical_check: Agrees with the nirguna upasana tradition of Vedanta; Jyotish remedy texts mostly assume a saguna deity.

gist: Joke that atheists have a great time because they are free of complications.

hindi: डॉक्टर साहब विटामिन बी कम है कि डी कम है सी मल्टीविटामिन खा ले वाओ सब जो कम है वो भर गया बॉडी में जो वेस्ट है वो मल मूत्र के द्वारा बाहर होते हैं
says: Analogy (not a medical claim): a multivitamin fills whatever is lacking without testing which vitamin is short, and the excess leaves the body; he seems to mean the installed ishta works the same way, supplying what the person lacks without diagnosing each weakness.
ambiguity: The link from this analogy to the ishta idol is inferred from context; he does not state it in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent; classical remedy texts usually match the remedy to a specific afflicted planet, so a catch-all remedy differs.

hindi: वाइफ है हस्बैंड है दो बच्चे हैं चारों के अलग-अलग इ है तो कौन सा इ कर ये भी आएगी बात अभी
says: A family of husband, wife and two children has four different ishtas, so the open question is whose ishta goes into the home; he says this question will come up and be answered later.
ambiguity: 'इ' is cut off and is read as 'इष्ट'; the answer is not given in this slice.
classical_check: Silent; classically the ishta belongs to each individual's own chart.

gist: Transitional remark that Ganesh ji will now come to that place; the slice ends mid-thought.

hindi: अब गणेश जी आपने रख दिए आपके रखने से वही काफी है
says: Once Ganesh ji is installed in your worship place, that placement alone is enough for you and no further deities are needed to make the ishta work. Ganesh is tied to Ketu in his scheme, which he states a few lines later.
ambiguity: 'वही काफी है' could mean Ganesh alone is sufficient, or that mere placement without elaborate ritual is sufficient. Ganesh being this person's ishta is assumed from the example that follows.
classical_check: Silent on sufficiency of one image. Ketu with Ganesh is a popular remedial pairing, not the Parashari adhidevata of Ketu.

hindi: अब हस्बैंड वाइफ और बच्चे हैं वाइफ के इष्ट जो है पता लगाओ राम है तो एक राम भी रख दो
says: In a family worship corner every member has a separate ishta. Find the wife's ishta on its own, and if hers turns out to be Ram, add Ram beside the husband's deity. The children are listed as further members who need the same check.
ambiguity: How the wife's ishta is found is not said here; no chart point or method is named.
classical_check: Individual ishta-devata from the 5th/9th house or Karakamsa is classical. A combined family corner built from each member's ishta is a modern practice and classical texts are silent on it.

hindi: आपको वरुण देवता पूजा पाठ भगवान के स्थान पर कितने मर्जी देवता रखो अगर आप उससे जुड़े हैं वह आपके लिए काम करेगा
says: At the home place of worship you may keep as many deities as you like, provided you are personally connected to each one. A deity you are genuinely connected to will work for you.
ambiguity: 'आपको वरुण देवता' is garbled. Varun (Neptune in his scheme) may be an example deity or a caption error. 'जुड़े हैं' (connected) is not defined as a chart test.
classical_check: Keeping many deities at home is ordinary Hindu practice. The connected-means-works test is his own criterion and classical texts are silent on it.

hindi: अब मुद्दा एकय आता है कि गलती से नेगेटिव इस्ट रख दिया यह हो गया लफड़ा मान लो नेगेटिव इस्ट की स्थिति बन गई
says: The real danger in home worship is not too few deities but installing a negative (anti) ishta by mistake, a deity that is hostile to your own chart's ishta. He calls this the source of the mess.
ambiguity: 'नेगेटिव इष्ट' is not defined here. The next lines give an example with Ketu and Mercury in Pisces.
classical_check: Classical texts speak of ishta devata and of pacifying malefic planets but have no anti-ishta term. This is Gautam's own construct.

hindi: जिस ग्रह के कारण से आप गणपति को पूजते हो केतु वह 12 नंबर राशि के अंदर पावर पकड़ता है उसी 12 नंबर के अंदर बुध नेगेटिव है वह है दुर्गा
says: Worked example of an anti-ishta pair. Ganapati belongs to Ketu, and Ketu gains power in sign number 12 (Pisces). In that same sign Mercury is negative (weak) and Mercury's deity is Durga. So when Ketu is strong and Mercury is weak in Pisces, Ganesh and Durga are opposed deities.
cells_derived_method: The sign is fixed (Pisces) but the house changes with the lagna: Pisces is the Hth house when lagna sign number = 12-H+1. The same Ketu-Mercury clash therefore lands on a different life area per lagna (1st Pisces lagna self, 4th Sagittarius lagna home, 7th Virgo lagna partner, 10th Gemini lagna career, 12th Aries lagna loss and foreign), and the houses Mercury rules for that lagna decide what the weak Mercury damages.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo lagna (12-7+1=6). Mercury is lagna lord and 10th lord, weak in the 7th with Ketu, so the Ganesh-Durga clash would be felt in partnership and marriage, which fits his remark that Durga suits the wife.
Derived: Gemini lagna (12-10+1=3). Mercury is lagna lord and 4th lord, weak in the 10th, so the clash would show in career and public standing with the self-ruler weakened.
Derived: Aries lagna (12-12+1=1). Mercury rules the 3rd and 6th, weak in the 12th, so the clash shows in expenses, sleep and foreign matters; a 6th lord in the 12th also has partial relief logic.
Derived: Sagittarius lagna (12-4+1=9). Mercury rules the 7th and 10th, weak in the 4th, so home, mother and peace of mind carry the strain, and the weak lord pulls on marriage and career.

ambiguity: '12 नंबर राशि' is read as sign number 12 = Pisces, in line with the series numbering, but he could mean the 12th house. 'बुध नेगेटिव' is read as debilitated; he does not use that word. Mercury = Durga is his own mapping.
classical_check: Mercury is debilitated in Pisces, which agrees. Ketu in Pisces is treated as own or strong by some texts, partly agreeing. Mercury's classical deity is Vishnu (Buddha avatar) so Mercury = Durga differs, though some popular traditions use it.

hindi: अब आपने गणेश और दुर्गा इकट्ठा रख दिए वर्ण में तो लीफाई इफेक्ट हो जाएगा आपकी लाइफ में प्लस भी बहुत होगा और माइनस भी बहुत होगा
says: If both Ganesh and Durga are installed together for someone whose chart sets them against each other, results get magnified in both directions. Life will show very large gains and very large losses together instead of a calm middle.
ambiguity: 'लीफाई इफेक्ट' is cut in the caption and could be 'amplify' or 'nullify'. 'बहुत प्लस और बहुत माइनस' supports amplify, which is the reading used. 'वर्ण में' is unclear.
classical_check: Silent. Mixing hostile deities causing swings is his claim; classical texts give no such rule.

hindi: सोचो कितना कठिन है ये सर अगर जुड़े यहां से सिर्फ गणपति से वह काम तो करेगा लेकिन दुर्गा काम करेंगी दुर्गा काम करेगी वह पत्नी को सूट करती है बच्चे को कोई और सूट करता है
says: If you stay connected only to Ganapati, that deity works for you. Durga also acts, but she suits the wife, and the child may need yet another deity. So each family member needs a matched deity and one shared puja corner cannot serve everyone.
ambiguity: 'दुर्गा काम करेगी' may warn that Durga acts against the husband, or may only say she works for the wife. Both readings fit the caption.
classical_check: Silent. Matching a separate deity to each family member from their own chart is his method.

hindi: उससे जुड़ भी गए कि नहीं फिर मैं दुर्गा माता की भी कर ही लूं उस दिन से बैंड बजनी शुरू हो जाएगी आपको समझ नहीं आएगा क्या हो रहा है
says: If a person already tied to Ganapati decides to also worship Durga on the side, trouble begins from that very day and the person will not understand why things are going wrong. He gives this as the typical result of adding an anti-ishta deity.
ambiguity: 'उससे जुड़ भी गए कि नहीं' is unclear: connected to Ganapati or not. 'उस दिन से' is a loose day-of-start claim, not a measurable delay.
classical_check: Silent. Trouble starting on the day of adding a deity is his claim only.

hindi: तो आपका जो इष्ट है ये निर्धारित करके चलना है कैसे इसलिए घर में मंदिर की आवश्यकता नहीं बाहर होता है मंदिर अपने वाले इष्ट को पकड़ो
says: Fix your own ishta first and then move forward on that alone. For this reason a full temple inside the house is not needed because temples exist outside; just hold on to your own ishta instead of collecting many deities.
ambiguity: This seems to contradict his earlier line that any number of deities can be kept in the puja place if you are connected. It probably means a big home mandir is unnecessary, not that no deity may be kept.
classical_check: Differs from mainstream Hindu practice and Vastu, which recommend a puja room or altar (north-east) at home. He treats the home mandir as optional.

hindi: अगर कोइंसिडेंटली ऐसा हो गया इसमें नवांश कुंडली आती है एक उसमें आपको खुद का ही इष्ट सूट ना करे ऐसा भी होता है
says: The navamsa chart enters the ishta question. Even your own ishta, read from the main chart, can fail to suit you when the navamsa disagrees, so one chart alone does not settle which deity is safe.
ambiguity: 'कोइंसिडेंटली ऐसा हो गया' means 'if this happens by chance', referring to an accidental anti-ishta. Which chart point gives the ishta is not named.
classical_check: Using the navamsa for deity choice is in line with Jaimini's Karakamsa method (Atmakaraka in navamsa). The anti-ishta clash between the two charts is his own idea.

hindi: मान लो यहां पर आपका गॉड कॉन्शसनेस में आपको यहां हनुमान आपके इष्ट बनते हैं और दूसरी कुंडली नवांश कुंडली यह कहती है के विष्णु इष्ट है तो ये दोनों एंटी हैं
says: Example of a conflict between charts. The first chart, which he links to god-consciousness, gives Hanuman as ishta while the navamsa gives Vishnu. He calls these two deities anti to each other, so the person holds two ishtas that clash.
ambiguity: Which chart point gives each deity (5th house, 9th house, Atmakaraka) is not stated. The first chart is taken as D1 from context but could be another. No planets are named for Hanuman or Vishnu.
classical_check: Differs from tradition, where Hanuman is Rama's (Vishnu's avatar) devotee and so aligned, not hostile. His anti is planet-logic based and not stated here.

hindi: तो आप किसकी पूजा करोगे तो आप उनका कॉमन देवता निकालो आप भैरव की पूजा कर सकते हो आप शिव की पूजा कर सकते हो दोनों को हटा दो
says: When the two charts give opposing ishtas such as Hanuman and Vishnu, drop both and worship a deity common to the pair that neither opposes, for example Bhairav or Shiva.
ambiguity: How the common deity is derived is not stated; Bhairav and Shiva are given only as examples.
classical_check: Silent. Bhairav is a fierce form of Shiva, so the two examples are one family.

hindi: कुछ लोग लाइफ के अंदर जरा सा काम करके रॉकेट की तरह उठते हैं क्योंकि उनका एंटी इस्ट नहीं है यह भी परमात्मा ने बनाया है
says: Some people rise like a rocket after very little effort because their chart has no anti-ishta conflict. He treats this absence of conflict as something built in by God.
ambiguity: He does not say how to tell from the chart that a person has no anti-ishta.
classical_check: Silent. Effortless rise from a conflict-free ishta is his explanation; classical texts attribute it to yogas and strong dashas instead.

hindi: कुछ लोग बहुत मेहनत करके थोड़ा करते हैं क्योंकि एंटी इस्ट है अपने अपने ही देवता के पास भी एप्लीकेशन ढंग से नहीं लगा सकते उसका साइड इफेक्ट साथ मिलता है
says: The opposite case: people who work very hard for small results have an anti-ishta in the chart. They cannot even file their request properly with their own deity because the conflict adds a side effect to every prayer.
ambiguity: 'अपने अपने ही देवता' is read as 'their very own deity'. 'एप्लीकेशन' is a metaphor for prayer or request.
classical_check: Silent. Classical texts explain hard work with little result by weak or afflicted houses and lords, not by anti-ishta.

hindi: इष्ट कौन है इष्ट की पूजा करें पूजा करना जाने पूजा पर क्लासेस ऑलरेडी ई पड़ी है पूजा कैसे करते हैं जब तक आप ये नहीं जानेंगे इन चक्रों में ना फसे
says: Because the ishta question is so tangled, the practical advice is simply to worship your ishta, and first to learn how to perform puja properly (he notes his puja classes already exist). Until the method is learned, do not get caught in endless ishta-hunting loops.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical bhakti and puja traditions stress correct procedure before results.

gist: Doctor-patient joke: a patient keeps instructing the surgeon during the operation, the doctor says put him to sleep first, the patient dies and then blames the doctor; used to show that one should trust the expert.
Says going to a new doctor or a new astrologer every time is gambling, and the gamble resolves only when one fully dedicates oneself to one person.
Takes a guarantee that death comes only when it is written, so someone's experiments on you will not kill you, and if you are alive now you will stand up again; no date or chart rule given.

hindi: सारी बात का निचोड़ है रिलाइजेशन इष्ट के रखने मात्र से आपका काम होगा
says: His summary of the whole talk is realization. He says your work will get done through the mere keeping (establishing) of your ishta, as opposed to merely knowing its name without installing it.
ambiguity: The caption may have dropped a negation: it could read 'merely keeping the ishta will not get your work done, realization is needed'. The affirmative reading matches his earlier 'रखने से वही काफी है' but is not certain.
classical_check: Silent. Results from mere installation of a deity are his claim; classical texts require sadhana and japa.

hindi: आपको प्रेम राधा से है कृष्ण से है राम से है गो अहेड प्रेम करने के लिए कोई दिक्कत नहीं
says: Emotional devotion is separate from ishta placement. If you love Radha, Krishna or Ram, go ahead and love them, since there is no problem in loving any deity. He is splitting bhakti from the ishta rule for results.
ambiguity: He does not say whether devotion to a deity that is anti to your ishta is also harmless.
classical_check: Bhakti to any deity is accepted in Hindu tradition. The split between devotion and ishta-for-results is his own.

hindi: आपका प्रेम का जो खाना है यहां से प्रेम होता है यह पंचम भाव है यह पूर्व जन्म की कृपा से होता है
says: The house (box) of love is the fifth house. Love arises from there and comes through the grace or merit of past lives (purva punya).
cells_derived_method: The flavour of love depends on the sign in the 5th, which is lagna+4: fire signs give passionate and impulsive love, earth signs steady and practical, air signs mental and playful, water signs emotional. The 5th lord's nature adds to it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna (5-5+1=1). Sun-ruled 5th gives proud, loyal and showy romance.
Derived: Cancer lagna (8-5+1=4). Mars-ruled 5th gives intense, secretive and possessive romance.
Derived: Aquarius lagna (3-5+1=-1, wraps to 11). Mercury-ruled 5th gives talkative, playful, mind-led love.
Derived: Scorpio lagna (12-5+1=8). Jupiter-ruled 5th gives idealised, devotional and dreamy love.

classical_check: Agrees: the 5th is the house of romance, children and purva punya in Parashara.

hindi: और यहां शादी होती है इसलिए अगर इन दोनों के अंदर तालमेल ना हो कुंडली में जो एक टेक्निकल बात है तो शादी के बाद प्रेम खत्म
says: Marriage happens from the other box he points to, which is presumably the 7th. If the love box (5th) and the marriage box are not in tune in the chart, which he calls a technical point, then love goes cold or ends once the marriage takes place.
cells_derived_method: Test the 5th-7th coordination by the relation of the two house lords (natural friend or enemy, aspect, conjunction, exchange) and by the signs. The 5th and 7th signs are always two apart, so their elements always match (fire-air or earth-water) and the lords decide the tuning. Not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna (5-5+1=1). 5th lord Sun and 7th lord Venus (Libra) are natural enemies, so poor tuning and a risk of love fading after marriage.
Derived: Aquarius lagna (3-5+1 wraps to 11). 5th lord Mercury and 7th lord Sun (Leo): Mercury treats the Sun as a friend and the Sun is neutral to Mercury, so no hostility and better tuning.
Derived: Gemini lagna (9-7+1=3). 5th lord Venus (Libra) and 7th lord Jupiter: Jupiter treats Venus as an enemy while Venus is neutral to Jupiter, so tuning is cool and one-sided.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is a pointing gesture and the 7th is inferred from the topic. 'तालमेल' is not defined: lord friendship, aspect, sign match or mutual placement are all possible.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 5th-7th link is classically used to judge love marriages. The claim that love ends after marriage when they are not in tune is his own.

gist: Joke in a mother-in-law's voice (runs into the next chunk): before marriage my son loved us a lot, this outsider is cunning and has snatched him from us.

hindi: अरे छीना नहीं उसकी कुंडली में योग यही है प्रेम शिफ्ट हो गया सफल हो गया
says: Punchline of the joke: the bride did not snatch the son. The yoga in his own chart is simply such that love shifts from the family to the spouse after marriage, so the shift is the chart working out.
ambiguity: 'सफल हो गया' is unclear: the love marriage succeeded, or the love moved successfully to the spouse. The yoga is not named.
classical_check: Silent on a specific yoga. Shift of attachment from family to spouse is generally read from the 4th against the 7th, but he names none.

hindi: इसलिए प्रेमी प्रेमिका बहुत अच्छे होते हैं कई बार शादी खराब कभार प्रेमी बहुत बकवास और गंदे होते हैं शादी लाजवाब होती है
says: Because love and marriage sit in separate boxes, a couple can be excellent lovers and still have a bad marriage, or be poor lovers and then have a superb marriage. How good one phase is does not predict the other.
cells_derived_method: Judge the love phase from the 5th house, sign and lord, and the marriage phase from the 7th house, sign and lord, each on its own. Either can be strong while the other is weak depending on the lagna. Not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna (7-7+1=1). Venus owns the 7th, so marriage can be good even if the 5th (Leo, Sun) gives a cooler lover phase.
Derived: Cancer lagna (8-5+1=4). Mars-ruled 5th gives a stormy, intense love phase, while the 7th (Capricorn, Saturn) gives a sober, duty-bound marriage.

ambiguity: 'इसलिए' ties back to the 5th versus 7th explanation, but this sentence itself names no house, so cells are left as any.
classical_check: Consistent with classical practice of judging 5th and 7th separately. He gives no rule for when each outcome occurs.

hindi: शादी में कोई खास रोमांस नहीं होता प्रेम नहीं होता यह होता है रोमांस ये होती है पार्टी कितनी पार्टी करेंगे पार्टी तो कहीं भी कर सकते हैं
says: He contrasts the boxes: marriage does not bring special romance or love. Romance belongs to one box (the love house), while the marriage box gives party, meaning companionship and social outings, which can be had anywhere with anyone, so marriage alone cannot supply romance.
cells_derived_method: Read romance from the 5th and companionship or partnership from the 7th. The sign and lord in each decide how warm or how routine each side is. Not said by him.
ambiguity: 'यह' and 'ये' are pointing gestures at boxes the caption does not name. Romance is probably the 5th and party probably the 7th, but party could also mean social outing or a legal party (partner).
classical_check: Classically the 7th is spouse, partnership and companionship and the 5th is romance, so this broadly agrees. The party label is his own.

hindi: अब ये हर एक खाने का एक अलग एटिबल है अलग उसकी शक्ति है अलग ताकत है उसके अनुसार आपका काम होता है
says: Every house (box) has its own distinct attribute and its own power and strength, and your outcomes in life follow whichever box is acting. No two houses give the same kind of result.
cells_derived_method: Each house's attribute comes from its classical topic (5th romance and children, 7th partner, 10th career), shaded by the sign in it and the lord of that sign. Not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna (5-5+1=1). The 5th is romance and children, coloured by Leo and the Sun.
Derived: Aries lagna (7-7+1=1). The 7th is partnership and marriage, coloured by Libra and Venus.
Derived: Aries lagna (10-10+1=1). The 10th is career and status, coloured by Capricorn and Saturn.

ambiguity: 'एटिबल' is read as 'attribute'.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea of bhava karakatwa, a separate signification for each house.

hindi: तो प्रथम भ्रांति के हमने अपना मात्र इष्ट जान लिया और हम जेब में लेकर घूम रहे हैं उसे नहीं
says: The first misconception he wants to clear is thinking that merely knowing your ishta, like carrying its name in your pocket, is enough. Knowing alone does nothing until the deity is properly established.
ambiguity: 'प्रथम भ्रांति के' is cut in the caption, and 'उसे नहीं' is read as 'not so'.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical remedies require action such as worship and japa, not just knowledge of the deity.

hindi: आप एज अ ले मैन यह कर सकते हैं कि अपने इष्ट को आपने घर के वेस्ट में स्थापित करके रख दिया खत्म लेकिन वह भी किसी अच्छे जानकार
says: A simple remedy for a layman: install your own ishta in the west of the home and that is enough, but even this should be done under the guidance of a good knowledgeable person.
ambiguity: 'वेस्ट' is the compass west of the house, not a chart house. Which corner or wall of the west is not specified.
classical_check: Differs from common Vastu, which places the puja corner in the north-east or east. West (Varuna's direction, Saturn) is not the standard place.

hindi: के थ्रू कहते हैं ना अच्छे डॉक्टर के थ्रू करो काम एक चीज नियम में बांधनी पड़ेगी
says: Continuing the layman advice: get the installation done through a competent person, just as you would go to a good doctor, and the practice has to be tied down to fixed rules rather than done casually.
ambiguity: 'एक चीज नियम में बांधनी पड़ेगी' does not say which thing is bound by rule: the ishta puja routine or the whole remedy.
classical_check: Silent. Guru-guided practice with fixed rules is general tradition.

gist: Announces that he will later discuss which planets of the chart are involved, general principles first, while specific cases differ from person to person.
Asks how we can gain control over ourselves in life and remarks that we have no control even over ourselves.

hindi: तो इसलिए आपको किसी अच्छे एस्ट्रोलॉजर के थ्रू यह पता करना है और अपनी रेमेडीज करनी है
says: Your ishta and anti-ishta should be found out through a good astrologer, and your remedies should be done on the basis of that finding, rather than by guessing it yourself.
classical_check: Agrees with general classical advice to take remedies on a qualified astrologer's guidance.

gist: Warns that following internet stories means hearing lectures for a hundred years and going mad since everyone says something different; a few common points exist but need years of study.

hindi: और उसके बाद आपके पास यह होना चाहिए कि आप रिटेंशन कर सके याद कर सके आपके घर के अंदर थ अच्छा होना चाहिए ताकि याद रह सके
says: To retain and remember what you study, a particular part of the home must be in good condition. The caption drops the direction word, with only a trailing 'थ' surviving, so which direction gives memory retention cannot be recovered with certainty.
ambiguity: 'थ' is the tail of a word like साउथ or नॉर्थ (South or North) or of a compound such as South-West. The direction is not recoverable.
classical_check: Cannot be matched because the direction is lost. Vastu links study and memory to the north-east, east and north, and stability to the south-west.

hindi: आपका साउथ ईस्ट बढ़िया होना चाहिए ताकि आप याद करके उसे रीप्रोड्यूस भी कर सके
says: The south-east of your home should be in good shape so that after remembering you can also reproduce (recall and express) what you learned. He links the south-east with output of knowledge, distinct from the earlier direction for retention.
ambiguity: 'रीप्रोड्यूस' is read as recalling and expressing in exams or speech, not as reproduction in the biological sense.
classical_check: Vastu: the south-east is the Agni corner ruled by Venus (energy, expression, kitchen). Linking it to recall and reproduction is his own, and no planet is named here.

hindi: आप खुद ऐसे होने चाहिए कि आपके घर में साउथ ईस्ट वेस्ट नॉर्थ सबसेट मिले उसके लिए आपको अपने ग्रह को सेटल करना जरूरी है
says: For all four directions of your home (south, east, west, north) to come out well set, you yourself must first be settled, and the way to do it is to settle your own planets in the chart. The quality of the home's directions follows your planetary condition.
ambiguity: 'सबसेट' is read as 'सब सेट' (all set). 'अपने ग्रह को सेटल करना' does not say how the planets are to be settled.
classical_check: In the Vastu-Jyotish spirit, each direction has a planetary lord (E Sun, SE Venus, S Mars, SW Rahu, W Saturn, NW Moon, N Mercury, NE Jupiter), but he names none here.

gist: Says that what typically goes wrong in our planets, broadly and universally, would be very good and necessary to cover next.
Planets in space keep revolving round and round; we may understand our own planets but find we cannot implement that understanding.

hindi: हमारे अपने ग्रह इतनी ईगो दे देते हैं कि नहीं हमें तो हर हालत के अंदर अपनी चलानी है
says: Our own natal planets inflate the ego so much that we insist on having our own way in every situation, which is why we fail to implement advice we have understood. Planetary condition shows up as stubbornness.
ambiguity: No planet, house or sign is named for the ego.
classical_check: Silent on a specific planet. Classically ego is read from the Sun, the lagna and the lagna lord.

gist: Anecdote: someone plants a doubt that your doctor is a looter, you rush to another doctor even though the first had suited you and changed your life.
Says astrology has a problem: an astrologer with God-given knowledge can read what you have been thinking, which he calls very dangerous; the sentence is cut at the end of the slice.
Tail of an anecdote about a doctor/guru who reads you at a glance and stays silent; warning that if you doubt such a guru you are out of his life for good.

hindi: जो जो आपको सूट कर गया देवता है ना राम हमें सूट कर गए कृष्ण हमें सूट कर गए आपने एक बार सोच लिया ना कृष्ण का क्या है अयाश था ... जिंदगी में नर्क बनना शुरू हो जाएगा
says: Whichever deity has actually suited you (Ram, Krishna and so on), stay with that one. Once you start doubting him, for example dismissing Krishna as a womaniser, you will get beaten up by life and things turn hellish. Practical meaning: keep faith in your own working ishta devata and do not second-guess it.
ambiguity: 'Suits me' (सूट कर गया) is judged by personal experience, not by any chart rule; he gives no method for choosing the deity.
classical_check: Classical ishta-devata selection uses the Atmakaraka in Navamsa (Karakamsa) or the 5th/9th lords; he uses experiential fit instead. The warning against doubting the chosen deity is a devotional tradition claim, not found in Parashara.

gist: Opens the 'story of doubt': a woman puts on a suit, doubts she looks fine, cancels it, tries a blue one and is still unsure.
Anecdote goes on: the wife tries yellow, goes back to green, quizzes her husband on the outfit and 'fails' him, scolds him for wearing safari suits, then steps out in her pink suit by mistake.
Role-reversal punchline: the husband dresses plainly, the wife makes him change three times, he cries 'courier me by FedEx' and gives up; doubt piled on doubt ends in a fight.

hindi: शक पर शक आपने शक किया है इसलिए यदि आपको जो सूट कर गया है भले ही वह बंगाली बाबा है उसे छोड़ो मत उसे लूटने दो
says: Moral of the dress story: doubting on top of doubt ruins the relationship. If a guru, healer or remedy-giver has genuinely suited you, even if he looks like a roadside 'Bengali baba', do not leave him and do not haggle over his fee, let him 'loot' you. Recorded as his advice to keep paying a guide who works for you; it is not an astrological rule and is not endorsed here.
ambiguity: 'Let him loot you' is rhetorical: he means do not argue about the guru's fee, not that fraud is acceptable. The sentence is split across two caption chunks.
classical_check: Silent. This is guru-loyalty advice with no classical Jyotish source.

gist: Argues that if you leave this guru, doctors, the outside world and friends will fleece you anyway, and the guru takes only a small fraction by comparison.
Complains that people made rich by the guru later call him a robber; says he never asked a share of their earnings and only blessed them, so doubting him is unfair.
Says such a guru can read you (your doubt included), that this is dangerous, and that you will not even realise what you have lost.

hindi: इसीलिए साधु व्यक्ति के साथ आपको नमन करना आशीर्वाद लेना है आपको कृपा मिलेगी पैसे को मत देखो यदि वो ज्ञानी है तो अपने आप ऐसी स्थिति कराएगा कि आपका जीवन बेहतर करेगा
says: With a sadhu or learned guru, bow and take his ashirwad and you will receive kripa (grace); do not judge him by money. If he is truly knowledgeable he will, by himself, arrange circumstances that make your life better. This is a spiritual claim; no chart condition is attached.
ambiguity: 'Knowledgeable' (ज्ञानी) is the only test he gives for a genuine guru, and there is no way to verify it from the chart or the sentence.
classical_check: Silent in measurable terms. Grace through a guru is a devotional tradition and lies outside Parashari computation.

gist: General advice: do not waste your own time, because time is the biggest currency.

hindi: आपको पता नहीं कितने आशीर्वाद मिलने से वंचित हो जाओगे जिंदगी तो फिर भी चलेगी
says: By wasting time or doubting the right guide you cut yourself off from an unknown number of blessings; life still goes on, but without those benefits. A cost-of-doubt claim, not tied to any chart factor.
ambiguity: The sentence is split across two caption chunks ('आपको पता' / 'नहीं कितने'); the subject (wasted time vs doubting the guru) is inferred from the previous lines.
classical_check: Silent. Devotional claim only.

hindi: एक प्रश्न आता है कि यदि हमने उपाय ना किए तो तो ना करो चश्मा लगाए बिना आप जी सकते हो एसी लगाए बिना आप जी सकते हो गाड़ी के बिना बस में जा सकते हो
says: Asked 'what if we do not do any remedies?', his answer is: then do not. Remedies are optional, like spectacles, an AC or a car, since you can live without them or take a bus instead.
classical_check: Differs in tone: classical texts present upaya as the prescribed answer to afflictions, though none calls it compulsory.

hindi: यहां मुद्दा ही नहीं है कि उपाय करने जरूरी हैं लोगों के भाई बहन भतीजे हस्बैंड वाइफ मर जाते हैं जिंदगी आप जी सकते हो कोई मना थोड़ी है उसको फैसिलिटेट करना है बेहतर करना है
says: Remedies are not a survival requirement: people lose siblings, nephews or a spouse and still live on, and nobody forbids that. The only purpose of upay is to facilitate life and make it better, not to prevent loss. Bereavement is mentioned only as an example, not as a prediction.
classical_check: Silent on this framing. Classical upaya aim at reducing affliction, which is wider than only 'making life better'.

hindi: अरे करने क्या हो इस जिंदगी में में मौज करो इसको बेटर करो इसके लिए हम कृपा लेते हैं इसलिए कृपा लेना बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी है
says: The point of this life is to enjoy it and improve it; for that we take kripa (grace), so taking grace is 'very necessary'. This sits against the previous lines, where upay was called optional, so he separates grace (needed) from remedies (optional).
ambiguity: He does not say how kripa differs from upay in practice or how one 'takes' it, beyond the guru-blessing talk before.
classical_check: Slight tension: classical texts do not split grace from remedies. Daan, japa and puja are all upaya whose result is said to rest on grace.

hindi: यह कृपा के टाइम ग्रह वक्री होकर क्या करते हैं और कैसे हमारी खोपड़ी खराब करते हैं क्या हम इसके उपाय करें जो जेनेरिक हमारी लाइफ 50 पर गारंटी ठीक हो जाएगी उसकी बात करेंगे हम इंटरवल के बाद
says: Preview, not a rule: after the interval he will explain what retrograde (vakri) planets do and how they 'spoil the head' (disturb the mind), and which generic remedies would set life right with a claimed 50 percent assurance. No details given yet.
ambiguity: 'कृपा के टाइम' and '50 पर गारंटी' are garbled: it could mean 50 percent guaranteed or 50 out of 100, and 'at the time of grace' may be a caption error.
classical_check: Retrograde planets are classically strong in cheshta bala but often read as delayed or intense in result; 'harms the mind' is his claim. The 50 percent figure is not classical and is unmeasured.

hindi: जो ग्रह होते हैं 12 ग्रह हैं हैं यह सात ग्रह है जो यूजुअली लोग जानते हैं मानते हैं और साथ में राहु और केतु इसके आगे पीछे लोग यूजुअली लेते ही नहीं कुछ भी
says: In his scheme there are 12 grahas. Most people know and use only the seven classical bodies (Sun to Saturn) plus Rahu and Ketu, and normally consider nothing beyond those nine.
ambiguity: 'इसके आगे पीछे' (beyond or around this) presumably means beyond the nine; the next sentences name the other three.
classical_check: Classical Parashari Jyotish uses 9 grahas (navagraha). The 12-planet scheme with Uranus, Neptune and Pluto is his own extension; classical texts are silent on it.

hindi: यह दो उपग्रह य होते होते कहीं नहीं यह चंद्रमा की नोडल पोजीशन का चक्कर है चंद्रमा राहु और केतु बनता है जब सूर्य ग्रहण और चंद्र ग्रहण का लफड़ा
says: Rahu and Ketu are not physical bodies; he calls them sub-planets that exist nowhere in the sky. They come from the Moon's nodal points, which matter when solar and lunar eclipses happen.
ambiguity: The caption 'चंद्रमा राहु और केतु बनता है' (Moon becomes Rahu-Ketu) is garbled, so the node explanation is inferred. 'उपग्रह' (satellite) is used loosely.
classical_check: Agrees that Rahu and Ketu are the lunar nodes (chhaya grahas, shadow planets). Calling them 'upagraha' differs from classical usage, where upagraha means Gulika, Mandi and similar points.

hindi: चंद्रमा के तीन प्लेनेट और है हमारे इंद्र यह हो गए सात ये हो गए पाच ये 12 ग्रह और 12 ही होती है राशियां
says: Besides the nine there are three more planets (he names Indra first; Varuna and Pluto follow in the next lines). Seven plus two plus three makes 12 grahas, which he pairs with the 12 rashis.
ambiguity: Only Indra is named in this sentence, and the counting words ('सात', 'पाच') are garbled; the 7+2+3 arithmetic is supplied by me.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish has no Uranus, Neptune or Pluto. He maps them to Indra, Varuna and Yama; the 12 planets for 12 signs pairing is his own system.

hindi: इन तीन को लेकर चलते ही नहीं कुछ क्योंकि यह ग्रह एक परिक्रमा करता है 84 साल में यह करता है 164 और यह मेरे ख्याल से 248 है या 244 46 248
says: People do not work with these three because their orbits are very long: about 84 years for the first (Uranus), 164 years for the second (Neptune) and, he thinks, 248 years for the third (Pluto).
ambiguity: The planets are not named in this sentence; the mapping to Uranus, Neptune and Pluto follows the order of the standard periods. He is unsure of the last value ('248 or 244').
classical_check: Agrees with modern astronomy: Uranus 84.0 years, Neptune 164.8 years, Pluto 247.9 years. Classical Jyotish is silent.

hindi: प्लूटो उसके जन्म में हो सकता है पूरी लाइफ एक ही राशि में पड़ा रहे पूरे जन्म वरुण एक ही राशि में पड़ा रहे 84 साल बहुत है हद से हद एक राशि बदलेगा
says: For a person who lives about 100 years, he claims Pluto may stay in one sign for the whole life, Neptune too, and even the 84-year planet will change sign at most once. So these three give one nearly fixed colour to a whole lifetime.
ambiguity: The caption '24 84 साल' is garbled; I read the 84-year planet as Uranus. The 100-year life is stated just before the quoted part.
classical_check: Astronomically wrong and self-contradictory. With an 84-year orbit Uranus spends about 7 years per sign, Neptune about 14 and Pluto 12 to 31, so each changes sign several times in a lifetime. It also contradicts his own 84/164/248 figures. Classical texts are silent.

hindi: यानी लाइफ के कुछ ऐसे दूरगामी इफेक्ट है इतने परमानेंट जो कुछ भी उपाय करके भी नहीं उखड़ मतलब इन तीनों के लिए यह तीन उसके हवाले हैं
says: Because these three stay so long in one place, their effects on life are far-reaching and so permanent that no remedy uproots them. For these three planets his stance is to leave them in God's hands and offer no remedy.
ambiguity: 'उसके हवाले' means handed over to Him (God or destiny) but could also be read as handed over to the guru. It is unclear whether he exempts them from the 'generic remedies' promised earlier.
classical_check: Silent on these planets. It conflicts with the Parashari view that afflictions can be eased by upaya, though classical remedies exist only for the nine grahas.

hindi: शनि जो है यह 30 साल में 12 राशियों को घूम जाता है 29 है लेकिन 30 मोटा मोटा हम लेकर चल रहे हैं
says: Saturn takes about 30 years (more exactly about 29) to go round all 12 signs; he rounds to 30 for working purposes, which is about 2.5 years in each sign.
ambiguity: The sentence starts at the end of the previous caption chunk ('शनि जो है यह').
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn's sidereal period is about 29.5 years, roughly 2.5 years per sign, the basis of sade-sati arithmetic.

hindi: शुक्र जो है मान लो यह डेढ़ महीने में कर लेता है
says: Venus is given as taking about one and a half months; the sentence is left unfinished and the thing being timed (whole zodiac or one sign) is not stated.
ambiguity: Unit unclear. As a full-zodiac time it is false, since it is about 1 year; as a time per sign it is roughly right. The caption also breaks off 'शुक्र ... बुध जो है' and then jumps to Jupiter.
classical_check: Venus covers the zodiac in about 1 year and stays about 23 to 30 days per sign on average, longer in retrograde years. 1.5 months is only right as an upper-end per-sign figure.

hindi: बृहस्पति एक वर्ष 13 महीने वन ईयर 12 मंथ्स वन ईयर
says: Jupiter stays about one year in a sign; he wavers between 13 months and 12 months and settles on one year. Read as time per sign, the full round then takes about 12 years.
ambiguity: The caption reads as time per sign; as a full-zodiac time it would be wrong. The 12-year full round is my inference.
classical_check: Agrees as per-sign time: Jupiter's transit is about 12 to 13 months per sign, and the full cycle is about 11.86 years.

hindi: बुध जो है ... बुध करीब एक महीना
says: Mercury takes roughly one month (to change sign). He starts the Mercury sentence, jumps to Jupiter, and comes back to Mercury with a rough one-month figure.
ambiguity: The unit is not stated; as with Venus it must be per sign, because Mercury's full zodiac round is about a year.
classical_check: Mercury spends about 14 to 30 days per sign (up to about 2 months with retrogression), and goes round the zodiac in about a year. A month per sign is a fair average.

hindi: मंगल दो साल लगते हैं पूरे के पूरे 12 राशियों को कवर करने में
says: Mars needs about two years to cover all 12 signs, which works out at about two months per sign.
classical_check: Agrees roughly: Mars's sidereal period is 687 days (about 1.9 years), averaging about 1.5 months per sign, with much longer stays when retrograde.

hindi: चंद्रमा तो 27 दिन से 29 दिन में चेंज करता है 12 राशियां
says: The Moon goes through all 12 signs in 27 to 29 days, one lunar month.
ambiguity: The range 27 to 29 days mixes the sidereal round with the phase month.
classical_check: Agrees: the sidereal month is 27.32 days and the synodic (phase) month is 29.53 days. The sign-round itself is the sidereal 27.3 days.

hindi: और सूरज जो है हर महीने में एक राशि करता है वन वन मंथ तो सूरज की वजह से ही एक महीना बना तो 12 महीने की राशिया है
says: The Sun spends one month in each sign; the month as a unit exists because of the Sun's sign change, so 12 months correspond to the 12 signs.
classical_check: Agrees for the solar (sauramana) month of about 30.4 days. The Hindu lunar month is defined by the Moon, so 'month because of the Sun' is only one of two conventions.

gist: Restates that the Moon circles the Earth in 27 to 29 days, which he treats as one month, and that within one month the Moon has gone through all 12 signs.

hindi: मान लो मेष राशि में सूरज है एक नंबर के अंदर एरीज तो उस एक नंबर राशि के टाइम चंद्रमा 12 की 12 राशियां घूम जाएगा
says: Worked example of the Sun-month: while the Sun is in Aries (sign no.1), the Moon will pass through all twelve signs during that one month.
ambiguity: One caption fragment ('एक नंबर ि') is garbled; sign no.1 is Aries, as in the rest of the series. The Aries cell is only the example month, not a rule about Aries.
classical_check: Agrees astronomically: the Moon's sidereal period (27.3 days) fits inside one solar month (about 30.4 days), so it visits all 12 signs within it.

gist: Set-up example: people ask 'what is your rashi?' and the reply is 'Libra, Libra'; no rule yet, it leads into the point that 'rashi' alone is ambiguous.

hindi: सात नंबर की राशि सूरज की जब वो सर्दियों में जाकर के नवंबर के महीने में पहुंचता है वहां
says: Libra is sign number 7, and the Sun is there when it moves into winter, around the month of November. This is his rough seasonal anchor for the Sun in Libra.
