ambiguity: The sentence is a fragment that runs into the next one, so it is unclear whether he means the Sun's entry or its stay.
classical_check: With Lahiri ayanamsa the Sun is in Libra from about 17 Oct to 16 Nov, so 'around November' is roughly right. The tropical (Western) Sun is in Libra from 23 Sep to 22 Oct, which would not match.

hindi: वहां अगर हम बात कर रहे राशि की मींस चंद्रमा की राशि की बात हो रही है तो तुला राशि का मतलब हो गया चंद्रमा
says: If 'rashi' is meant in the Indian sense of the Moon's sign, then 'my rashi is Libra' means the Moon is in Libra (implied: at birth), not the Sun.
ambiguity: The sentence trails off after 'चंद्रमा' and 'at birth' is not spoken; it is my reading of janma rashi.
classical_check: Agrees: the janma rashi in Parashari practice is the sign the Moon occupies at birth.

hindi: सूरज एक राशि में एक महीना रहेगा पूरे साल में चंद्रमा हर महीने हर बार हर राशि में जाएगा इसलिए राशि बोलने से काम नहीं चलता
says: The Sun stays a month in one sign, while the Moon passes through every sign every month, so the bare word 'rashi' is not specific enough. You must say whose sign (Sun's or Moon's) you mean.
classical_check: Agrees in substance: Jyotish separates surya rashi, chandra (janma) rashi and lagna. Classical texts default to the Moon sign when 'rashi' is said alone.

hindi: अगर आपने बोला की एरीज राशि है तो आपने इंग्लिश वर्ड यूज किया है इसका मतलब आप यह बोल रहे कि सूरज एक नंबर में है एक नंबर राशि जो होती है व एरीज होती है
says: If someone says their sign is 'Aries', using the English name, they are giving the Sun's sign: the Sun is in sign no.1, which is Aries. English zodiac names are therefore read as Sun-signs, and by contrast the Hindi 'rashi' as the Moon-sign.
ambiguity: He states only the English-name half explicitly; the rule that the Hindi rashi means the Moon-sign comes from the contrast with the previous lines.
classical_check: Matches popular usage (Western sun-sign versus Vedic janma rashi), not a classical rule. In Jyotish the Sanskrit and English sign names refer to the same zodiac.

hindi: और चंदा मामा इन इन सारी की सारी राशियों के अंदर घूम गया 27 दिन में ढाई दिन में घूमता है घोड़े की चाल है इसकी
says: The Moon runs through all the signs in about 27 days, roughly 2.5 days in each sign, so its pace is a horse's gallop compared with the slower planets.
ambiguity: The caption '27 दिन में ढाई दिन में' is garbled; I read it as 27 days for the round and 2.5 days per sign.
classical_check: Roughly agrees: 27.32 days divided by 12 gives about 2.28 days per sign, so 2.5 is a rounded-up figure.

hindi: यह हमारा सबकॉन्शियस है यह हमारे मुन्ना की चाल है
says: The Moon's quick pace is the pace of our subconscious: the Moon stands for the inner, instinctive mind, which is why it moves at a horse's speed, and he calls it 'our munna' (our little boy).
cells_derived_method: Moon is the mind karaka; the house it occupies shows which life area the subconscious is drawn to, and the sign shows the quality of the mood (earth and water signs steadier, air and fire signs more restless). This is derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in its own sign in the 4th house, so the subconscious is anchored in home, mother and emotional security and the mind settles easily.

Derived, not said by him: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 7th house, so instinctive reactions in partnerships are intense and swing sharply, and the subconscious pattern is tied to spouse and partners.

ambiguity: 'सबकॉन्शियस' is his modern gloss on manas; the exact referent of 'यह' (the Moon's pace or the Moon) is inferred from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is manas karaka (mind) in Brihat Parashara; 'subconscious' is a modern gloss.

gist: 'मुन्ना कहां है शनि चाल किससे चंद्रमा से' seems to compare Saturn's slow pace with the Moon's, but the caption is too garbled to state a claim.

hindi: मन कितना चंचल है मन फटाफट अभी यार अभी नफरत
says: The mind (Moon) is extremely fickle and swings in an instant: a friend one moment, hated the next. He links this restlessness to the Moon's quick sign changes.
cells_derived_method: Moon's changeability is shown through its house (the life area where moods swing) and its sign (how strongly: dual or airy signs amplify, fixed or exalted placements steady it). This is derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in the airy dual sign Gemini in the 3rd house, so mood swings show up in talk, messages and dealings with siblings, with quick shifts between warmth and irritation.
Derived, not said by him: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 10th house, so moods stay steadier at work and in public life, and the swing between liking and disliking is weak.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the Moon is the changeable (chanchala) mind, and waxing and waning is tied to mood shifts. Silent on the 'friend to hate' phrase.

hindi: चंद्रमा एक महीने के अंदर घूमते घुमाते पूर्ण चंद्र हो जाता है फुल
says: Within one month, in its circuit, the Moon reaches the full-moon phase. The sentence is cut off at the end of this slice and continues in the next batch.
ambiguity: Truncated at the slice end ('फुल'), so the point he goes on to make about phases or mood is not available here.
classical_check: Agrees: the synodic month of about 29.5 days contains one full moon, and the Moon is strongest in paksha bala near fullness.

hindi: कंप्लीट महीने में लगता है एक बार यार फुल है लाइफ कितनी अच्छी लाइफ है सब पूरा है यार उसी महीने में अमावास जाती है लगता है कुछ नहीं है लाइफ कूड़ा है
says: He says a person's feeling about life swings with the lunar phase in a single month: at full moon everything feels complete and great, at new moon (amavasya) life feels like garbage, and at the half moon it is so-so. So the Moon's phase drives mood.
cells_derived_method: Which life area swings with the Moon's phase depends on the house the Moon sits in (4th: home peace, 7th: partner mood, 10th: work mood), and how sharp the swing is depends on the sign nature (water/fixed signs hold the mood longer, movable signs change it faster) and on the Moon's dignity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in its own sign Cancer in the 4th (lagna Aries): mood swings centre on home and mother but the Moon is strong, so the dips recover quickly.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus): phase-linked mood swings land on the partner relationship and are sharper, with emotional intensity.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 10th (lagna Leo): mood changes show at work but the Moon is steady, so public image stays stable through the phases.

ambiguity: He gives the monthly pattern without saying whether it is the natal Moon phase (birth tithi) or the transit Moon phase; the wording reads as general monthly experience.
classical_check: Classical texts agree that a strong waxing Moon gives a steady mind and a weak waning Moon an unsteady one (Moon as manas karaka); the full/new/half-moon mood description is popular, not a specific shloka.

hindi: फिर शाम को नहीं नहीं वो तो चोर है पापी है गलत है पाप हो जाएगा गलत हो जाएगा उनका चंदा मामा एक दिन के अंदर उनकी खोपड़ी खराब किए बैठा है और उनकी लाइफ स्टेबल कभी नहीं होगी
says: People whose mood flips constantly (eager to meet someone in the morning, calling the same person a sinner by evening) have a Moon that is spoiling their head within a single day, and such a person's life will never become stable.
cells_derived_method: He ties the unstable-mind pattern to the Moon in general. Using house x sign logic, the instability would be worst where the Moon is weak (debilitated in Scorpio, afflicted by Saturn/Rahu, or waning) and would hit the house topic the Moon occupies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 1st (lagna Scorpio): moodiness is part of the personality itself.
Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 6th (lagna Aquarius): the mind keeps flipping around work routine, health habits and conflicts with colleagues.
Derived: Moon in Pisces in the 9th (lagna Cancer): flip-flopping beliefs and guru or religion choices.

ambiguity: 'Chanda mama' is his nickname for the Moon. He does not say which Moon condition (sign, house, aspect) causes the instability; he speaks of the Moon generally.
classical_check: Classical texts link an afflicted or weak Moon (especially with Saturn or Rahu) to a fickle mind; he gives no specific rule here.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति के लिए चंदा मामा के लिए हम मोती पहनाते हैं लेकिन यदि मोती सूट करता है तो प्लस करेगा मोती सूट नहीं करता है तो माइनस करेगा
says: Remedy: for such a Moon-troubled person a pearl is prescribed, but only if the pearl suits the person; a suitable pearl adds benefit and an unsuitable one makes things worse.
cells_derived_method: Whether a pearl suits depends on the Moon's house lordship for that lagna: the pearl is generally safer where the Moon lords a kendra/trikona or the 2nd/11th and risky where the Moon lords the 6th/8th/12th or is placed in a dusthana.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, Moon is the lagna lord in the 1st, so a pearl is a natural supportive choice.
Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 8th (lagna Scorpio): Moon lords the 9th but sits in the 8th, so the pearl needs checking before it is worn.
Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 6th (lagna Aquarius): Moon lords the 6th itself, so a pearl would strengthen a dusthana lord and could be a minus.

ambiguity: He does not say what test decides whether the pearl 'suits' (lordship, trial wearing, or dasha).
classical_check: Classical gem rules (BPHS and later texts) say a gem should be worn only for a benefic or yogakaraka lord; this suit-or-harm caution agrees with that.

hindi: सबकॉन्शियस माइंड खट खट खट खट खट खट बदल रहा है
says: He says the subconscious mind of such a person keeps changing rapidly, flipping again and again; he places the subconscious mind under the Moon.
ambiguity: The word 'subconscious' is his own modern term; classical texts say mind (manas) for the Moon.
classical_check: Classical: Moon is manas karaka (mind); subconscious is a modern relabel, not a classical term.

hindi: अच्छा मोती क्यों पहनाते हैं हम छोटा सा उपाय क्यों नहीं कर लेते क्योंकि वो परमानेंट फिल्टर लगा दिया सारी दुनिया भर के सारे उपायों में सबसे ऊंचा उपाय है रत्न
says: He asks why a gem is prescribed instead of a small remedy and answers that a gem fits a permanent filter on the person, so gemstone is the highest of all the remedies in the world.
ambiguity: 'Filter' is metaphorical: he means the gem permanently screens the planet's influence, not a physical filter.
classical_check: Classical texts rank gems as one of several remedies (mantra, daan, puja, gem); ranking gems 'highest' is his own view and is not in the classics.

hindi: क्योंकि य हाइड्रोकार्बन है आपके स्पेसिफिक एंटीना जो उंगलियां है जहां से जो वेन और नर्व
says: He claims the gem works because it is a hydrocarbon and your fingers act as specific antennas, with veins and nerves carrying the signal (sentence continues into the next chunk).
ambiguity: Caption cuts off mid-sentence; the end continues in the next chunk. 'Hydrocarbon' is a factual error for most gems (ruby and sapphire are aluminium oxide, pearl is mostly calcium carbonate with organic matter).
classical_check: Classics are silent on any physical mechanism like hydrocarbon or antenna; the chemistry claim is wrong for most gems, so treat it as his analogy only.

hindi: जहां जा रही है उसके अंतर्गत आपको वह उस प्लेनेट की रेज को फिल्टर करके आपकी बॉडी में डालता है
says: Finishing the gem mechanism: wherever the vein and nerve go, the gem filters the rays of its planet and feeds them into your body, so the gem acts as a channel for that one planet's energy.
ambiguity: Continues the broken sentence from the previous chunk; 'rays' means planetary radiation in the classical sense, not measured light.
classical_check: Classics say a gem carries the planet's rashmi (rays) to the wearer, which agrees in spirit; the vein/nerve route is his addition. No physical evidence for it.

hindi: सारा जो टाइट्स आती है पानी ऊपर जाता है पानी नीचे जाता है यह चंद्रमा की वजह से जाता है फुल मून और न्यू मून अधूरा नो मून इसपे टाइड्स छोटी होती है बड़ी होती है
says: The tides of the sea, with water rising and falling, are caused by the Moon; the tides are bigger or smaller depending on the lunar phase (full moon, new moon, half moon). He uses this as proof of the Moon's pull on water and on us.
ambiguity: The captions mix up the phases; physically, the largest tides come at full and new moon and the smallest at the half moons.
classical_check: Classical: Moon is the karaka of water and fluids. The tide-phase physics he quotes is correct astronomy but is not a jyotish rule.

hindi: चंदा मामा की टाइड्स के हिसाब से मछली अंडे देती है सोच के चलिए प्रजनन इतने ही दिनों के अंदर स्त्री का मासिक धर्म होता है
says: Fish lay eggs according to the Moon's tides, and a woman's menstrual cycle runs in about the same lunar number of days, so the Moon governs reproduction cycles.
ambiguity: None significant; he does not state the number of days.
classical_check: Classical: Moon is the karaka of women, fluids and fertility; the lunar link to the menstrual cycle is traditional and agrees. Whether the cycle length is lunar is a popular claim, not proven.

hindi: हमारे जन्म के लिए जरूरी है मां का मासिक धर्म पिता के शुक्राणु से मिलने के लिए एग को फर्टिलाइज करें तो हम सब तभी जन्म ले सकते हैं यह चंदा मामा टॉप पे है इसलिए शिव जी इसे टॉप प रखते हैं
says: Birth needs the mother's cycle and the father's sperm to fertilise the egg, so the Moon is on top of the hierarchy of life, and this is why Shiva keeps the Moon on his head.
ambiguity: This is a mythic or symbolic argument for the Moon's importance, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Classical: Moon on Shiva's head is Puranic imagery; classics call Moon the mother and the mind, consistent with this. No chart rule follows.

hindi: यह सूर्य है पिता यह हो गई माता
says: Plain karaka pairing: the Sun is the father, and the Moon (just discussed) is the mother.
cells_derived_method: In a chart the father is read from the Sun and the 9th/10th, the mother from the Moon and the 4th; the sign and house of each show the parent's condition.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Leo in the 9th (lagna Sagittarius): Sun is strong in its own sign in a father house, so the father is a notable, authoritative figure.
Derived: Moon in Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra): the mother-house Moon sits in a Saturn sign, so mother is disciplined or burdened.

ambiguity: None; this is a standard assignment.
classical_check: Classical BPHS agrees: Sun is pitri karaka and Moon is matri karaka.

hindi: सूर्य जो है इसके लिए माणिक पहनाया जाता है माणिक एक स्टोन है
says: Remedy: ruby (manik) is the gem worn for the Sun.
cells_derived_method: Ruby should be worn only where the Sun is a friendly lord (for example lagna Leo, Aries, Sagittarius, Scorpio); for lagnas where the Sun lords a difficult house (Capricorn 8th, Aquarius 7th, Gemini 3rd) the gem needs caution.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, Sun is the lagna lord, so ruby is the standard supportive gem.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 8th (lagna Capricorn): Sun lords the 8th, so ruby would feed an 8th-lord and needs checking.
Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 5th (lagna Sagittarius): Sun lords the 9th trikona and is exalted, so ruby supports a strong trikona lord.

ambiguity: He does not say here when ruby is unsuitable (suitability was covered only for pearl).
classical_check: Classical: ruby is the gem of the Sun in all texts, so this agrees.

hindi: सूर्य कौन है राजा सिंह
says: The Sun is the king of the planets and is symbolised by the lion (Simha).
ambiguity: The caption is clipped ('raja simha'); it reads as king and lion.
classical_check: Classical: Sun is the king (raja) of the navagrahas, and Leo is its sign; this agrees.

hindi: सिंह राशि एक अकेली राशि है जिसको कोई ओवर पावर नहीं कर सकता यह सिंह राशि है
says: Leo is the one sign that nobody can overpower, so the Sun in Leo (its own sign) is dominant and cannot be dominated by other planets.
cells_derived_method: The strength shows through the house Leo falls in for that lagna: Leo in the 1st gives self-command, in the 10th command in career, in the 8th a strong sign but in a dusthana, so authority is tested by hidden matters.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Leo in the 1st (lagna Leo): dominant personality, hard to overpower.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 10th (lagna Scorpio): Sun is the 10th lord in its own sign, so a strong, hard-to-dislodge career position.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 8th (lagna Capricorn): strong own-sign Sun but in a dusthana, so the strength shows as resilience in crises rather than public authority.

ambiguity: 'Overpower' is not defined; it could mean not being defeated by other planets' aspects or only the sign's natural dominance.
classical_check: Classical: Leo is a fixed, royal sign owned by the Sun; no text says no other planet can overpower it, so this is his emphasis.

hindi: इसकी पांच नंबर की राशि सूर्य की इसकी राशि है चार नंबर इसकी
says: The Sun's sign is number 5, which is Leo. He then starts a new number, 'four number its', which is cut off by the chunk break and probably names the Moon's sign Cancer.
ambiguity: The 'four number' that follows is cut off, so whose sign it is cannot be confirmed from this chunk; here it is only recorded as likely the Moon's Cancer.
classical_check: Classical: Sun owns Leo (5th sign); this agrees with the Aries=1 numbering confirmed in the series.

gist: Garbled run of sign numbers ('one, three, no two, 10') continuing the 'four number' list after the Sun's 5; the caption does not show which planet owns which number, so nothing is recorded.

hindi: यह इतना टेक्निकल है कि इसको लोग पकड़ते नहीं इसके उपाय दूरगामी उपाय बहुत लंबे टाइम के यह अंबानी अडानी वगैरह जो बनते हैं
says: He says this planet-and-gem system is so technical that people miss it, and its remedies are far-reaching, working over a very long time; he links this to how very rich business families are made. The wealth claim is a loose anecdote, not a rule.
ambiguity: 'This' is unclear: it may mean the planet-to-sign ownership scheme just listed or the gem system generally. The link to named business families is an anecdote and not checkable.
classical_check: Classics say gem results build over a long period with dasha; the wealth example is not classical and has no chart rule behind it.

hindi: ये खटखट खटखट बीच में ग्रह चेंज होते रहते हैं 303 साल में भी शनि बदलता है पूरी जिंदगी नहीं बदलती
says: The fast planets keep changing position all the time in between, and even Saturn changes sign over about 30 years; but something (the slow planets he turns to next) does not change through a whole life. This is a contrast of fast and slow movers.
cells_derived_method: Fast planets (Moon, Mercury, Venus, Sun, Mars) change sign quickly and so show short-term shifts; slow ones (Saturn about 2.5 years per sign, Jupiter 1 year) show multi-year phases. Which houses are touched depends on the transit sign against the natal lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn transiting Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries) sits in the career house for about 2.5 years, a phase that stays long compared with the Moon's two-day passage.
Derived: Saturn transiting Aquarius in the 4th (lagna Scorpio) lasts about 2.5 years on home and peace, while Mars passes the same sign in about 45 days.

ambiguity: '303 saal' is a caption error, most likely '30 saal' (Saturn's roughly 29.5-year cycle). What 'does not change in a whole life' refers to is unclear.
classical_check: Classical Saturn transit is about 2.5 years per sign and about 29.5 years for a full round, which matches the 30-year figure.

hindi: उन पों के ये है जो जान दे रहे हैं यह दैत्य ग्रह जो राक्षसों की तरह पकड़ के बैठे हैं यह क्रूर देवता है जो जिंदगी भर रॉकेट करते हैं
says: He calls a group of slow planets demon (daitya) planets that sit gripping a person like rakshasas, cruel gods who push life like a rocket for the whole of a lifetime. The planets are not named in this chunk.
ambiguity: Which planets he means is not stated here; they may be the three outer planets (Uranus, Neptune, Pluto) or Rahu/Ketu/Saturn. The first clause ('those ... which give life') is garbled.
classical_check: Classical: 'daitya' usually points to Rahu and Ketu, and 'krura' (cruel) to Saturn, Mars, Rahu, Ketu and Sun; the outer planets are not in classical texts.

hindi: यह तीनों के तीनों लक्ष्मी मैया पैर दबाती है विष्णु के यानी कि आप जब जब पुरुष होकर भी किसी के चरणों में जा रहे हो आपके तीनों प्लेनेट प्रबल हो रहे हैं अगर यह दोषी है तो दोष भी मुक्त हो रहा है
says: Remedy by humility: Lakshmi presses Vishnu's feet, so whenever you, even as a man, go to someone's feet in service, your three planets grow strong, and if they were afflicted the fault is also removed.
ambiguity: The 'three planets' are not named in this chunk; they may be the three just called demon planets, or Sun, Moon and Mars from the main thread. Whose feet and how often is not given.
classical_check: Classics advise serving elders and the guru as a remedy for afflicted planets, which agrees broadly; the 'three planets' mapping is his own.

hindi: ऐसे नहीं कहा गया स्त्रियों को व्रत र को कहा गया क्यों कहा गया है
says: He says it is not for nothing that fasting (vrat) is prescribed specifically for women, and asks why it was said; the reasons follow in the next lines.
ambiguity: Caption has a garbled word ('vrat r ko'); the meaning is clear from the next lines.
classical_check: Fasting rites for women (Karva Chauth, Teej, Hartalika) are traditional; classical jyotish texts do not give this reasoning.

gist: Social rant that society has gone wrong and men fight themselves to death while women are more necessary, starting the animal comparison (continues into the next chunk).

Animal analogies (hens kept for eggs while roosters are slaughtered, the cow as mother because of milk) used to argue that women must be protected, respected and kept healthy because we are born through them.

hindi: क्योंकि जो पैदा करेगी बेबी वो बेबी सेट पैदा होगा क्यों ऑटो फेजी अपने ही शरीर व्रत रखने पर अपने ही बॉडी के डेड सेल्स को खा जाता है कैंसर नहीं होएगा बीपी शुगर की प्रॉब्लम्स अपने आप कम रहेंगी
says: Women are told to fast to keep their health good so the baby they bear is born healthy. He gives a body-science reason (autophagy: the fasting body eats its own dead cells) and claims this prevents cancer and keeps BP and sugar problems low, and that fasting was made a religious duty so it would be followed. These are his health claims, not astrology, and are recorded only as his statement, not as medical advice.
ambiguity: This is a medical claim with no chart link; 'cancer will not happen' is an absolute that cannot be stated as fact. Autophagy during fasting is real physiology, but the cancer and BP outcomes are overstated.
classical_check: Classical jyotish is silent on autophagy or any disease-prevention reasoning; vrat is a Dharmashastra and folk tradition.

hindi: अब उन खास खास दिनों के व्रतों का महातम है चंद्रमा की चतुर्थी पर वो करवा चौत रखना है
says: Certain special-day fasts carry a particular significance, and for the Moon the fast is on the chaturthi (fourth lunar day), when Karva Chauth is kept.
ambiguity: 'Moon's chaturthi' is the fourth tithi after the full moon in the lunar month of Kartik (Karva Chauth); he does not name the month here.
classical_check: Karva Chauth is on Kartik Krishna Chaturthi (purnimanta) with the fast broken at moonrise; this matches the tradition. It is not a rule in the classical jyotish texts.

hindi: सूर्य उन दिनों में सात नंबर राशि का होता है नीच होता हाईली नेगेटिव सबसे नेगेटिव सात नंबर कहां होता है
says: In those Karva Chauth days (October-November) the Sun is in sign number 7 (Libra), where it is debilitated and highly negative, the most negative position for the Sun.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's debilitation in Libra works through the house Libra falls in for the lagna and the houses the Sun lords: Libra in the 1st weakens the self, in the 4th the home and family peace, in the 10th career authority. A cancellation (neecha bhanga) is not mentioned by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra, Sun lords the 11th and is debilitated in the 1st: weak vitality and ego, and gains through personal effort feel muted.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Sun lords the 2nd and is debilitated in the 4th: strain on family wealth and on peace at home.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Sun lords the 8th and is debilitated in the 10th: authority and recognition at work are blocked and delayed.

ambiguity: He says 'where is number 7' and the answer follows in the next sentence. The Sun is in Libra in the sidereal (Lahiri) calendar from about mid-October to mid-November, which matches Karva Chauth.
classical_check: Classical: Sun is debilitated in Libra at 10 degrees; this agrees. The pairing with Karva Chauth is calendar, not jyotish doctrine.

hindi: दो और सात नंबर होता है हृदय प उसके दिल में किसी किस्म का मैल नहीं
says: He places signs 2 and 7 (Taurus and Libra) at the heart, so keeping the fast means no kind of malice or ill-feeling will arise in a woman's heart. This ties the Sun's debilitation in sign 7 to the heart region.
cells_derived_method: Taurus and Libra are Venus's signs, so heart and affection matters would be read through Venus in these signs and the house they fall in: in the 4th, inner emotional peace; in the 5th, romance and children; in the 7th, spouse.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra in the 4th (lagna Cancer): the heart-sign sits on the home house, so emotional peace at home depends on keeping a balanced feeling and a clean heart.
Derived: Taurus in the 5th (lagna Capricorn): the heart-sign sits on love and children, with steady, faithful affection when the mind is calm.

ambiguity: The caption is garbled. It is unclear whether 'heart' refers to the signs (2 and 7) or to a body zone; classically the heart belongs to Leo and the Sun and the 4th house, not to Taurus and Libra. He may mean Venus's love sense.
classical_check: Differs: classical body-part mapping puts the heart at Leo (5th sign), not Taurus (face and neck) or Libra (lower abdomen); Venus rules love but not the heart organ.

hindi: आएगा भटकाव नहीं होगा भटकाव नहीं होगा तो भटका हुआ बेबी पैदा नहीं होगा
says: Remedy rationale: if the fasting woman has no malice in her heart, her mind will not wander, and because the mind does not wander, a wayward or astray child will not be born to her.
ambiguity: The chain from heart to mind to the child's nature is his claim; the Moon is implied (mind) but not named in this sentence.
classical_check: Classical texts link the mother's mind (Moon) to her child's temperament in a general way; this fasting-to-child claim is not in them.

hindi: भटकाव नहीं होगा तो प्रेम करेगी उसका हृदय ठीक रहेगा हार्ट अटैक नहीं होगा क्या गजब की साइंस ले रखी थी हमारे जानकारों ने
says: With no wandering, she will love, her heart stays well and she will not get a heart attack; he praises the 'science' of the old sages. This is a health claim of his, not astrology, and no heart attack can be guaranteed away by fasting.
ambiguity: A medical absolute ('no heart attack') that cannot be accepted as fact; recorded only as his claim.
classical_check: Classical jyotish is silent on fasting and heart attacks; heart disease is read from the Sun, Leo and the 4th and 5th houses, not from vrat.

gist: Rant that men do not need such rules (they will eat, fight and die anyway, and if one becomes wise he becomes a guru) while women must be looked after, so the fast was assigned to women.

hindi: इसलिए उसको व्रत रखने को कह दिया गया उसके मन की चंचलता अपने आप शांत होगी क्रोध ही नहीं करेगी
says: The fast was assigned to a woman so that the fickleness of her mind settles on its own and she does not get angry; fasting is used as a calming remedy for the restless, Moon-ruled mind.
cells_derived_method: The calming effect would matter most where the Moon is weak or afflicted, for example the Moon in Scorpio (debilitated) or the Moon in a dusthana, and where the 4th house or its lord carries mental stress.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 6th (lagna Gemini): a restless, irritable mind that gets angry at conflict, where calming practices would be tried.
Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 12th (lagna Cancer): a mind that races at night with sleeplessness and overthinking; a fast is offered as a calmer.

ambiguity: The Moon is implied by the 'fickle mind' idea from earlier but not named in this sentence.
classical_check: Classical: fasting on the Moon's day (Monday) or on tithis is the stated remedy for a weak Moon; this agrees in spirit.

hindi: बिंदी लगा दो यहां थर्ड आई बंद कर दी उसकी फालतू सोचना ही नहीं बहन मेरी ने क्रोध ही नहीं करेगी
says: Remedy by custom: put a bindi on the forehead, which he says closes the third eye, so she does not think idly and so does not get angry.
ambiguity: The caption is rough ('behan meri ne'); 'closes the third eye' is his image for calming the ajna point, and the exact bindi position and colour are not given.
classical_check: Classical jyotish is silent; the ajna chakra and tilak between the brows is yogic and Tantric lore. He says it closes the third eye, whereas the usual tradition says it protects or activates it, so he differs from the common view.

gist: Comic line about a man taking off his shoe, hitting his own head and cursing himself, then saying 'fine, curse me too'.
Biology talk that women rarely beat their heads, nature made them fit and resistant, they fall ill less and do not die easily, and that in premature births the girl survives while the boy dies.

hindi: यह स्त्री ग्रह चंद्रमा मोती मां होता है
says: The Moon is a feminine planet; its gem is the pearl, and it stands for the mother.
ambiguity: None; the gem and mother links repeat what was said earlier, here grouped with the gender of the planet.
classical_check: Classical: Moon is a feminine planet, its gem is the pearl, and it is the mother karaka; this agrees.

hindi: यह सूर्यकांत है मालिक यह चंद्र कांता है इसकी पत्नी यह पति पत्नी नहीं है य माता और पिता के समान है
says: The Sun is the lord (Suryakant) and the Moon is Chandrakanta, his consort; but he corrects himself that they are not husband and wife and are to be taken as mother and father.
ambiguity: He first calls the Moon the Sun's wife and then rejects that, so the pair relationship is parent figures, not spouses.
classical_check: Classical texts treat Sun and Moon as king and queen (raja and rani) and as father and mother; the husband-wife reading he rejects is a later popular addition, and he agrees with the classics on parents.

hindi: इसकी वजह से एजिस्ट करता है चांद की रोशनी मिलती है सूर्य से तो सूर्य इज परम किंग परम आत्मा
says: The Moon exists and shines because of the Sun, since moonlight comes from the Sun; therefore the Sun is the supreme king and the supreme soul (atma).
ambiguity: 'Exist' is meant in the sense of being visible and lit, not that the Moon's body depends on the Sun.
classical_check: Classical: Sun is the atmakaraka (soul) and Moon's light is borrowed from the Sun; the Surya Siddhanta states this and the BPHS agrees, so it is accurate.

hindi: यह मंगल ये सेनापति है यह बेटा है 2 साल
says: Mars is the commander-in-chief (senapati) and the son in the planetary family. The caption adds '2 saal' (two years), which is unclear and may refer to age or a period.
ambiguity: '2 saal' cannot be placed; it might be a garble of 'to saal' or a timing remark.
classical_check: Classical: Mars is the commander of the planets (senapati) and a young, prince-like planet; the son link is not stated in this form, though Mars is a karaka of brothers and Jupiter of sons.

hindi: इसके लिए मूंगा पहनाया जाता है
says: Remedy: red coral (moonga) is worn for Mars.
cells_derived_method: Coral suits lagnas where Mars is a friendly or functional benefic lord (Aries, Scorpio, Cancer, Leo, Sagittarius, Pisces) and needs caution where Mars lords a maraka or dusthana (Libra 2nd and 7th, Gemini 6th and 11th, Virgo 3rd and 8th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in the 1st (lagna Aries): Mars is the lagna lord in its own sign, so coral is the natural supportive gem.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra): Mars lords the 2nd and 7th (marakas), so coral needs checking despite the exaltation.

ambiguity: No condition for suitability is given in this sentence.
classical_check: Classical: coral (praval) is the gem of Mars in all texts; this agrees.

hindi: इसके पास शौर्य है ताकत है वीरता है
says: Mars is the planet of valour, physical strength and bravery.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Classical: Mars is the karaka of courage, strength and valour; this agrees.

hindi: आठ नंबर राशि भी इसी की है लेकिन ये आठ नंबर की राशि इसने लोन पर दे रखी है किसे इंद्र को
says: Sign number 8 (Scorpio) also belongs to Mars, but he says Mars has given it out on loan to Indra, meaning Uranus in his 12-planet scheme; so Scorpio is shared between Mars and Uranus.
cells_derived_method: For Scorpio, which owner's result applies depends on the house Scorpio falls in: the Mars side (action, courage) is read in houses like the 3rd and 6th, and the Uranus side (sudden change, research) in houses like the 8th and 11th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio, Mars as the lagna lord gives the body and drive, with the Uranus tenant adding sudden, unconventional turns in the personality.
Derived: lagna Gemini, Scorpio in the 6th: Mars side shows in fighting disputes and illness, Uranus side in unexpected turns in daily work.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Scorpio in the 10th: Mars side gives forceful career action, Uranus side gives unusual, technology-led career shifts.

ambiguity: 'Also' implies Mars's other sign is Aries (number 1), but this sentence does not say so. 'Loan' means shared lordship; whether Mars still keeps the lord role is unclear. 'Indra' stands for Uranus, as set up in his diagram of the previous week.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give Scorpio only to Mars (Ketu as co-lord in some schools); no classical text has Uranus as Scorpio's lord.

hindi: तो यदि इंद्र की करेक्शन करनी है तो भी मंगल से हो जाएगी मुंगे से हो जाएगी
says: Remedy: if Indra (Uranus) needs correcting, it can be done through Mars, that is by coral; since Uranus is Mars's tenant in Scorpio, the Mars remedy covers it.
cells_derived_method: The Mars-coral route for Uranus matters where Uranus sits in Scorpio, because that is the sign they share; in other signs the Uranus fix may need its own remedy, which he does not state.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in Scorpio in the 3rd (lagna Virgo): its problems in effort and siblings are treated through Mars with coral, if coral suits Virgo lagna (Mars lords the 3rd and 8th, so check).
Derived: Uranus in Scorpio in the 12th (lagna Sagittarius): losses and sudden foreign moves are treated through Mars (lord of the 5th and 12th) with coral.

ambiguity: He does not say if the Uranus-by-Mars rule holds outside Scorpio; the 'diagram' he refers to was shared last week and is not in this chunk.
classical_check: Classical texts have no Uranus, so there is no classical rule; the Mars-coral link follows only from his sign-sharing idea.

gist: Says the topic is very detailed and he is giving only a short pass ('taking a shot') before moving to the next planet.

hindi: पन्ना बुध बुध होता है बुध के लिए जो दो के साथ सात है 10 के साथ
says: Remedy: emerald (panna) is the gem for Mercury. He then starts another note about Mercury with numbers (two with seven, ten with ...) that breaks off at the end of the chunk.
cells_derived_method: Emerald suits lagnas where Mercury is a functional benefic lord (Gemini, Virgo, Taurus, Capricorn, Aquarius) and needs caution where it lords the 6th, 8th or 12th (Aries 6th, Scorpio 8th, Sagittarius 7th and 10th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Virgo in the 1st (lagna Virgo): Mercury is the lagna lord in its own and exalted sign, so emerald is the natural supportive gem.
Derived: Mercury in Gemini in the 8th (lagna Scorpio): Mercury lords the 8th and 11th and sits in the 8th, so emerald needs caution.

ambiguity: The numbers 'two with seven, 10 with ...' are cut off and may be sign numbers for Mercury or for other planets; they cannot be read, so no sign cells are recorded.
classical_check: Classical: emerald is the gem of Mercury in all texts; this agrees.

hindi: बुध जो है इसके लिए पन्ना पहनाया जाता है
says: The gemstone prescribed for Mercury is emerald (panna); it is worn to strengthen Mercury.
ambiguity: Caption opens with a stray '11' before Mercury, probably the tail of the previous sentence (a sign or house number); 11 is not a Mercury sign (Gemini 3, Virgo 6).
classical_check: Agrees: emerald is the classical gem for Mercury.

hindi: बुध क्या है वाणी कम्युनिकेशन
says: Mercury signifies speech (vani) and communication in general.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is the classical karaka of speech, intellect and communication.

hindi: बुध के द्वारा यह बुद्ध है जो इतनी बकबक चल रही है जरूर मेरे बुध का कुछ लफड़ा है जो मैं इतना ज्यादा फालतू बोलता हूं
says: Joking about his own long lecture, he implies that constant needless talking is a sign something is off with Mercury. Recorded as a loose diagnostic claim made half in jest.
cells_derived_method: none: no placement or affliction is named, so nothing house or sign specific can be derived.
ambiguity: Said as a self-directed joke; 'बुद्ध' is probably a caption slip for बुध. No condition (sign, house, aspect) is given for the supposed Mercury problem.
classical_check: Silent on idle chatter specifically; classically an afflicted Mercury disturbs speech and the nervous system.

hindi: अगर बुध रिफाइंड है तो रॉकेट जैसी बात निकलेगी
says: If Mercury is refined (well conditioned and free of bad influence), the person's speech comes out sharp, fast and on target, like a rocket.
cells_derived_method: Refinement depends on Mercury's sign dignity (own in Gemini and Virgo, exalted in Virgo, debilitated in Pisces), on its house, and on benefic versus malefic influence, so the same speech quality varies across cells.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury exalted in Virgo in the 1st house (lagna Virgo) is about as refined as Mercury gets, so crisp, precise, target-hitting speech is expected.
Derived: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 6th house (lagna Libra) is unrefined by sign; sharp speech would need outside support, such as the Jupiter influence he describes next.

ambiguity: 'Refined' is not defined; taken as dignity plus benefic support.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: a strong, unafflicted Mercury gives eloquence; the rocket image is his own.

hindi: बृहस्पति के द्वारा इफल है तो ज्ञान निकलेगा शांति से चलेगा डिस्टर्ब नहीं हो
says: When Mercury (speech) is under Jupiter's influence, what comes out is real knowledge, delivered calmly and without disturbance.
cells_derived_method: The house where the Mercury-Jupiter link falls decides the field in which the knowledgeable speech shows (2nd family and speech, 5th learning, 9th teaching, 10th profession); the sign decides how smoothly it flows.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in its own sign Gemini with Jupiter in the 2nd house (lagna Taurus): the speech and family house carries teaching-quality knowledge, spoken calmly.
Derived: Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius with Mercury in the 9th house (lagna Aries): speech turns to dharma, preaching and guidance, delivered with calm authority.

ambiguity: 'इफल' is a caption garble, most likely 'influence' (इन्फ्लुएंस); whether he means conjunction, aspect or general association is not stated.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit (Jupiter's contact gives wise speech) but Jupiter treats Mercury as an enemy in Parashari friendship tables, so classical results are mixed.

hindi: शांति से चलेगा डिस्टर्ब नहीं हो तो चंद्रमा का कारण आ गया
says: If the speech stays calm and undisturbed, that quality is credited to the Moon's factor having joined Mercury.
cells_derived_method: The Moon's sign strength and the house of the Mercury-Moon link set how soothing and emotional the speech is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in its own sign Cancer joins Mercury in the 4th house (lagna Aries): soft, caring, home-centred speech, low on friction.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus joins Mercury in the 3rd house (lagna Pisces): soothing, steady communication, pleasant talk and writing with siblings and neighbours.

ambiguity: Caption is broken: it may mean 'no disturbance, so it is the Moon's doing' or be the tail of the Jupiter clause. 'कारण' may stand for कारक (significator) or प्रभाव.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Moon with Mercury gives a soft, imaginative mind; in Parashari tables Mercury treats the Moon as an enemy while the Moon treats Mercury as a friend.

hindi: यदि उसमें फोकस बहुत तगड़ा है तो शनि का आ गया
says: If the speech or knowledge carries very strong, unwavering focus, it is Saturn's factor that has joined Mercury.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's dignity and the house of the link decide whether the focus is disciplined and useful or heavy and restrictive.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Capricorn, a sign it rules, joins Mercury in the 10th house (lagna Aries): disciplined, structured speech at work, slow but dependable.
Derived: Saturn in Aquarius, another sign it rules, joins Mercury in the 3rd house (lagna Sagittarius): measured communication and persistent, methodical writing or effort.

ambiguity: Link type (conjunction, aspect) not specified.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury with Saturn is read as serious, methodical, sustained thinking; Saturn and Mercury are friends in Parashari tables.

hindi: यदि वह ज्ञान उड़ उड़ के आ रहा उड़ उड़ रे पतंग मेरी उड़ी रे फालतू था तो यह राहु का आ गया
says: If the knowledge or talk keeps flying about like a kite, drifting and pointless, it is Rahu's factor mixing with Mercury: scattered, restless, exaggerated expression.
cells_derived_method: Rahu amplifies whatever house and sign it sits with; the house of the Mercury-Rahu link shows where the speech scatters or inflates.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury exalted in Virgo with Rahu in the 3rd house (lagna Cancer): outsized communication and media or sales talent, with a tendency to exaggerate or scatter.
Derived: Mercury in Gemini, a sign it rules, with Rahu in the 5th house (lagna Aquarius): quick, speculative ideas that fly about, strong curiosity and weak follow-through in studies.

ambiguity: The kite song is an illustration of aimless talk; link type not given.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Rahu with Mercury is read as cunning, exaggerated or unconventional speech.

hindi: यह जो फालतू बात बीच रास्ते में की शुक्र आ गया
says: Casual, pleasant, off-the-cuff chatter done in passing along the way is Venus colouring Mercury.
cells_derived_method: Venus's dignity and the house of the link decide whether the talk is charming and social or merely idle.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in its own sign Taurus with Mercury in the 7th house (lagna Scorpio): charming, easy, pleasantly idle talk inside partnerships.
Derived: Venus in its own sign Libra with Mercury in the 11th house (lagna Sagittarius): social, light chit-chat across the friend circle and networks.

ambiguity: 'बीच रास्ते में की' is unclear: casual talk on the way, or talk that interrupts. The Venus link may mean sweet or flirtatious talk; this is an inference.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mercury with Venus gives a pleasant, artistic, witty tongue; 'idle' is his emphasis.

hindi: यानी कि अलग अलग तरीके से सारे एक्सप्रेशन है
says: Each companion planet gives the same underlying speech and knowledge function a different style of expression; the list just given is a catalogue of those styles.
cells_derived_method: none: a summary of the preceding rows, not itself house or sign dependent.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard practice of reading a planet through its conjunctions and aspects.

hindi: और यदि ज्ञान तक है छोड़ दिया त्याग दिया क्या रखा है मोह छोड़ो मोक्ष प्राप्त करो केतु आ गया
says: If the talk turns to renunciation (drop it, give it up, nothing is in it, leave attachment, seek moksha), it is Ketu's factor with Mercury: detached, liberation-themed speech.
cells_derived_method: Ketu detaches whatever it touches; the house and sign of the Mercury-Ketu link show which area of speech and learning is renounced or withdrawn.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury debilitated in Pisces with Ketu in the 12th house (lagna Aries): withdrawn, detached speech that drifts toward renunciation and moksha themes.
Derived: Mercury with Ketu in Cancer in the 9th house (lagna Scorpio): philosophical talk of letting go, a renunciant tone in discussions of dharma.

ambiguity: 'ज्ञान तक है' is garbled, probably 'ज्ञान कहता है' (the knowledge says). Link type not stated.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Ketu is the karaka of renunciation and moksha, and Ketu with Mercury is read as detached, occult or philosophical speech.

hindi: एक ही ग्रह के साथ अन्य ग्रह किस प्रकार चलते हैं
says: He frames the lesson as how the other planets accompany one single planet: read a planet through the companions that colour it, shown here with Mercury as the example.
cells_derived_method: none: a statement of method, not tied to a house or sign.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard method of judging a planet by yuti (conjunction), drishti (aspect) and association.

hindi: यह बुध है बुध बहन बुआ बेटी साली होती है यह बुद्धि का है
says: In the household picture Mercury stands for the young female relatives: sister, father's sister (bua), daughter and wife's sister (sali), and it is the planet of intellect (buddhi).
classical_check: Partly differs: classical lists give Mercury as maternal uncle, friends and younger relatives; the exact female-relative set here is his teaching extension. Intellect agrees.

hindi: यह मंगल जो है बेटा है सेनापति है
says: Mars is the son of the household and the commander-in-chief (senapati) of the planetary court.
classical_check: Commander role agrees (Mars is the army chief in the planetary cabinet); 'son' differs, since the classical child karaka is Jupiter and Mars signifies brothers.

hindi: यह चंद्रकांता है माता है प्रेम है माया भी यही है श्रृंगार बनाव प्रेम शांति पालन पोषण
says: The Moon is the mother figure and stands for love, maya (emotional attachment), adornment and make-up, peace, and nurturing or upbringing.
ambiguity: 'चंद्रकांता' could be a feminine name for the Moon or the moonstone. 'Maya' is given to the Moon here but later to Saturn, so he uses the word in two senses (attachment versus material illusion).
classical_check: Agrees on mother, peace and nurture; adornment and love overlap with Venus in classical lists.

hindi: सूर्य जो है पिता है जो मालिक है पूरे गांव का सरपंच है भाई य
says: The Sun is the father, the owner, and the sarpanch (headman) of the whole village: the ruling authority of the system.
ambiguity: The trailing 'भाई य' is probably a filler address to the audience ('brother, ...'), not a family relation.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is father, king and authority.

hindi: इसके बाद आ गया बृहस्पति यह गुरु यह गुरु है इसका स्टोन होता है पुखराज
says: Jupiter is the guru-planet, and its gemstone is yellow sapphire (pukhraj).
classical_check: Agrees: yellow sapphire is the classical gem for Jupiter.

hindi: 12 नंबर राशि भी इसी की है यह इसी के इला में है और यह केतु को दी हुई है
says: Sign number 12 (Pisces) also belongs to Jupiter, sits on Jupiter's Ida side, and has been handed to Ketu as well, so in his scheme Pisces is shared by Jupiter and Ketu.
cells_derived_method: Wherever Pisces falls as a house, both Jupiter's themes (knowledge, grace) and Ketu's themes (detachment, release) colour that house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces rising, so Jupiter's wisdom and Ketu's detachment both colour the self and temperament.
Derived: Pisces on the 12th house (lagna Aries): losses, foreign lands and liberation themes carry both Jupiter's blessing and Ketu's withdrawal.
Derived: Pisces on the 5th house (lagna Scorpio): learning, children and creativity touched by Jupiter's knowledge and Ketu's detachment from results.

ambiguity: 'इला' is probably 'Ida' (the left subtle channel) rather than 'territory'. 'यह केतु को दी हुई है' could refer to Pisces or to Jupiter's other sign; read here as Pisces, matching his scheme where Pisces is Jupiter or Ketu.
classical_check: Differs: classical lordship of Pisces is Jupiter alone; Ketu sharing it is a modern, school-specific scheme.

hindi: हमने यह हमारा जो डायग्राम था जिसमें एक नंबर से राशियां घूमती है गोल गोल गोल पिछले हफ्ते बात हो चुकी है तो दो दो राशिया इकट्ठा पड़ती है हर पोर्टल के ऊपर एक राइट साइड के इ और पिंगला
says: Recalls last week's circular diagram that runs the signs from number 1: signs fall in pairs, two together at each point, one on the right side and one on the left (Ida and Pingala), which is why a planet carries two signs.
cells_derived_method: Applies to sign pairs; in the classical pairing these are Aries-Scorpio (Mars), Taurus-Libra (Venus), Gemini-Virgo (Mercury), Sagittarius-Pisces (Jupiter), Capricorn-Aquarius (Saturn). He does not list them in this passage.
ambiguity: 'पोर्टल' is probably a garble of 'planet' or 'pole' or chakra; 'इ' is Ida. The diagram is from an earlier lecture and not visible here, so the exact pairing is unconfirmed.
classical_check: Silent: Ida and Pingala are yogic channels, not part of classical sign-lordship tables.

hindi: बृहस्पति के लिए पुखराज है आपके जीवन में जितना ज्ञान है जितना गुरु समान चीज है
says: Jupiter stands for all the knowledge present in your life and for everything guru-like in it (teachers, guidance); yellow sapphire is named again as its stone.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the karaka of knowledge, teachers and guidance.

hindi: यह गुरु सूर्य का भी गुरु है यानी सूर्य ने जो धरती वगैरह का बैलेंस बना रखा है वो बृहस्पति की वजह से बना रखा है
says: Jupiter is the guru even of the Sun; the balance the Sun keeps over the Earth and other bodies exists only because of Jupiter.
classical_check: Partly differs: classically the Sun is king and Jupiter the minister and preceptor of the devas; the claim that Jupiter physically holds the system together is his own cosmology.

gist: Reminds the audience that Jupiter's role of holding all of space was explained earlier and says redrawing it would waste time.

hindi: अंतरिक्ष के अंदर बृहस्पति ही अकेला मेंटेन कर रहा है तो सारे ग्रह चल रहे हैं तो सूर्य जो देवता
says: Within space Jupiter alone does the maintaining, and that is why all the planets keep moving; this leads into the claim that the Sun is a deity because of Jupiter.
ambiguity: Sentence continues in the next caption chunk.
classical_check: Silent: Jupiter as sole maintainer of the planetary system is his own cosmology.

hindi: है वो देवता इसीलिए है क्योंकि बृहस्पति ने संभाल के रखा नहीं तो धरती को भी निकल जाएगा सूर्य इसलिए इस गुरु के दम पर ही सारा कार्यक्रम है
says: The Sun is a deity only because Jupiter has been holding everything together; without that the Sun would swallow or throw out even the Earth, so the whole cosmic programme runs on this guru's strength.
ambiguity: 'निकल जाएगा' could be 'निगल जाएगा' (swallow) or 'निकाल देगा' (throw out); the meaning is the same idea of the Sun harming the Earth.
classical_check: Silent; the Sun as devata is classical, the Jupiter-holds-the-system idea is his own.

hindi: गुरु हमारा सेक्स चक्र है हमारा वाटर चक्र है और 72 पर हम जल तत्व से बने हैं
says: Jupiter is our sex (sacral) chakra and our water chakra, and about 72 percent of us is made of the water element.
ambiguity: '72 पर' read as 72 percent; the caption number could be wrong. The chakra is named svadhisthana a few lines later.
classical_check: Differs: chakras are outside classical Jyotish, and Parashara gives Jupiter the ether element; water goes to Moon and Venus.

hindi: गुरु ही ज्ञान है और जल का देवता है वरुण जिसकी हम बात कर रहे हैं
says: Jupiter is knowledge itself, and the god of water is Varuna, the planet he has been discussing (Neptune in his set of twelve), tying Jupiter's water nature to Varuna.
ambiguity: Unclear whether Varuna is a water deity paired with Jupiter or the outer planet Neptune standing beside it; 'जिसकी हम बात कर रहे हैं' points to Varuna as Neptune in his scheme.
classical_check: Varuna as water deity is Vedic; mapping him to Neptune is his own, as Neptune is outside classical Jyotish.

hindi: कि आपका नवा भाव पंचम भाव देव कृपा सारी की सारी यही है
says: The 9th house and the 5th house together are where all divine grace (deva kripa) comes from.
cells_derived_method: Each of the 5th and 9th houses is touched by two or more signs (major and minor shares); the channel of grace takes the flavour of those signs and their lords, so the same houses give grace through different routes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 5th house in Pisces (lagna Scorpio): grace comes through Jupiter-type knowledge, teaching and devotion, with Ketu's detachment alongside in his scheme.
Derived: 9th house in Sagittarius (lagna Aries): grace flows through guru, dharma and Jupiter's own sign, a direct channel.
Derived: 5th house in Capricorn (lagna Virgo): grace arrives slowly, through discipline and effort (Saturn's sign), after delays.
Derived: 9th house in Gemini (lagna Libra): grace comes through learning, reading and communication (Mercury's sign), a more intellectual channel.

ambiguity: 'नवा भाव' read as the 9th house; he sometimes uses sign and house numbers interchangeably, but here context (grace) fits houses.
classical_check: Agrees: the 5th and 9th are the trikona houses of purva punya, blessings and fortune.

hindi: हमारा जन्म कहां से होता है एग्स कहां बनते हैं माता के ओवरीज कहां है जल चक्र स्पर्म कहां बनता है कहां से सेक्सुअल एक्टिविटी होती है जल चक्र इसी चक्र के द्वारा ही प्रजनन होती है
says: Birth and reproduction work through the water chakra: the mother's eggs and ovaries, sperm, and sexual activity all belong to it, so procreation happens through this chakra, which he gives to Jupiter. A body-function attribution only, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Jupiter as karaka of children and fertility agrees in spirit; the chakra mapping is outside classical texts.

hindi: यानी जब भी कोई नई चीज की उत्पत्ति होती है लाइट की स्क्वेयर स्पीड सी स्क्वायर की स्पीड से स्वाधिष्ठान चक्र से बूम ब्लास्ट करके जाता है हमारे अंतरिक्ष के अंदर एक इलेक्ट्रोमैग्नेटिक सिग्नल
says: Whenever something new is created, a signal leaves the svadhisthana (water) chakra with a boom at 'c squared' speed as an electromagnetic signal into space, so creation is tied to Jupiter's chakra. This is his own analogy.
ambiguity: 'लाइट की स्क्वेयर स्पीड' is a loose reference to c squared (E equals mc squared); physically imprecise, and the caption may be garbled.
classical_check: Silent: a modern-physics gloss with no classical basis.

hindi: और वो चीज ठीक होती है यहीं ईगो भी रहती है क्योंकि टेढ़ा मेढ़ा गुरु होगा तो घमंडी बहुत होगा गमी नंबर वन हो सकता है ड्रामा कर सकता है
says: Ego also lives in this same chakra, so if Jupiter is crooked or afflicted the person becomes very arrogant, can be number-one proud and prone to drama.
cells_derived_method: How Jupiter is afflicted (debilitation, enemy sign, malefic contact) and the house it sits in decide where the pride shows.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 10th house (lagna Aries): wisdom is reduced and pride about status or position can fill the gap.
Derived: Jupiter placed in Mercury's Virgo in the 3rd house (lagna Cancer), a sign unfriendly to it: pride can show in self-promotion, speech and writing.

ambiguity: 'गमी नंबर वन' is probably 'घमंडी नंबर वन'; 'टेढ़ा मेढ़ा' means afflicted but no specific affliction is named; 'वो चीज ठीक होती है' is unclear.
classical_check: Agrees in part: afflicted Jupiter is classically linked with pride, preachiness and excess.

hindi: यह बृहस्पति गुरु है इस गुरु के आगे बुद्ध बुद्धि का इसको यह माफ करता है बिटिया है घर की
says: In the household story Mercury (intellect), the daughter of the house, stands in deference before Jupiter the guru.
cells_derived_method: none: a single relationship claim with a garbled verb, so no house or sign reading is drawn.
ambiguity: 'इसको यह माफ करता है' literally means 'forgives'; it is probably 'मानता है' (respects) or 'माफिक' (suits). The meaning is uncertain.
classical_check: Differs: Jupiter regards Mercury as an enemy in Parashari friendship tables, and Mercury regards Jupiter as neutral.

hindi: यह मंगल है सेनापति सेनापति तो सेवा में लगेगा गुरु की यह मित्र है इनके देखो किस तरह मित्र है
says: Mars the commander will serve Jupiter the guru; he presents Mars as Jupiter's friend, one that works in the guru's service.
cells_derived_method: Friendship changes comfort by sign: each planet is at ease in the other's sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Mars's sign Aries in the 9th house (lagna Leo): Jupiter sits in a friend's home, so dharma and guidance get courage and drive.
Derived: Mars in Jupiter's sign Sagittarius in the 5th house (lagna Leo): Mars serves Jupiter's agenda, with energy put into learning, teaching and creative work.

classical_check: Agrees: Mars and Jupiter are natural friends in Parashari tables.

hindi: चंद्रमा यह तो माता है गुरु घर में आया उसके चरणों का ध्यान करती है माता खाना पना खिलाती है माता स्वागत करती है फूल की थाली सजाती है
says: The Moon, as the mother of the household, receives Jupiter the guru with care: she attends to his feet, feeds him, welcomes him and sets a flower platter; so the Moon is Jupiter's warm, honouring friend.
cells_derived_method: The Moon-Jupiter friendship is most visible when one stands in the other's sign or the two are placed in mutual kendras.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer, the Moon's home, in the 4th house (lagna Aries): the mother-and-guru pairing at its warmest, with comfort, blessings and a peaceful home.
Derived: Moon placed in Jupiter's sign Sagittarius in the 6th house (lagna Cancer): the Moon is hosted by a friend, so feelings find teacher-like support even in a house of work and struggle.

classical_check: Agrees: Moon and Jupiter are natural friends, and Gaja Kesari yoga is built on their kendra link.

hindi: सूर्य राजा भी उतर के आता आसन से कहता आइए गुरु जी
says: Even the Sun, the king, comes down from his seat and welcomes Jupiter with 'please come, Guru-ji': the Sun respects and befriends Jupiter.
cells_derived_method: Sun and Jupiter are most comfortable in each other's signs, Leo and Sagittarius.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in the Sun's sign Leo in the 9th house (lagna Sagittarius): guru-wisdom hosted by the king, with dharma carried with authority and dignity.
Derived: Sun in Jupiter's sign Sagittarius in the 1st house (lagna Sagittarius): the king sits in the guru's home, an authoritative self that still respects teachers.

classical_check: Agrees: Sun and Jupiter are natural friends.

gist: Says all these household stories are constructed only to help the audience understand the planets' relationships.

hindi: यह शुक्र है इसके पास वैभव है सारी ऐश है काम वासना आनंद स्त्री भोग विलास
says: Venus holds splendour and comfort: luxury, every kind of ease, desire (kama), joy, women or the wife, and sensory enjoyment.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the karaka of luxury, desire, pleasure and the wife.

hindi: अगर आपकी लाइफ में भोग विलास नहीं है आप सेक्स मात्र को भोग विलास ना समझे बढ़िया कपड़े अच्छा इतर आनंद खानपान स्वाद मस्ती घूमना फिरना ठिठोली रोमांस अगर यह नहीं है तो शुक्र डिस्टर्ब है
says: If a person's life lacks enjoyment (good clothes, perfume, pleasure, food and taste, fun, outings, banter, romance; not sex alone), then Venus is disturbed in that chart.
cells_derived_method: Venus is disturbed by weak sign dignity, by malefic contact and by difficult houses; the cell of Venus therefore decides how much enjoyment shows up.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 6th house (lagna Aries): enjoyment is hampered and turns into routine, service and friction, a candidate for his disturbed-Venus pattern.
Derived: Venus exalted in Pisces in the 7th house (lagna Virgo): Venus is strong, so comforts and romance are expected to be present, the opposite case.

ambiguity: The caption continues past this point; 'इतर' is perfume (itr).
classical_check: Agrees broadly: a weak or afflicted Venus is read as lack of comfort, romance and luxury.

gist: Rhetorical remark: imagine how poor life's course is when those pleasures are missing.

hindi: यदि तुक्के से आपकी कुंडली अलाव करती है कि आपको हीरा सूट करता है या सफेद पुखराज तो यह पहनने से सारी चीज ठीक हो
says: Remedy: if the chart happens to permit it, diamond or white pukhraj (white topaz or white sapphire), the Venus stones, are said to set everything right, A to Z. He overstates the effect, so treat it as a tradition claim.
ambiguity: 'तुक्के से' means 'by chance'; 'अलाव' means 'allow'. The chart condition for suitability is not specified; the sentence runs into the next caption chunk.
classical_check: Agrees on diamond and white stones for Venus; classical advice is that gems are worn only when the chart supports the planet, and a total fix is not promised.

hindi: यानी कि आपकी पत्नी है रोमांस है कि नहीं है पति है रोमांस है कि नहीं है मस्ती है नहीं है
says: Whether romance and fun exist with your wife or husband is the test of Venus: its presence or absence in the marriage shows the state of Venus.
ambiguity: He applies Venus to both husband and wife.
classical_check: Partly differs: Venus is the wife karaka for a man, while Jupiter is the husband karaka for a woman in classical texts; he uses Venus for both.

hindi: लेकिन अगर कुंडली अलाव करती है तो ऐसा होगा अदर वाइज नहीं होगा
says: Principle: a gemstone or remedy delivers its result only if the birth chart allows it; otherwise it will not work.
classical_check: Agrees: classical gem advice depends on the chart (lagna lord, yogakaraka, dasha), not on the planet alone.

gist: Repeats that diamond or white pukhraj is worn for Venus.

hindi: मौज मस्ती अयाशी पार्टी कर रहे हैं आपने दारू पी मस्ती से पी खराब नहीं किया उसने कुछ भी
says: Venus also covers fun, revelry, indulgence and partying; he adds in passing that drinking alcohol cheerfully did not spoil anything. This is a casual remark, not a recommendation.
ambiguity: 'खराब नहीं किया उसने कुछ भी' is unclear: who did not spoil what; probably 'enjoyment taken joyfully does no harm'.
classical_check: Venus as pleasure and entertainment is classical; the alcohol remark is not astrological.

hindi: किडनी सारी शुक्र के पास होती है बृहस्पति क्रोध वहां रहता है
says: The kidneys fall under Venus; he adds that Jupiter and anger also reside in that area. Body-part attribution only, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'बृहस्पति क्रोध वहां रहता है' is unclear: either 'Jupiter and anger live there' or 'Jupiter's anger'. Anger (krodh) is classically a Mars quality.
classical_check: Venus as kidney and urinary-system significator agrees with many classical lists; Jupiter and anger there is his own.

hindi: यानी कि सोचो किडनी बचानी है आपका शुक्र ठीक होना चाहिए आपका बृहस्पति ठीक होना चाहिए मंगल की दृष्टि ठीक होनी चाहिए
says: Tradition claim about kidney health: Venus must be sound, Jupiter must be sound, and Mars's aspect must be sound, all together and not one alone. Recorded as his statement, not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: none: the target of Mars's aspect (Venus, or a kidney-related house) is not stated, so no house or sign reading is derived. A derived test would check Venus and Jupiter dignity and whether Mars aspects Venus.
ambiguity: Which house or planet Mars's aspect must fall on is not said; 'ठीक' is undefined.
classical_check: Partly agrees: health judgement uses the significator planet plus the relevant house; the three-planet combination is his own.

hindi: मल्टीपल है अकेला नहीं कि एक पत्थर पहन लिया काम हो गया यह बहुत कॉम्प्लिकेटेड है
says: Principle: a result has multiple causes, so wearing one stone does not finish the job; chart reading is complicated because several planets work together.
classical_check: Agrees: classical judgement weighs several factors together rather than one planet or one remedy.

gist: No matter how much astrology you study, you cannot know anything without practical experience.

hindi: हमने यहां काम देखें जो परमात्मा ने जीवन में पता नहीं कहां कहा से सिखाया दो धागे पहनाओ काम हो गया दर्दे गायब हो गई रिड की हड्डियां सीधी हो गई क्लेश खत्म हो गए
says: Anecdote about a thread remedy taught to him from an unknown source: putting on two threads is claimed to have made pains vanish, spine bones straighten and household quarrels end; he credits the knowledge to the Divine. A claimed result, not validated, and a health claim recorded as his statement only.
ambiguity: Which two threads (colour, planet, knotting) is not said. 'रिड की हड्डियां' means spine bones. The sentence continues into the next chunk ('यह परमात्मा देता है यह ज्ञान वहां से').
classical_check: Silent: thread remedies are folk practice, not part of Parashara or Brihat Jataka.

hindi: शनि यह आपका सेवक है शनिचर कहते हैं ना शनिचर धीरे-धीरे चलता है बूढ़ा सा है ढीला ढाला लेकिन यह आपका मुखिया है
says: Saturn is the household's servant (Shanichar), slow, old-looking and loose-limbed, yet he is also called the one in charge of the work.
ambiguity: 'मुखिया' (chief) clashes with Saturn being a servant and with the Sun being the village headman; probably means chief worker or foreman. Unresolved.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is slow, old, a servant and the karaka of labourers; the 'chief' wording is his own.

hindi: इतना जबरदस्त फोकस है इसके पास जिस व्यक्ति का फोकस बहुत स्ट्रांग है आप देखोगे फोकस्ड है उसका शनि बहुत स्ट्रंग है उसकी हड्डियां सेट होंगी
says: Saturn carries enormous focus; a person who is very focused is read as having a strong Saturn, and such a person's bones will be well set. The bone point is his claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's strength depends on sign dignity (own in Capricorn and Aquarius, exalted in Libra, debilitated in Aries) and on house; a strong placement fits a focused temperament and the bone claim, a weak one the opposite.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 7th house (lagna Aries): strong Saturn, so by his rule a steady, focused person with firm bones.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 10th house (lagna Cancer): weak Saturn, so by his rule focus is less steady and the bone claim runs weaker; neecha-bhanga conditions could change this.

classical_check: Agrees with Saturn as karaka of bones and persistence; the focus-to-Saturn link is a psychological gloss.

hindi: यानी अगर आपको अपनी हड्डियां भी ठीक करनी है आपका फोकस सेट होना चाहिए
says: Behavioural remedy claim: to mend your bones, first set your focus; steadying attention is presented as the route to improving Saturn's domain. Recorded as his claim, not medical advice.
classical_check: Silent: classical remedies for Saturn are mantra, charity, service and gems, not attention training.

hindi: जो लोग बात-बात पर फोकस बदलते हैं किसी ने कुछ कह दिया उसकी भड़का में आ गए जो व्यक्ति किसी के कहने पर कुछ नहीं मानते जब तक खुद ना आजमा ले उनको शरीर की हड्डियां मजबूत रहती है
says: Contrast: people who keep changing focus and get swayed by whatever others say are the unsteady type, while people who accept nothing on hearsay until they test it themselves keep strong bones. Saturn-type steadiness is again linked to bone strength; his claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: The weaker-bones outcome for the easily swayed group is implied, not spoken.
classical_check: Silent: the link between temperament and bone strength is his own.

hindi: सारी सारी की सारी हड्डियां शनि के पास है
says: All the bones of the body belong to Saturn.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn rules bones, joints and teeth.

hindi: शनि के पास मूलाधार चक्र है
says: The root chakra (muladhara) is assigned to Saturn.
classical_check: Chakra assignments are not in classical Jyotish; modern yogic mappings link muladhara to Saturn or Mars (earth).

hindi: शनि के पास सारी माया है शनि के पास सारी चिजी है प्रॉपर्टी जायदाद जमीन भोग विलास की चिजी भोग नहीं विलास नहीं चिजी
says: Saturn holds all the material maya: the things themselves, such as property, estate, land and luxury goods. He stresses the objects, not the enjoyment of them, which belongs to Venus.
ambiguity: 'Maya' was given to the Moon earlier as attachment; here it means material illusion and possessions, two senses of one word.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn signifies durable assets and labour, but the classical land karaka is Mars and property is read from the 4th house.

hindi: और इसी को आदेश देता है मालिक सूर्य सूर्य के आगे कभी नहीं जाता य कि वह तो गांव के मुखिया है बस आदेश पहुंच गया ठीक है जी जो कहो
says: The master Sun gives orders to Saturn; Saturn never goes in front of the Sun because the Sun is the village headman, and once an order arrives he simply obeys with 'yes sir, as you say'.
ambiguity: 'सूर्य के आगे कभी नहीं जाता' could mean Saturn never confronts or overtakes the Sun, or never appears before him in person; it is unclear whether this is social or astronomical.
classical_check: Differs: Parashari tables make Sun and Saturn mutual enemies (father and son); here they are master and obedient servant.

hindi: चंद्रमा यह जल है यह तेल है यह तेल इसको भी खा जाता है
says: The Moon is water and Saturn is oil; this oil is said to consume even the Moon, meaning Saturn can overpower the Moon.
ambiguity: The caption does not name who 'यह तेल' is (Saturn by context); 'खा जाता है' could mean absorbs or overpowers; the pronouns for oil and water are unclear.
classical_check: Silent on the oil and water image; Moon with Saturn (visha yoga) is classically read as a heavy or depressed mind.

hindi: इतना पुराना सेवक है कि सुनता तो य माता जी की भी नहीं लेकिन इसको जो काम सौप दिया जाए वह करता है
says: Saturn is such an old servant that he does not even listen to the mother (Moon), yet he faithfully carries out any task assigned to him: he obeys duty, not feeling.
classical_check: Consistent with Saturn's duty-bound, unemotional nature; Saturn treats the Moon as an enemy in Parashari tables.

hindi: इसलिए यदि किसी का मन दबा हुआ बिल्कुल शनि की दृष्टि है चंद्रमा के ऊपर वो जिंदगी भर उसका मन दबा रहेगा मन की बात कह नहीं सकता वो कभी कह ही नहीं पाता
says: Rule: if Saturn aspects the Moon, the person's mind stays suppressed for life and he cannot voice what is in his heart; he frets inside, things do not come to him, and if they do he does not enjoy them, living in planning and programming instead of experience.
cells_derived_method: Saturn aspects the 3rd, 7th and 10th houses from itself (classical), so the Moon is hit when placed there; the area of suppression follows the Moon's house (4th home and peace, 7th partnership, 10th career) and the Moon's sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 7th house (lagna Taurus) with Saturn in the 1st aspecting it by the 7th aspect: feelings held back inside partnerships, a very tight emotional register.

Derived: Moon in Pisces in the 4th house (lagna Sagittarius) with Saturn in Capricorn in the 2nd aspecting it by the 3rd aspect: the heart cannot be spoken at home (2nd house of speech and family) and peace of mind is held tight.

Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 10th house (lagna Virgo) with Saturn in the 1st aspecting it by the 10th aspect: career and public-image feelings are held in check; he works hard but rarely says what he feels.

ambiguity: 'दृष्टि' (aspect) may include conjunction in his usage; he does not say which aspects count or whether the Moon's sign matters.
classical_check: Agrees broadly: Saturn's conjunction or aspect on the Moon is read as a heavy, inhibited or depressed mind (visha yoga when conjunct).

hindi: इसलिए बहुत जरूरी है कि आपके शनि की इंप्रूवमेंट हो इसकी इंप्रूवमेंट होती है नीलम से
says: Remedy: it is therefore very important to improve your Saturn, and the improvement comes through blue sapphire (neelam).
classical_check: Agrees on neelam for Saturn; classical texts caution that it must be tested first because it acts hard when Saturn is unfavourable in the chart.

hindi: 11 नंबर राशि भी इसके पास है यमराज की ये भी नीलम ही काम करेगा यहां पर
says: Sign number 11 (Aquarius) is also Saturn's and is the sign of Yamaraj (Pluto) in his scheme; for Pluto too blue sapphire is what works.
cells_derived_method: Wherever Aquarius falls as a house, Saturn and Yama (Pluto) both colour it, and his remedy for both is neelam.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aquarius rising, so Saturn and Pluto both colour the self; neelam is his remedy for both.
Derived: Aquarius on the 8th house (lagna Cancer): Saturn and Yama share the house of slow transformation, research and long-term obstacles; neelam again his remedy.

ambiguity: 'इसके पास' could mean Saturn has Aquarius and Yama shares it; 'यहां पर' marks a position on his diagram.
classical_check: Differs: Aquarius is ruled by Saturn alone in classical texts; Pluto is outside the nine Parashari planets and its gem is his own mapping.

hindi: यहां पर वरुण है सात नंबर यह भी सफेद पुखराज काम करेगा यहां पर
says: Varuna (Neptune) sits at number 7 (Libra, Venus's sign) in his scheme, and for Varuna too white pukhraj, the Venus stone, will work.
cells_derived_method: Wherever Libra falls as a house, Venus and Neptune both colour it, and white pukhraj is his remedy for both.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra on the 7th house (lagna Aries): partnership colours from Venus plus Neptune's idealised, dreamy quality; white pukhraj per his remedy.
Derived: Libra on the 4th house (lagna Cancer): home life and the mother carry Venus's comfort together with Neptune's water-like, imaginative tone.

ambiguity: 'सात नंबर' is not called a sign explicitly and could be the 7th house; read as sign 7 because Libra is Venus's sign and the stone is Venus's.
classical_check: Neptune is outside classical Jyotish; the gem assignment is his own mapping.

hindi: यहां पर इंद्र है यह भी आपके लिए मूंगा काम करेगा
says: Indra (Uranus) is placed at the next point of his diagram, and for Indra too red coral (moonga), the Mars stone, will work.
cells_derived_method: none: the sign or number is not stated in this sentence, so no house or sign reading is derived.
ambiguity: The sign or number for Indra is not spoken here; the Mars stone suggests it shares Mars's Scorpio in his scheme, but that is inferred.
classical_check: Uranus is outside classical Jyotish; coral for Mars is classical, the Uranus mapping is his own.

hindi: यह केतु है इसके लिए लहसुनिया है
says: The gemstone for Ketu is cat's eye (lahsuniya).
classical_check: Agrees: cat's eye is the classical gem for Ketu.

hindi: इसके लिए गोमेद
says: Hessonite (gomed) is named for the next planet in the list; the planet is not spoken, but gomed is the classical stone of Rahu.
ambiguity: The caption ends at the batch edge and 'इसके लिए' does not name the planet; Rahu is inferred from the stone, and it could be another of his twelve.
classical_check: Agrees: hessonite is the classical gem for Rahu.

hindi: राहु जो है यह है आपकी बुद्धि यह है मुंडी यह सूर्य को ग्रहण लगा देता है यानी के किसी की राहु बुद्धि हो ना बुद्धिजीवी व्यक्ति तो सूर्य भी चुप हो जाता है
says: Rahu is the intellect, the head. It eclipses the Sun, so a person whose Rahu is strong (an intellectual) silences even the Sun, i.e. the plain soul/authority principle gets overshadowed by clever mind.
ambiguity: Unclear whether he means Rahu conjunct Sun or just a general strong Rahu in the chart.
classical_check: Classical texts give Sun-Rahu as a grahan (eclipse) combination that weakens Sun; Rahu as buddhi/head is his own framing (Rahu is the severed head in myth).

hindi: राहु बृहस्पति की भी बैंड बजा देता है बृहस्पति कहता है हा वाक में बात इसमें दम है
says: Rahu overpowers Jupiter as well; Jupiter, the planet of wisdom, has to concede that Rahu's argument has force, so Rahu dominates the guru planet.
ambiguity: Conjunction, aspect or general strength is not specified.
classical_check: Classical Guru-Chandala yoga says Rahu with Jupiter corrupts Jupiter's results; broadly agrees that Rahu dominates Jupiter, though it is usually called a negative combination.

hindi: राहु आपकी मुंडी है राहु जैसा ग्रह आपके जीवन के अंदर ज्योतिषी बनाता है ज्ञानी बनाता है लीडर बनाता है सारे मिनिस्टर जो पार्लियामेंट में जा रहे हैं सबका राहु सेट है
says: Rahu produces astrologers, scholars and leaders; he claims every minister who reaches Parliament has a well-set (strong) Rahu, linking Rahu with politics and public leadership.
ambiguity: 'Set' is not defined; no house or sign for the strong Rahu is given. The claim about all ministers is a sweeping generalisation not tested here.
classical_check: Classical texts link Rahu with politics, mass following, unconventional knowledge and sudden rise; agrees in spirit, but the 'all ministers' claim is not classical.

hindi: राहु के दशा के समय मनुष्य भयंकर बेबस होता है इसलिए राहु को कहते हैं बुरा प्लेनेट
says: During Rahu's dasha a person feels intensely helpless, and that is the reason Rahu is labelled a bad planet; he implies the label comes from the pressure of the period, not from the planet's nature.
ambiguity: Does not say which house/sign Rahu must occupy for the helplessness to occur.
classical_check: Classical tradition treats Rahu as a natural malefic and its dasha as troubled; agrees on the reputation, he reinterprets the reason.

hindi: जिंदगी में व्यक्ति को कूट कूट के पॉलिश करता है और ज्ञानी बनाता है तो जो कुटाई हो रही है वह राहु आपको ज्ञानी बनाने के लिए कर रहा है और हम कुटाई से हटते हैं
says: Rahu hammers and polishes a person through life and produces wisdom and speakers; the beating being received is Rahu's method of making you knowledgeable, and people tend to run away from that beating.
ambiguity: Sentence is cut at the chunk boundary and continues in the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent as a classical statement; it is his interpretive framing of Rahu's karmic pressure.

hindi: हैं तो बेवस कर देता है हम कुटाई को सोचते हैं चलो प्रारब्ध है परमात्मा की इच्छा है कोई बात नहीं
says: If a person dodges Rahu's hardship, Rahu leaves him helpless; the right attitude is to take the beating as prarabdha (past karma) and God's will and simply accept it.
ambiguity: Whether this is a prescription (accept hardship) or a description of how people cope is not fully clear from the caption.
classical_check: Classical texts do not speak of Rahu this way; acceptance of prarabdha is a general karma-theory idea.

hindi: यदि किसी का चंद्रमा राहु साथ हो तो महा कुड़ियल सड़ नेचर होती है महा कुड़ियल सड़
says: Moon and Rahu together make the nature extremely sour, brooding and irritable, someone who stews in resentment.
cells_derived_method: Conjunction is the stated condition, so the effect shifts with the house where the pair sits and the sign. In the 4th the sourness shows at home and with mother; in the 10th it shows at work and in public image; in a sign owned by a friend of the Moon the mood swings are milder than in Scorpio (Moon debilitated).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign with Rahu in the 4th (lagna Aries) - brooding at home, domestic mood stays sour; Moon's strength in own sign softens it somewhat.
Derived: Moon debilitated with Rahu in the 10th (lagna Aquarius) - resentment and bitterness colour career dealings and public image, the harshest version.
